(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defparameter *buffer-row-spec*
  (make-row-spec :buffer "buffer/1" '("list-buffers")
                 (vector (make-field-spec :buffer/name :buffer :text :format "buffer_name")
                         (make-field-spec :buffer/size :buffer :integer :format "buffer_size"
                                          :minimum 0 :maximum 18446744073709551615)
                         (make-field-spec :buffer/created :buffer :integer :format "buffer_created"
                                          :minimum -9223372036854775808 :maximum 9223372036854775807))))

(defun buffer-name-arguments (name &key create)
  (when name
    (let ((name (text-argument name "Buffer name" nil)))
      (when (and create
                 (find-if (lambda (character)
                            (or (< (char-code character) 32)
                                (= (char-code character) 127)
                                (char= character #\\)))
                          name))
        (invalid-argument "New buffer names cannot contain backslashes, ASCII controls or DEL"))
      (list "-b" name))))

(defun buffer-file-argument (path)
  (let ((path (text-argument path "Buffer file path" nil)))
    (when (string= path "-")
      (invalid-argument "Use set-buffer or show-buffer for bytes; spell a file named - as ./-"))
    (literal-format path)))

(defun decode-outcome-rows (client outcome spec cancel-token timeout row-limit)
  (handler-bind ((libtmux:libtmux-error
                   (lambda (condition)
                     (setf (slot-value condition 'libtmux::client) client
                           (slot-value condition 'libtmux::outcome) outcome))))
    (let ((budget (make-capture-budget
                   :deadline (+ (monotonic-seconds)
                                (- (or timeout (slot-value client 'libtmux::timeout))
                                   (libtmux:outcome-elapsed outcome)))))
          (token (or cancel-token (libtmux:make-cancellation-token))))
      (decode-rows spec (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::stdout) :row-limit row-limit
                   :check-budget (lambda () (check-capture-budget budget token))))))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun list-buffers (client &key (row-limit 10000) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Acquire buffer metadata; return a fresh simple vector of owned plists and an outcome.
Each plist has :BUFFER/NAME, :BUFFER/SIZE (bytes) and :BUFFER/CREATED (Unix
seconds). Preserve tmux's listing order; buffer names are mutable locators,
not captured entity identities. Empty listing returns #(). ROW-LIMIT bounds
decoding. Signals an operational or decoding condition with the raw outcome."
  (unless (typep row-limit '(integer 1))
    (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Buffer row limit must be positive"))
  (let* ((spec libtmux.internal::*buffer-row-spec*)
         (outcome (libtmux.internal::perform-command
                   client nil (list "list-buffers" "-F" (libtmux.internal::row-format spec))
                   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))
         (rows (libtmux.internal::decode-outcome-rows client outcome spec cancel-token timeout row-limit)))
    (values (map 'vector
                 (lambda (row)
                   (loop for field across (libtmux.internal::row-spec-fields spec)
                         append (list (libtmux.internal::field-spec-key field)
                                      (libtmux.internal::row-value row (libtmux.internal::field-spec-key field)))))
                 rows) outcome)))

(defun set-buffer (client data &key name append cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Store literal DATA in a named or automatic buffer; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
DATA is a NUL-free string or an octet vector. Strings use tmux set-buffer;
octets use its load-buffer stdin path and preserve NUL and invalid UTF-8.
APPEND is available only for strings. Empty DATA is tmux's no-op and preserves
an existing buffer. NAME is literal; omission creates an automatic name.
New names reject backslashes, ASCII controls and DEL before I/O because tmux
versions otherwise rewrite or reject them. Spaces and Unicode are supported.
Signals INVALID-ARGUMENT or an operational condition."
  (let ((names (libtmux.internal::buffer-name-arguments name :create t)))
    (if (stringp data)
        (libtmux.internal::perform-command
         client nil (append '("set-buffer") names (when append '("-a"))
                            (list "--" (libtmux.internal::text-argument data "Buffer text")))
         :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)
        (progn
          (unless (vectorp data) (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Buffer data must be a string or octet vector"))
          (when append (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Appending octets is not supported; use an explicit replacement"))
          (libtmux.internal::perform-command
           client nil (append '("load-buffer") names '("--" "-"))
           :input (libtmux.internal::octet-vector data)
           :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))))

(defun show-buffer (client &key name cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Read a literal named buffer, or tmux's top buffer; return octets and an outcome.
Output is an owned octet vector with no text decoding or trimming. Uses an
ordinary unattached tmux client and requires normal completion with empty stderr.
Names select the buffer at dispatch, not an earlier incarnation. A post-launch
failure does not prove non-dispatch. Signals an operational condition retaining
its outcome and any partial bytes."
  (let ((outcome (libtmux.internal::perform-command
                  client nil (append '("show-buffer") (libtmux.internal::buffer-name-arguments name))
                  :raw-read t :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))
    (values (outcome-stdout outcome) outcome)))

(defun load-buffer (client path &key name cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Load a file's bytes into a literal named or automatic buffer; return an outcome.
PATH is literal path text, not a format. Relative paths follow the tmux command
client's cwd. An empty file is tmux's no-op and preserves an existing buffer.
New names reject backslashes, ASCII controls and DEL before I/O.
Use SET-BUFFER for in-memory bytes. Signals INVALID-ARGUMENT or an operational
condition; a failure after dispatch may have an uncertain outcome."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client nil (append '("load-buffer") (libtmux.internal::buffer-name-arguments name :create t)
                      (list "--" (libtmux.internal::buffer-file-argument path)))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun save-buffer (client path &key name append cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Save a named or top buffer's bytes to literal PATH; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
Overwrite the file unless APPEND is true. Relative paths follow tmux's command
client cwd. Use SHOW-BUFFER for returned bytes. Success records tmux's reported
completion, not independently verified file contents or durability. In particular,
tmux 3.3a can suppress file-write errors. An uncertain write is never retried.
Signals INVALID-ARGUMENT or an operational condition."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client nil (append '("save-buffer") (libtmux.internal::buffer-name-arguments name)
                      (when append '("-a")) (list "--" (libtmux.internal::buffer-file-argument path)))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun paste-buffer (client pane &key name separator raw bracketed verbatim delete
                                     cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Paste a named or top buffer into PANE; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
Newlines become Return by default. RAW preserves newlines; SEPARATOR explicitly
replaces each newline with literal text and is mutually exclusive with RAW.
VERBATIM preserves every byte, implies RAW and disables tmux's newer control-byte
sanitization; it cannot be combined with a separator or bracket markers.
BRACKETED uses bracketed paste when the pane enabled it. DELETE removes the
selected buffer afterward. Tmux may accept without sending when input is
disabled; success does not prove application consumption. Signals STALE-TARGET
or an operational condition."
  (when (and raw separator) (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Choose raw paste or a separator"))
  (when (and verbatim (or separator bracketed))
    (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Verbatim paste cannot add a separator or bracket markers"))
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client (list pane)
   (append (list "paste-buffer" "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target pane :pane))
           (libtmux.internal::buffer-name-arguments name)
           (when separator (list "-s" (libtmux.internal::text-argument separator "Paste separator")))
           (when (or raw verbatim) '("-r")) (when bracketed '("-p")) (when delete '("-d")))
   :version-flags (when verbatim '(("3.7" "-S")))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun delete-buffer (client &key name cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Delete the literal named buffer, or the current top buffer; return an outcome.
Named deletion requires a live tmux 3.4+ daemon because 3.3a can delete the top
buffer when the supplied name is missing. On 3.3a, an explicit NAME signals
UNSUPPORTED-CAPABILITY before payload dispatch; omission still deletes the top
buffer. A name identifies the buffer at dispatch, not an earlier incarnation.
Signals an operational condition on failure; never retries an unknown deletion."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client nil (append '("delete-buffer") (libtmux.internal::buffer-name-arguments name))
   :minimum-version (when name "3.4") :feature :named-buffer-deletion
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defstruct capture-budget start deadline remaining row-limit field-limit retain-outcomes (outcomes nil))

(defun charge-capture-outcome (budget outcome)
  "Debit each completed native read before validation; optionally retain its evidence."
  (decf (capture-budget-remaining budget)
        (+ (length (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::stdout))
           (length (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::stderr))))
  (when (capture-budget-retain-outcomes budget)
    (push outcome (capture-budget-outcomes budget)))
  outcome)

(defun check-capture-budget (budget token)
  (when (libtmux:cancelled-p token)
    (error 'libtmux:command-cancelled :message "Operation was cancelled"))
  (unless (< (monotonic-seconds) (capture-budget-deadline budget))
    (error 'libtmux:deadline-exceeded :message "Operation exceeded its total deadline")))

(defun verify-listing-witness (client rows witness)
  (unless (and (= (length rows) 1)
               (= (row-value (aref rows 0) :server/pid) (server-witness-pid witness))
               (= (row-value (aref rows 0) :server/start-time) (server-witness-start witness))
               (equal (row-value (aref rows 0) :server/socket-path) (server-witness-socket witness))
               (equal (row-value (aref rows 0) :server/version) (server-witness-version witness))
               (server-witness-fd witness)
               (null (poll-owned (list (list :server (server-witness-fd witness) :input)) 0)))
    (invalidate-client-generation client)
    (inconsistent-capture "A listing connected to a different tmux server")))

(defun execute-capture-command (client arguments token budget)
  (check-capture-budget budget token)
  (let ((remaining-time (- (capture-budget-deadline budget) (monotonic-seconds))))
    (unless (plusp remaining-time)
      (error 'libtmux:deadline-exceeded :message "Snapshot acquisition exceeded its total deadline"))
    (unless (plusp (capture-budget-remaining budget))
      (error 'libtmux:output-limit-exceeded :message "Snapshot acquisition exceeded its total byte limit"))
    (check-outcome
     (charge-capture-outcome
      budget (execute-tmux client arguments token remaining-time
                           (capture-budget-remaining budget) nil)))))

(defun capture-command (client name token budget &optional witness)
  (let ((outcome (execute-capture-command
                  client (if witness
                             (append (row-command :witness) '(";") (rest (row-command name)))
                             (row-command name)) token budget)))
    (handler-bind ((libtmux:libtmux-error
                     (lambda (condition)
                       (setf (slot-value condition 'libtmux::outcome) outcome))))
      (let* ((bytes (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::stdout))
             (start (if witness
                        (1+ (or (position 10 bytes)
                                (inconsistent-capture "Missing listing connection witness")))
                        0)))
        (when witness
          (verify-listing-witness
           client (decode-rows :witness (subseq bytes 0 start) :row-limit 1
                                       :field-limit (capture-budget-field-limit budget)) witness))
        (decode-rows name (make-array (- (length bytes) start) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8)
                                     :displaced-to bytes :displaced-index-offset start)
                     :row-limit (capture-budget-row-limit budget)
                     :field-limit (capture-budget-field-limit budget)
                     :check-budget (lambda () (check-capture-budget budget token)))))))

(defun capture-listing-batch (client token budget witness)
  (let ((outcome (execute-capture-command client (listing-batch-command) token budget)))
    (handler-bind ((libtmux:libtmux-error
                     (lambda (condition)
                       (setf (slot-value condition 'libtmux::outcome) outcome))))
      (decode-listing-batch
       (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::stdout)
       (lambda (rows) (verify-listing-witness client rows witness))
       :row-limit (capture-budget-row-limit budget)
       :field-limit (capture-budget-field-limit budget)
       :check-budget (lambda () (check-capture-budget budget token))))))

(defun read-server-witness (client token budget)
  (handler-case
      (let ((rows (capture-command client :witness token budget)))
        (unless (= 1 (length rows))
          (inconsistent-capture "Expected exactly one live tmux server witness"))
        (witness-from-row client (aref rows 0)))
    (error (condition)
      (invalidate-client-generation client)
      (error condition))))

(defun audit-with-budget (client token budget)
  (check-capture-budget budget token)
  (unless (plusp (capture-budget-remaining budget))
    (error 'libtmux:output-limit-exceeded :message "Operation exhausted its byte budget before configuration audit"))
  (audit-command-aliases
   client token (max 0 (- (capture-budget-deadline budget) (monotonic-seconds)))
   (capture-budget-remaining budget) (lambda (outcome) (charge-capture-outcome budget outcome))))

(defun acquire-snapshot (client token budget entity-limit)
  (audit-with-budget client token budget)
  (let* ((start (monotonic-seconds)) (wall-start (get-universal-time))
         (before (accept-server-witness client (read-server-witness client token budget))))
    (let* ((*command-socket-path* (server-witness-endpoint before))
           (session-rows (capture-command client :session token budget before))
           (link-rows #()) (pane-rows #()) (client-rows #()) (after nil))
      (when (plusp (length session-rows))
        (multiple-value-setq (link-rows pane-rows client-rows)
          (capture-listing-batch client token budget before)))
      (unwind-protect
           (progn
             (setf after (read-server-witness client token budget))
             (unless (same-witness-p before after)
               (accept-server-witness client after)
               (setf after nil)
               (inconsistent-capture "Tmux server changed during snapshot acquisition"))
             (check-capture-budget budget token)
             (build-snapshot
              (slot-value client 'libtmux::context) (slot-value client 'libtmux::generation)
              (append (witness-provenance before)
                      (list :executable-version (libtmux:tmux-version client)
                            :acquired-monotonic-start start :acquired-monotonic-end (monotonic-seconds)
                            :acquired-universal-start wall-start :acquired-universal-end (get-universal-time)))
              session-rows link-rows pane-rows client-rows :entity-limit entity-limit
              :check-budget (lambda () (check-capture-budget budget token))))
        (close-witness after)))))

(defun capture-with-retries (client token budget entity-limit)
  (loop for attempt below 3
        do (handler-case
               (return (acquire-snapshot client token budget entity-limit))
             (libtmux:incomplete-snapshot (condition)
               (when (= attempt 2) (error condition))))))

(defun resolve-observation (client observation new)
  (let ((old (etypecase observation
               (libtmux:snapshot observation)
               (libtmux:entity (slot-value observation 'libtmux::snapshot)))))
    (unless (and (eq (slot-value old 'libtmux::context) (slot-value new 'libtmux::context))
                 (= (slot-value old 'libtmux::generation) (slot-value new 'libtmux::generation)))
      (error 'libtmux:stale-target :client client :target observation
             :message "The capture belongs to an older server context"))
    (when (typep observation 'libtmux:snapshot) (return-from resolve-observation new))
    (let* ((values (captured-collection new (libtmux:entity-model observation)))
           (matches
             (if (typep observation 'libtmux:attached-client)
                 (remove-if (complement (lambda (value) (string= (libtmux:name value) (libtmux:name observation)))) values)
                 (remove-if (complement (lambda (value) (libtmux:same-entity-p value observation))) values))))
      (unless (= (length matches) 1)
        (error 'libtmux:stale-target :client client :target observation
               :message "Captured target is missing or ambiguous"))
      (let ((result (aref matches 0)))
        (when (typep observation 'libtmux:attached-client)
          (unless (and (nth-value 1 (libtmux:field-value observation :client/created))
                       (every (lambda (field)
                                (equal (multiple-value-list (libtmux:field-value observation field))
                                       (multiple-value-list (libtmux:field-value result field))))
                              '(:client/pid :client/created :client/tty)))
            (error 'libtmux:stale-target :client client :target observation
                   :message "Attached-client target was replaced or cannot be verified")))
        result))))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun fetch-snapshot (client &key cancel-token (timeout (slot-value client 'timeout))
                                  (output-limit (slot-value client 'output-limit))
                                  (row-limit 100000) (entity-limit 100000) (field-limit 1048576))
  "Acquire an eager native graph; all later accessors on it are local.
TIMEOUT controls one acquisition deadline and OUTPUT-LIMIT caps combined output,
including at most two retries after contradictory observations. Synchronous
setup and additional cleanup can extend caller wall time. ROW-LIMIT bounds each listing;
ENTITY-LIMIT bounds the complete graph; FIELD-LIMIT bounds encoded field bytes.
No daemon is started. A live daemon with zero sessions yields empty vectors;
connection/listing failures remain errors. Closing CLIENT leaves this snapshot
usable. This is an interval observation, not a transactional snapshot.
See also: FETCH-PANES, PROVENANCE, REFRESH, ERROR-OUTCOME."
  (libtmux.internal::check-limits timeout output-limit)
  (dolist (limit (list row-limit entity-limit field-limit))
    (unless (typep limit '(integer 1))
      (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Capture count/field limits must be positive integers")))
  (handler-bind ((libtmux-error
                   (lambda (condition) (setf (slot-value condition 'client) client))))
    (libtmux.internal::call-with-operation
     client cancel-token
     (lambda (token)
       (let* ((start (libtmux.internal::monotonic-seconds))
              (budget (libtmux.internal::make-capture-budget
                       :start start :deadline (+ start timeout) :remaining output-limit
                       :row-limit row-limit :field-limit field-limit)))
         (libtmux.internal::capture-with-retries client token budget entity-limit))))))

(defun fetch-sessions (client &rest options)
  "Acquire a complete snapshot and return its fresh session vector. OPTIONS go to FETCH-SNAPSHOT."
  (sessions (apply #'fetch-snapshot client options)))
(defun fetch-windows (client &rest options)
  "Acquire a complete snapshot and return physical windows once each. OPTIONS go to FETCH-SNAPSHOT."
  (windows (apply #'fetch-snapshot client options)))
(defun fetch-panes (client &rest options)
  "Acquire a complete snapshot and return physical panes once each. OPTIONS go to FETCH-SNAPSHOT."
  (panes (apply #'fetch-snapshot client options)))
(defun fetch-clients (client &rest options)
  "Acquire a complete snapshot and return every attached-client row. OPTIONS go to FETCH-SNAPSHOT."
  (clients (apply #'fetch-snapshot client options)))

(defun refresh (client observation &rest options)
  "Acquire a replacement observation, leaving the earlier capture unchanged.
CLIENT must own the original context/generation. Missing or replaced targets
signal STALE-TARGET. Attached-client refresh requires one unique live target
name with the same PID/creation/tty fingerprint; its observation identity changes."
  (let* ((old (etypecase observation (snapshot observation) (entity (slot-value observation 'snapshot))))
         (new (progn
                (unless (eq (slot-value old 'context) (slot-value client 'context))
                  (error 'stale-target :client client :target observation
                         :message "The capture belongs to another client context"))
                (apply #'fetch-snapshot client options))))
    (libtmux.internal::resolve-observation client observation new)))

(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defun terminal-client-target (target)
  (unless (typep target 'libtmux:attached-client)
    (invalid-argument "Expected a captured attached-client target"))
  (when (libtmux:field-value target :client/control-mode)
    (invalid-argument "This operation requires an ordinary terminal client"))
  ;; Native client lookup strips exactly one final colon.
  (concatenate 'string (libtmux:name target) ":"))

(defun check-terminal-client-selector (target)
  (let* ((name (libtmux:name target))
         (matches
           (remove-if
            (complement
             (lambda (candidate)
               (let ((tty (libtmux:field-value candidate :client/tty)))
                 (or (string= name (libtmux:name candidate))
                     (and tty (or (string= name tty)
                                  (and (uiop:string-prefix-p "/dev/" tty)
                                       (string= name tty :start2 5))))))))
            (libtmux:clients (slot-value target 'libtmux::snapshot)))))
    (unless (and (= 1 (length matches)) (eq target (aref matches 0)))
      (error 'libtmux:stale-target :target target
             :message "The attached-client selector matches another client's name or tty"))))

(defun client-request-builder (arguments)
  (lambda (witness current)
    (declare (ignore witness))
    (terminal-client-target (first current))
    (check-terminal-client-selector (first current))
    arguments))

(defun request-client-action (client target command flags options)
  (let ((arguments (append (list command "-t" (terminal-client-target target)) flags)))
    (apply #'perform-command client (list target) arguments
           :argument-builder (client-request-builder arguments) options)))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun switch-client (client target session &key update-environment (observe t)
                                               cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Switch captured terminal TARGET to SESSION and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
CLIENT is the connection owning both observations. UPDATE-ENVIRONMENT defaults
NIL, preserving the destination session environment; true applies tmux's
update-environment option using TARGET's environment. OBSERVE defaults true and
supplies a replacement attached-client through OUTCOME-VALUE. Earlier captures
stay unchanged; failed follow-up acquisition stays in OUTCOME-OBSERVATION-ERROR.
Blocks for preflight, dispatch and optional observation under shared limits.
Preflight checks the unique client name and PID/creation/tty fingerprint; tmux
does not atomically guard that fingerprint at dispatch. A changed or foreign
target signals STALE-TARGET. Operational failures retain their outcome; no
mutation is retried. Control clients are not supported by this operation.
See also: FETCH-CLIENTS, REFRESH, DETACH-CLIENT, OUTCOME-VALUE."
  (let ((arguments
          (append (list "switch-client" "-c" (libtmux.internal::terminal-client-target target)
                        "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target session :session))
                  (unless update-environment '("-E")))))
    (libtmux.internal::perform-command
     client (list target session) arguments
     :argument-builder (libtmux.internal::client-request-builder arguments)
     :observe (when observe (libtmux.internal::observe-target client target))
     :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun detach-client (client target &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Request detachment of captured terminal TARGET; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
CLIENT must own the observation. Success acknowledges the server's request,
not frontend process exit or terminal restoration. Returns no replacement.
Blocks under the supplied limits. The unique name/PID/creation/tty preflight
cannot exclude replacement between validation and dispatch. Missing or foreign
targets signal STALE-TARGET; external failures retain their outcome. Never
retries, detaches other clients, kills a parent, or starts a shell command.
See also: FETCH-CLIENTS, SWITCH-CLIENT, OUTCOME-STATUS."
  (libtmux.internal::request-client-action
   client target "detach-client" nil
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun refresh-client (client target &key status-only cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Request a redraw of captured terminal TARGET; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
STATUS-ONLY requests only the status line; NIL requests the whole display.
Success acknowledges scheduling, not completed terminal rendering. This is an
external operation; REFRESH instead acquires a replacement observation.
CLIENT must own TARGET. Blocks under shared preflight/dispatch limits. A stale
or foreign target signals STALE-TARGET; other failures retain their outcome.
The client fingerprint is checked before dispatch, with a remaining replacement
race. Returns no replacement and never retries the request.
See also: FETCH-CLIENTS, REFRESH, OUTCOME-STATUS."
  (libtmux.internal::request-client-action
   client target "refresh-client" (when status-only '("-S"))
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun suspend-client (client target &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Request suspension of captured terminal TARGET; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
Tmux asks the frontend to stop with SIGTSTP. Success acknowledges the request;
it does not prove process suspension. An already suspended frontend can be a
no-op. Its controlling application owns resumption. CLIENT must own TARGET.
Blocks under shared preflight/dispatch limits; returns no replacement. Stale or
foreign targets signal STALE-TARGET; other failures retain their outcome.
Preflight cannot exclude client replacement before dispatch. Never retries.
See also: FETCH-CLIENTS, DETACH-CLIENT, LOCK-CLIENT, OUTCOME-STATUS."
  (libtmux.internal::request-client-action
   client target "suspend-client" nil
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun lock-client (client target &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Request locking of captured terminal TARGET; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
The frontend runs the session's configured lock-command through its shell.
Success acknowledges the request, not lock startup, completion or authentication.
An already suspended frontend or an empty/oversized lock command can be a no-op.
CLIENT must own TARGET.
Blocks under shared preflight/dispatch limits; returns no replacement. Stale or
foreign targets signal STALE-TARGET; other failures retain their outcome.
Preflight cannot exclude client replacement before dispatch. Never retries.
See also: FETCH-CLIENTS, LOCK-SESSION, LOCK-SERVER, SET-OPTION, SUSPEND-CLIENT, OUTCOME-STATUS."
  (libtmux.internal::request-client-action
   client target "lock-client" nil
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defclass subprocess-transport () ())

(defgeneric execute-command (transport argv &key input timeout output-limit cancel-token keep-input-open)
  (:documentation "Internal transport protocol. Return an owned command outcome."))

(defmethod execute-command ((transport subprocess-transport) argv
                            &key input (timeout 30) (output-limit (* 16 1024 1024))
                              cancel-token keep-input-open)
  (declare (ignore transport))
  (run-process argv :input input :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit
                    :cancel-token cancel-token :keep-input-open keep-input-open))

(defun version-components (text)
  (let* ((version (string-trim '(#\Space #\Tab #\Newline #\Return) text))
         (dot (position #\. version))
         (suffix (and dot (position-if-not #'digit-char-p version :start (1+ dot)))))
    (unless (and dot (plusp dot)
                 (every #'digit-char-p (subseq version 0 dot))
                 (< (1+ dot) (or suffix (length version)))
                 (or (null suffix)
                     (and (= suffix (1- (length version)))
                          (char<= #\a (char version suffix) #\z))))
      (error 'libtmux:unsupported-tmux
             :message (format nil "Cannot identify the tmux release ~S" text)))
    (list (parse-integer version :end dot)
          (parse-integer version :start (1+ dot) :end suffix)
          (if suffix (1+ (- (char-code (char version suffix)) (char-code #\a))) 0))))

(defun supported-version (text)
  (let ((components (version-components text)))
    (unless (loop for actual in components for minimum in '(3 3 1)
                  when (> actual minimum) return t
                  when (< actual minimum) return nil
                  finally (return t))
      (error 'libtmux:unsupported-tmux
             :message (format nil "tmux 3.3a or newer is required; found ~A" text)))
    (copy-seq text)))

(defun version-at-least-p (actual minimum)
  (loop for value in (version-components actual) for bound in (version-components minimum)
        when (> value bound) return t
        when (< value bound) return nil
        finally (return t)))

(defstruct operation token owner)

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defclass client ()
  ((program :initarg :program :initform nil)
   (socket-name :initarg :socket-name :initform nil)
   (socket-path :initarg :socket-path :initform nil)
   (config-file :initarg :config-file :initform nil)
   (version :initform nil)
   (timeout :initarg :timeout :initform 30)
   (output-limit :initarg :output-limit :initform (* 16 1024 1024))
   (transport :initarg :transport
              :initform (make-instance 'libtmux.internal::subprocess-transport))
   (lock :initform (libtmux.internal::make-lock "tmux client"))
   (changed :initform (libtmux.internal::make-condition-variable))
   (state :initform :open)
   (active :initform nil)
   (cleanup-owner :initform nil)
   (cleanup-jobs :initform nil)
   (cleanup-failures :initform nil)
   (context :initform (gensym (format nil "SERVER-~36R-"
                                     (random (ash 1 128) (make-random-state t)))))
   (generation :initform 0)
   (witness :initform nil))
  (:documentation "A connection scope with one external-operation lease.
Closing cancels owned work and leaves the tmux daemon alive. Captured data may
outlive the client. Public operations never expose its mutable storage.

A client reaches one tmux server through a tmux program and an optional socket
name or path. The operations below take it as their first argument and run one
at a time per client.

#### What is on here

Operations on a tmux server take a client first. They fall into these groups:

**Connecting and closing.** `libtmux:open-client` checks the tmux version and
returns a client for the default socket or the one you name; it starts no
daemon. `libtmux:with-client` closes the client on every exit, and
`libtmux:close-client` does it by hand, cancelling active work and leaving the
daemon running. `libtmux:tmux-version`, `libtmux:client-open-p` and
`libtmux:client-cleanup-failures` report the release seen at open and the
lifecycle, without contacting tmux. `libtmux.control:open-connection` takes a
client and a captured session and attaches a separate control connection,
which needs a daemon at tmux 3.8 or newer.

`libtmux:open-client`, `libtmux:with-client`, `libtmux:close-client`,
`libtmux:tmux-version`, `libtmux:client-open-p`,
`libtmux:client-cleanup-failures` and `libtmux.control:open-connection`

**Capturing and querying.** `libtmux:fetch-snapshot` captures sessions,
windows, panes, window links and attached clients as one graph that stays
usable after the client closes; it is an interval observation, not a
transaction. `libtmux:fetch-sessions`, `libtmux:fetch-windows`,
`libtmux:fetch-panes` and `libtmux:fetch-clients` each take a fresh snapshot
and return one collection, and `libtmux:refresh` returns a replacement
observation without changing the earlier one. The optional query package
filters a capture locally: `libtmux.query:compile-filter` compiles a filter
form without evaluating it as Lisp, `libtmux.query:matching` returns the
values it accepts, and `libtmux.query:one` and `libtmux.query:one-or-none`
take the single result.

`libtmux:fetch-snapshot`, `libtmux:fetch-sessions`, `libtmux:fetch-windows`,
`libtmux:fetch-panes`, `libtmux:fetch-clients`, `libtmux:refresh`,
`libtmux.query:compile-filter`, `libtmux.query:matching`, `libtmux.query:one`
and `libtmux.query:one-or-none`

**Creating, restarting and removing.** `libtmux:new-session` creates a
detached session on a daemon that is already running; it never starts or
replaces one. `libtmux:new-window` adds a window to a captured session and
`libtmux:split-pane` splits a captured pane, and `libtmux:outcome-value`
supplies the created object from each result. `libtmux:respawn-pane` restarts
a pane's process in place, and `libtmux:respawn-window` restarts a window as a
single pane. `libtmux:kill-pane`, `libtmux:kill-window` and
`libtmux:kill-session` delete exactly the captured target, while
`libtmux:kill-server` terminates the daemon, which `libtmux:close-client`
never does.

`libtmux:new-session`, `libtmux:new-window`, `libtmux:split-pane`,
`libtmux:outcome-value`, `libtmux:respawn-pane`, `libtmux:respawn-window`,
`libtmux:kill-pane`, `libtmux:kill-window`, `libtmux:kill-session`,
`libtmux:kill-server` and `libtmux:close-client`

**Selecting, renaming and arranging.** Each operation takes captured targets
and changes what is selected, how sessions, windows and panes are named, sized
and laid out, or where they sit. Most also take an observe argument, true by
default, whose replacement record `libtmux:outcome-value` returns; earlier
captures stay unchanged. `libtmux:select-layout` applies a named or custom
layout, and `libtmux:swap-windows`, `libtmux:move-window`,
`libtmux:link-window` and `libtmux:unlink-window` work on window links.

`libtmux:select-window`, `libtmux:select-pane`, `libtmux:next-window`,
`libtmux:previous-window`, `libtmux:last-window`, `libtmux:last-pane`,
`libtmux:rename-window`, `libtmux:rename-session`, `libtmux:select-layout`,
`libtmux:next-layout`, `libtmux:previous-layout`, `libtmux:resize-pane`,
`libtmux:resize-window`, `libtmux:rotate-window`, `libtmux:swap-panes`,
`libtmux:swap-windows`, `libtmux:move-pane`, `libtmux:join-pane`,
`libtmux:break-pane`, `libtmux:move-window`, `libtmux:link-window`,
`libtmux:unlink-window` and `libtmux:outcome-value`

**Reading and driving panes.** `libtmux:capture-pane` reads a pane as strict
UTF-8 text and signals a decoding error otherwise, and
`libtmux:capture-pane-bytes` returns the octets unchanged. `libtmux:send-text`
sends literal text, `libtmux:send-keys` interprets tmux key names such as C-c
and Enter, and `libtmux:send-prefix` sends the session's prefix key. A
completed send means tmux processed the request, not that the application
consumed it. `libtmux:clear-history`, `libtmux:copy-mode` and
`libtmux:pipe-pane` clear a pane's history, enter or leave copy mode, and set
up a tmux-owned pipe.

`libtmux:capture-pane`, `libtmux:capture-pane-bytes`, `libtmux:send-text`,
`libtmux:send-keys`, `libtmux:send-prefix`, `libtmux:clear-history`,
`libtmux:copy-mode` and `libtmux:pipe-pane`

**Options, hooks and environment.** `libtmux:set-option`, `libtmux:set-hook`
and `libtmux:set-environment` write one entry, and every operation here
requires a scope, with a captured target for a session, window or pane.
`libtmux:show-option` returns one decoded option with a presence flag,
`libtmux:show-options` returns decoded records for several, and
`libtmux:show-hooks` and `libtmux:show-environment` do the same for hooks and
environment entries. `libtmux:show-options-text` and its hook and environment
counterparts return tmux's printer text instead. `libtmux:unset-environment`
deletes a name, while `libtmux:remove-environment` stores tmux's removal
marker.

`libtmux:set-option`, `libtmux:unset-option`, `libtmux:show-option`,
`libtmux:show-options`, `libtmux:show-options-text`, `libtmux:set-hook`,
`libtmux:unset-hook`, `libtmux:show-hooks`, `libtmux:show-hooks-text`,
`libtmux:set-environment`, `libtmux:unset-environment`,
`libtmux:remove-environment`, `libtmux:show-environment` and
`libtmux:show-environment-text`

**Buffers.** `libtmux:set-buffer` and `libtmux:load-buffer` store a string,
octets or a file's bytes; `libtmux:show-buffer`, `libtmux:save-buffer` and
`libtmux:paste-buffer` read a buffer's octets, write them to a file or paste
them into a pane. `libtmux:list-buffers` returns each buffer's name, size and
creation time, and `libtmux:delete-buffer` deletes one. Without a name, show,
save, paste and delete use tmux's top buffer, while store and load create an
automatic name; deleting by name needs tmux 3.4 or newer.

`libtmux:set-buffer`, `libtmux:load-buffer`, `libtmux:show-buffer`,
`libtmux:save-buffer`, `libtmux:paste-buffer`, `libtmux:list-buffers` and
`libtmux:delete-buffer`

**Attached terminals, key bindings and the rest.** `libtmux:switch-client`,
`libtmux:detach-client` and the other terminal operations act on one attached
terminal taken from a capture, while `libtmux:lock-session` and
`libtmux:lock-server` lock a session's or every attached terminal.
`libtmux:bind-key` and `libtmux:unbind-key` change key bindings and
`libtmux:server-access` changes the daemon's access list; `libtmux:list-keys`,
`libtmux:list-commands` and `libtmux:list-server-access` print bindings,
built-in commands and the access list. `libtmux:wait-for` waits on, signals or
locks a channel, though waiting and locking need tmux 3.8, and
`libtmux:display-message` prints a message through tmux. `libtmux:run-command`
runs explicit tmux arguments for anything else; it does not check captured
targets.

`libtmux:switch-client`, `libtmux:detach-client`, `libtmux:refresh-client`,
`libtmux:suspend-client`, `libtmux:lock-client`, `libtmux:lock-session`,
`libtmux:lock-server`, `libtmux:bind-key`, `libtmux:unbind-key`,
`libtmux:server-access`, `libtmux:list-keys`, `libtmux:list-commands`,
`libtmux:list-server-access`, `libtmux:wait-for`, `libtmux:display-message`
and `libtmux:run-command`"))

(defmethod print-object ((client client) stream)
  (print-unreadable-object (client stream :type t :identity t)
    (format stream "~A" (slot-value client 'state))))

(defun client-open-p (client)
  "Return whether CLIENT's lifecycle is open; no tmux I/O.
An active operation may still cause CLIENT-BUSY when new work is attempted."
  (libtmux.internal::call-with-lock
   (slot-value client 'lock) (lambda () (eq (slot-value client 'state) :open))))

(defun client-cleanup-failures (client)
  "Return a fresh vector of secondary cleanup conditions, newest first. No I/O."
  (libtmux.internal::call-with-lock
   (slot-value client 'lock)
   (lambda () (coerce (slot-value client 'cleanup-failures) 'simple-vector))))

(defun tmux-version (client)
  "Return a fresh copy of the release string observed when CLIENT opened."
  (let ((version (slot-value client 'version)))
    (and version (copy-seq version))))

(defgeneric close-client (client)
  (:documentation "Reject new work, cancel active work and release owned resources.
The operation is idempotent and does not kill the daemon. A bounded teardown
failure signals CLEANUP-FAILED; the active owner still retains cleanup duty."))

(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defun record-cleanup-failure (client condition)
  ;; No user callback or printer may replace a protected nonlocal exit.
  (handler-case
      (call-with-lock
       (slot-value client 'libtmux::lock)
       (lambda ()
         (setf (slot-value client 'libtmux::cleanup-failures)
               (subseq (cons condition (slot-value client 'libtmux::cleanup-failures))
                       0 (min 16 (1+ (length (slot-value client 'libtmux::cleanup-failures))))))))
    (serious-condition () nil)))

(defun retain-cleanup-job (client job)
  (call-with-lock
   (slot-value client 'libtmux::lock)
   (lambda ()
     (pushnew job (slot-value client 'libtmux::cleanup-jobs))
     (setf (slot-value client 'libtmux::state) :closing))))

(defun call-with-client-scope (client body)
  (let ((normal nil))
    (unwind-protect
         (multiple-value-prog1 (funcall body client) (setf normal t))
      (handler-case (libtmux:close-client client)
        (error (condition)
          (if normal (error condition) (record-cleanup-failure client condition)))))))

(defun call-with-operation (client token function)
  (let ((operation (make-operation :token (or token (libtmux:make-cancellation-token))
                                   :owner (current-thread))))
    (check-type (operation-token operation) libtmux:cancellation-token)
    (let ((failure
            (call-with-lock
             (slot-value client 'libtmux::lock)
             (lambda ()
               (cond ((not (eq (slot-value client 'libtmux::state) :open)) :closed)
                     ((slot-value client 'libtmux::active) :busy)
                     (t (setf (slot-value client 'libtmux::active) operation) nil))))))
      (case failure
        (:closed (error 'libtmux:client-closed
                        :message "Client is closed; open a new client"))
        (:busy (error 'libtmux:client-busy
                      :message "Client has an active external operation"))))
    (unwind-protect
         (let ((*operation-client* client))
           (funcall function (operation-token operation)))
      (call-with-lock
       (slot-value client 'libtmux::lock)
       (lambda ()
         (setf (slot-value client 'libtmux::active) nil)
         (when (and (eq (slot-value client 'libtmux::state) :closing)
                    (not (slot-value client 'libtmux::cleanup-jobs))
                    (not (slot-value client 'libtmux::witness))
                    (not (slot-value client 'libtmux::cleanup-owner)))
           (setf (slot-value client 'libtmux::state) :closed))
         (condition-broadcast (slot-value client 'libtmux::changed)))))))

(defun client-argv (client arguments)
  (let ((name (unless *command-socket-path* (slot-value client 'libtmux::socket-name)))
        (path (or *command-socket-path* (slot-value client 'libtmux::socket-path)))
        (config (slot-value client 'libtmux::config-file)))
    (append (list (slot-value client 'libtmux::program) "-u")
            (when name (list "-L" name)) (when path (list "-S" path))
            (when config (list "-f" config)) (coerce arguments 'list))))

(defun execute-tmux (client arguments token timeout output-limit input &key keep-input-open)
  (execute-command (slot-value client 'libtmux::transport)
                   (client-argv client arguments) :input input :timeout timeout
                   :output-limit output-limit :cancel-token token :keep-input-open keep-input-open))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defmethod close-client ((client client))
  (let ((active
          (libtmux.internal::call-with-lock
           (slot-value client 'lock)
           (lambda ()
             (unless (eq (slot-value client 'state) :closed)
               (setf (slot-value client 'state) :closing))
             (slot-value client 'active)))))
    (when active
      (cancel (libtmux.internal::operation-token active))
      (when (eq (libtmux.internal::operation-owner active)
                (libtmux.internal::current-thread))
        (error 'cleanup-failed :message "Cannot join an operation from its own thread")))
    (let* ((deadline (+ (libtmux.internal::monotonic-seconds) 0.75))
           (acquired
             (libtmux.internal::call-with-lock
              (slot-value client 'lock)
              (lambda ()
                (loop while (or (slot-value client 'active) (slot-value client 'cleanup-owner))
                      for remaining = (- deadline (libtmux.internal::monotonic-seconds))
                      do (unless (and (plusp remaining)
                                      (libtmux.internal::condition-wait
                                       (slot-value client 'changed) (slot-value client 'lock)
                                       remaining))
                           (return nil))
                      finally (return (setf (slot-value client 'cleanup-owner)
                                            (libtmux.internal::current-thread))))))))
      (unless acquired
        (error 'cleanup-failed
               :message "Active operation has not completed cleanup; client stays closing"))
      (unwind-protect
           (let ((libtmux.internal::*operation-client* client))
             (dolist (job (copy-list (slot-value client 'cleanup-jobs)))
               (when (libtmux.internal::cleanup-job job)
                 (setf (slot-value client 'cleanup-jobs)
                       (remove job (slot-value client 'cleanup-jobs)))))
             (unless (slot-value client 'cleanup-jobs)
               (libtmux.internal::release-client-witness client)))
        (libtmux.internal::call-with-lock
         (slot-value client 'lock)
         (lambda ()
           (setf (slot-value client 'cleanup-owner) nil
                 (slot-value client 'state)
                 (if (or (slot-value client 'cleanup-jobs) (slot-value client 'witness)) :closing :closed))
           (libtmux.internal::condition-broadcast (slot-value client 'changed)))))
      (when (slot-value client 'cleanup-jobs)
        (error 'cleanup-failed :resource (first (slot-value client 'cleanup-jobs))
               :message "Owned process cleanup remains incomplete; retry CLOSE-CLIENT"))))
  (values))

(defun open-client (&key (program "tmux") socket-name socket-path config-file
                        (timeout 30) (output-limit (* 16 1024 1024)))
  "Open an SBCL/Linux subprocess client and check its tmux version.
Checks the runtime profile and required OS facilities before resolving PROGRAM.
An unsupported profile or facility signals UNSUPPORTED-PLATFORM; ERROR-FEATURE
identifies the requirement. PROGRAM must resolve to a native x86_64 ELF tmux
executable; pass the underlying binary when PATH selects a script or shim.
SOCKET-NAME and SOCKET-PATH are mutually exclusive; omission selects tmux's
default socket. No daemon is started. TIMEOUT is seconds; OUTPUT-LIMIT bounds
combined stdout/stderr bytes per command. Signals an operational condition on
version/launch failure. Returned configuration strings are owned by the client.
See also: WITH-CLIENT, CLOSE-CLIENT, UNSUPPORTED-PLATFORM, ERROR-FEATURE."
  (libtmux.internal::require-process-profile)
  (libtmux.internal::check-limits timeout output-limit)
  (when (and socket-name socket-path)
    (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Specify socket-name or socket-path, not both"))
  (dolist (value (list socket-name socket-path config-file))
    (when value
      (unless (and (stringp value) (plusp (length value)) (not (find #\Null value)))
        (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Socket/configuration values must be nonempty strings without NUL"))))
  (libtmux.internal::ensure-process-platform)
  (let ((client (make-instance 'client
                 :program (libtmux.internal::native-program program)
                 :socket-name (and socket-name (copy-seq socket-name))
                 :socket-path (and socket-path (libtmux.internal::absolute-native-path socket-path))
                 :config-file (and config-file (libtmux.internal::absolute-native-path config-file))
                 :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))
        (opened nil))
    (unwind-protect
         (handler-bind ((libtmux-error
                          (lambda (condition) (setf (slot-value condition 'client) client))))
           (let* ((outcome (run-command client '("-V") :effect :read))
                  (text (string-trim '(#\Newline #\Return)
                                      (libtmux.internal::strict-text (outcome-stdout outcome)))))
             (unless (and (>= (length text) 5) (string= "tmux " text :end2 5))
               (error 'unsupported-tmux :outcome outcome
                      :message "The selected executable did not report a tmux release"))
             (setf (slot-value client 'version)
                   (libtmux.internal::supported-version (subseq text 5))))
           (setf opened t)
           client)
      (unless opened
        (handler-case (close-client client)
          (error (condition) (libtmux.internal::record-cleanup-failure client condition)))))))

(defmacro with-client ((name &rest options) &body body)
  "Bind NAME to a client and close the original resource on every exit.
Body declarations and multiple values are preserved. Cleanup failure signals
after normal return; during unwind it is retained in CLIENT-CLEANUP-FAILURES."
  (let ((owned (gensym "CLIENT")))
    `(let ((,owned (open-client ,@options)))
       (libtmux.internal::call-with-client-scope
        ,owned (lambda (,name) ,@body)))))

(defun run-command (client arguments &key effect input cancel-token
                       (timeout (slot-value client 'timeout))
                       (output-limit (slot-value client 'output-limit)))
  "Execute explicit tmux argv and return a retained COMMAND-OUTCOME.
EFFECT must be :READ or :MUTATION. Arguments are literal argv strings; tmux's
own command/format grammar still applies. INPUT is an octet vector or NIL.
This escape hatch does not validate captured target identities. Failures signal
conditions retaining the outcome; uncertain mutations are never retried."
  (unless (member effect '(:read :mutation))
    (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Run-command requires :effect :read or :mutation"))
  (let ((arguments (libtmux.internal::argument-vector arguments)))
    (unless (plusp (length arguments))
      (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Run-command requires at least one argument"))
    (libtmux.internal::check-limits timeout output-limit)
    (handler-bind ((libtmux-error
                     (lambda (condition) (setf (slot-value condition 'client) client))))
      (libtmux.internal::call-with-operation
       client cancel-token
       (lambda (token)
         (libtmux.internal::check-outcome
          (libtmux.internal::execute-tmux client arguments token timeout output-limit input)))))))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defgeneric error-message (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the failure's diagnostic string. No I/O; treat it as read-only."))
(defgeneric error-cause (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the original underlying condition, or NIL. No I/O; may be shared."))
(defgeneric error-outcome (condition)
  (:documentation "Return retained COMMAND-OUTCOME evidence, or NIL before one exists.
Inspect dispatch phase and status before deciding how to recover. No I/O."))
(defgeneric error-client (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the connection client associated with the failure, or NIL.
A partially opened client may still own cleanup work; retry CLOSE-CLIENT if
cleanup failed. Reading this slot performs no I/O."))
(defgeneric error-feature (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the unsupported capability's keyword identifier. No I/O."))
(defgeneric error-setting (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the daemon setting that violates a named command contract.
The captured diagnostic value may be shared; treat it as read-only. No I/O."))
(defgeneric error-field (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the requested field key, including an unregistered key. No I/O.
An invalid caller value is retained as supplied; it need not be a keyword."))
(defgeneric error-model (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the captured model keyword implicated in a field failure. No I/O."))
(defgeneric error-target (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the captured target associated with a dispatch refusal, or NIL. No I/O."))

(define-condition libtmux-error (error)
  ((message :initarg :message :initform "Tmux operation failed"
            :reader error-message)
   (cause :initarg :cause :initform nil :reader error-cause)
   (outcome :initarg :outcome :initform nil :reader error-outcome)
   (client :initarg :client :initform nil :reader error-client))
  (:documentation "A library failure with a message, original cause and outcome.")
  (:report (lambda (condition stream)
             (write-string (error-message condition) stream))))

(define-condition invalid-argument (libtmux-error) ()
  (:documentation "An argument violates the operation's declared contract."))
(define-condition unsupported-platform (libtmux-error)
  ((feature :initarg :feature :initform :runtime-profile :reader error-feature))
  (:documentation "The selected runtime lacks a qualified backend or required facility.
ERROR-FEATURE identifies the requirement; ERROR-CAUSE retains a failed probe
when available. OPEN-CLIENT checks the profile before resolving PROGRAM.
See also: OPEN-CLIENT, ERROR-FEATURE, ERROR-CAUSE."))
(define-condition unsupported-tmux (libtmux-error) ()
  (:documentation "The selected tmux does not meet the supported version floor."))
(define-condition unsupported-capability (libtmux-error)
  ((feature :initarg :feature :reader error-feature)
   (required-version :initarg :required-version)
   (actual-version :initarg :actual-version))
  (:documentation "The live daemon does not support the requested operation contract."))

(defun error-required-version (condition)
  "Return an owned copy of the capability's minimum tmux release."
  (copy-seq (slot-value condition 'required-version)))

(defun error-actual-version (condition)
  "Return an owned copy of the live daemon release that failed the capability check."
  (copy-seq (slot-value condition 'actual-version)))
(define-condition unsupported-configuration (libtmux-error)
  ((setting :initarg :setting :initform nil :reader error-setting)
   (commands :initarg :commands :initform nil))
  (:documentation "Daemon configuration overrides a required built-in command contract."))

(defun error-commands (condition)
  "Return an owned vector of command spellings implicated in the configuration failure."
