(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defun owned-configuration-names (names &key environment)
  "Copy at most 4096 finite whole names; never intern supplied text."
  (cond ((and (vectorp names) (not (stringp names)))
         (when (> (length names) 4096) (invalid-argument "At most 4096 configuration names are allowed")))
        ((listp names)
         (loop for tail = names then (cdr tail) for count from 0
               while tail
               do (unless (and (consp tail) (< count 4096))
                    (invalid-argument "Configuration names must be a finite list of at most 4096 names"))))
        (t (invalid-argument "Configuration names must be a list or vector")))
  (map 'simple-vector
       (lambda (name)
         (unless (and (stringp name) (<= 1 (length name) 1048576))
           (invalid-argument "Configuration names must be nonempty bounded strings"))
         (let ((name (text-argument name "Configuration name" nil)))
           (when (find (if environment #\= #\[) name)
             (invalid-argument (if environment "Environment names cannot contain ="
                                  "Whole option names cannot contain [ element syntax")))
           (when (> (length (encode-utf8 name)) 1048576)
             (invalid-argument "Configuration name exceeds its UTF-8 byte limit"))
           name))
       names))

(defun ordinary-configuration-input (bytes failed stamp budget)
  "Append an internal codec boundary; charge only acquired bytes to its ledger."
  (let ((tail (encode-utf8 (format nil "%~A ~D 0 0~%" (if failed "error" "end") stamp))))
    (incf (configuration-decode-budget-remaining-bytes budget) (length tail))
    (concatenate '(vector (unsigned-byte 8)) bytes tail)))

(defun decode-ordinary-option (bytes catalog name scope &key failed hooks-only
                               (budget (make-configuration-decode-budget))
                               (value-limit 1048576))
  "Decode one complete ordinary payload; the appended token is not a server frame."
  (let ((wire (ordinary-configuration-input bytes failed 0 budget)))
    (multiple-value-bind (state value offset)
        (decode-configuration-option-leaf wire catalog name scope 0 0
          :hooks-only hooks-only :budget budget :value-limit value-limit)
      (unless (= offset (length wire)) (malformed-configuration))
      (values state value))))

(defun decode-ordinary-environment (bytes name &key failed (profile :direct)
                                    (budget (make-configuration-decode-budget))
                                    (value-limit 1048576))
  "Decode a complete ordinary environment payload without a name/end collision."
  (let* ((name (encode-utf8 name))
         (check (make-configuration-input (octet-vector nil) 0 0 budget))
         (stamp (if (configuration-name-overlaps-end-p check name profile (format nil "%end 0 0 0~%")) 1 0))
         (wire (ordinary-configuration-input bytes failed stamp budget)))
    (multiple-value-bind (state value offset)
        (decode-configuration-environment-leaf wire name stamp 0
          :profile profile :budget budget :value-limit value-limit)
      (unless (= offset (length wire)) (malformed-configuration))
      (values state value))))

(defstruct configuration-reader
  client token budget decode catalog witness relation active-name active-scope current-outcome
  (outcomes nil) (records nil))

(defparameter *configuration-option-format*
  (format nil "libtmux-option/1~C#{q/a:option_name}~C#{q/a:option_array_key}~C#{option_has_array_key}~C#{option_has_value}~C#{option_is_parent}~C#{option_is_array}~C#{option_is_string}~C#{option_is_hook}~C#{option_is_user}~C#{q/a:option_value}"
          #\Tab #\Tab #\Tab #\Tab #\Tab #\Tab #\Tab #\Tab #\Tab #\Tab))

(defun configuration-reader-check (reader)
  (check-capture-budget (configuration-reader-budget reader) (configuration-reader-token reader)))

(defun configuration-read-one (reader domain scope target name &key hidden hooks-only value-limit)
  "Acquire a known ordinary leaf under the shared owner, retaining its outcome."
  (setf (configuration-reader-active-name reader) name
        (configuration-reader-active-scope reader) scope
        (configuration-reader-current-outcome reader) nil)
  (configuration-reader-check reader)
  (multiple-value-bind (targets flags)
      (if (eq domain :environment) (environment-scope-data scope target)
          (configuration-scope-data scope target))
    (let* ((catalog (configuration-reader-catalog reader))
           (arguments
             (append (list (if (eq domain :environment) "show-environment"
                              (if hooks-only "show-hooks" "show-options"))) flags
                     (when (eq domain :environment) '("-s")) (when hidden '("-h"))
                     (when (and (eq domain :option) (option-catalog-formatted-p catalog))
                       (list "-F" *configuration-option-format*))
                     (list "--" (literal-format name))))
           (relation (configuration-reader-relation reader)))
      (when relation
        (destructuring-bind (pane window) relation
          (setf arguments (list "if-shell" "-F" "-t" (libtmux:id pane)
                                (format-equal "window_id" (libtmux:id window))
                                (tmux-command-text arguments) "libtmux-internal-read-target-refused"))))
      (let* ((budget (configuration-reader-budget reader))
             (remaining (capture-budget-remaining budget))
             (encoded (check-command-envelope
                       (guarded-read-command (configuration-reader-witness reader) targets arguments)))
             (outcome (progn
                        (unless (plusp remaining)
                          (error 'libtmux:output-limit-exceeded :message "Configuration acquisition exhausted its byte budget"))
                        (charge-capture-outcome
                         budget (execute-tmux (configuration-reader-client reader) encoded
                                  (configuration-reader-token reader)
                                  (max 0 (- (capture-budget-deadline budget) (monotonic-seconds)))
                                  remaining nil))))
             (stdout (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::stdout))
             (stderr (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::stderr))
             (finished (and (eq (libtmux:outcome-phase outcome) :exited)
                            (member (libtmux:outcome-status outcome) '(:succeeded :failed))
                            (member (libtmux:outcome-exit-code outcome) '(0 1))
                            (null (libtmux:outcome-reason outcome))))
             (missing (and finished (= 1 (libtmux:outcome-exit-code outcome))
                           (zerop (length stdout))
                           (equalp stderr (encode-utf8
                                          (format nil "~A~A~%" (if (eq domain :environment)
                                                                  "unknown variable: " "invalid option: ") name))))))
        (push outcome (configuration-reader-outcomes reader))
        (setf (configuration-reader-current-outcome reader) outcome)
        (unless (and finished (or missing (plusp (length stdout))
                                 (and (eq (libtmux:outcome-status outcome) :succeeded) (zerop (length stderr)))))
          (check-outcome outcome)
          (error 'libtmux:command-failed :outcome outcome :message "Configuration read produced unexpected diagnostics"))
        (multiple-value-bind (state value)
            (let ((bytes (if missing stderr stdout)))
              (if (eq domain :environment)
                  (decode-ordinary-environment bytes name :failed missing
                    :profile (configuration-option-profile catalog) :budget (configuration-reader-decode reader)
                    :value-limit value-limit)
                  (decode-ordinary-option bytes catalog name scope :failed missing :hooks-only hooks-only
                    :budget (configuration-reader-decode reader) :value-limit value-limit)))
          (setf (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::value)
                (owned-data (append (list :name name :scope scope :target-id (and target (libtmux:id target))
                                         :state state :value value)
                                    (when (eq domain :environment) (list :hidden-p hidden))))
                (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::present-p) t)
          (unless missing
            (check-outcome outcome)
            (when (plusp (length stderr))
              (error 'libtmux:command-failed :outcome outcome :message "Configuration read produced unexpected diagnostics")))
          (values state value))))))

(defun configuration-layers (scope target inherited)
  (let ((local (list scope target)))
    (cons local
          (when inherited
            (case scope
              (:session (list (list :global-session nil)))
              (:window (list (list :global-window nil)))
              (:pane (list (list :window (libtmux:window target)) (list :global-window nil))))))))

(defun configuration-option-record (reader scope target spec inherited hooks-only value-limit)
  (let* ((name (option-spec-name spec))
         (layers (configuration-layers scope target inherited)))
    (loop repeat 3
          do (setf (configuration-reader-relation reader) nil)
             (let ((shadowed nil) (source nil) (value nil) (changed nil))
               (loop for tail on layers for (table entity) = (car tail)
                     do (when (and (eq scope :pane) (not (eq table :pane)))
                          (setf (configuration-reader-relation reader) (list target (libtmux:window target))))
                        (multiple-value-bind (state observed)
                            (configuration-read-one reader :option table entity name :hooks-only hooks-only :value-limit value-limit)
                          (when (eq state :present) (setf source (car tail) value observed) (return))
                          (when (cdr tail) (push (car tail) shadowed))))
               (dolist (layer (reverse shadowed))
                 (when (eq :present (configuration-read-one reader :option (first layer) (second layer) name
                                    :hooks-only hooks-only :value-limit value-limit))
                   (setf changed t)))
               (unless changed
                 (return-from configuration-option-record
                   (list :name (copy-seq name) :scope scope :target-id (and target (libtmux:id target))
                         :version (copy-seq (option-catalog-version (configuration-reader-catalog reader)))
                         :type (option-spec-kind spec) :array-p (not (null (option-spec-array-p spec)))
                         :present-p (not (null source)) :value value :source-scope (first source)
                         :source-target-id (and (second source) (libtmux:id (second source)))
                         :inherited-p (and source (not (eq (first source) scope)))))))
          finally (error 'libtmux:incomplete-snapshot :message "Configuration inheritance changed during acquisition"))))

(defun configuration-environment-record (reader scope target name value-limit)
  (loop repeat 3
        do (multiple-value-bind (state value)
               (configuration-read-one reader :environment scope target name :value-limit value-limit)
             (let ((hidden nil))
               (when (eq state :empty)
                 (setf hidden t)
                 (multiple-value-setq (state value)
                   (configuration-read-one reader :environment scope target name :hidden t :value-limit value-limit)))
               (when (or (member state '(:present :removed)) (and (eq state :missing) (not hidden)))
                 (return-from configuration-environment-record
                   (append (list :name (copy-seq name) :scope scope :target-id (and target (libtmux:id target))
                                 :version (copy-seq (option-catalog-version (configuration-reader-catalog reader)))
                                 :state (if (eq state :missing) :absent state) :value value)
                           (unless (eq state :missing) (list :hidden-p hidden)))))))
        finally (error 'libtmux:incomplete-snapshot :message "Environment visibility changed during acquisition")))

(defun acquire-configuration (client domain scope target names names-p inherited hooks-only
                             cancel-token timeout output-limit record-limit value-limit &key key key-p)
  (check-type client libtmux:client)
  (if (eq domain :environment) (environment-scope-data scope target)
      (progn
        (when (and hooks-only (eq scope :server)) (invalid-argument "Hooks have no server table"))
        (configuration-scope-data scope target)))
  (unless (and (typep record-limit '(integer 1 100000)) (typep value-limit '(integer 0 1048576)))
    (invalid-argument "Configuration limits require 1..100000 records and 0..1048576 value bytes"))
  (when (and (eq domain :environment) (not names-p))
    (invalid-argument "Decoded environment reads require explicit :names"))
  (when names-p (setf names (owned-configuration-names names :environment (eq domain :environment))))
  (when key-p
    (unless (or (integerp key) (and (stringp key) (<= 1 (length key) 1048576)))
      (invalid-argument "Array key must be an integer or nonempty bounded string"))
    (when (stringp key)
      (setf key (text-argument key "Array key" nil))
      (when (> (length (encode-utf8 key)) 1048576)
        (invalid-argument "Array key exceeds its UTF-8 byte limit"))))
  (when cancel-token (check-type cancel-token libtmux:cancellation-token))
  (setf timeout (or timeout (slot-value client 'libtmux::timeout))
        output-limit (or output-limit (slot-value client 'libtmux::output-limit)))
  (check-limits timeout output-limit)
  (when (and names-p (zerop (length names)))
    (return-from acquire-configuration (values (make-array 0) (make-array 0) nil)))
  (call-with-operation
   client cancel-token
   (lambda (token)
     (let* ((start (monotonic-seconds))
            (budget (make-capture-budget :start start :deadline (+ start timeout) :remaining output-limit
                                         :row-limit 100000 :field-limit 1048576))
            (reader (make-configuration-reader :client client :token token :budget budget :active-scope scope
                      :decode (make-configuration-decode-budget :remaining-bytes output-limit
                                :remaining-records record-limit :check (lambda () (check-capture-budget budget token))))))
       (handler-case
           (let* ((current (preflight-targets client (and target (list target)) token budget))
                  (target (first current))
                  (witness (slot-value client 'libtmux::witness))
                  (*command-socket-path* (server-witness-endpoint witness))
                  (catalog (configuration-catalog (server-witness-version witness)))
                  (specs nil) (selected-key nil))
             (setf (configuration-reader-witness reader) witness (configuration-reader-catalog reader) catalog)
             (unless names-p
               (setf names (coerce (loop for spec across (option-catalog-options catalog)
                                        when (and (member scope (option-spec-scopes spec))
                                                  (if hooks-only (option-spec-hook-p spec) (not (option-spec-hook-p spec))))
                                          collect (copy-seq (option-spec-name spec))) 'simple-vector)))
             (when (eq domain :option)
               (setf specs (map 'vector (lambda (name)
                                         (setf (configuration-reader-active-name reader) name)
                                         (configuration-reader-check reader)
                                         (catalog-option catalog name scope :hooks-only hooks-only)) names))
               (when key-p
                 (unless (option-spec-array-p (aref specs 0)) (invalid-argument "The requested option is not an array"))
                 (let ((normalized (normalize-option-key catalog key)))
                   (setf selected-key (if (integerp normalized) (write-to-string normalized :base 10 :radix nil) normalized)))))
             (loop for name across names for index from 0
                   do (setf (configuration-reader-active-name reader) name
                            (configuration-reader-active-scope reader) scope
                            (configuration-reader-current-outcome reader) nil)
                      (configuration-reader-check reader)
                      (push (if (eq domain :environment)
                                (configuration-environment-record reader scope target name value-limit)
                                (configuration-option-record reader scope target (aref specs index) inherited hooks-only value-limit))
                            (configuration-reader-records reader)))
             (values (coerce (reverse (configuration-reader-records reader)) 'simple-vector)
                     (coerce (reverse (configuration-reader-outcomes reader)) 'simple-vector) selected-key))
         (error (cause)
           (let ((outcome (or (and (typep cause 'libtmux:libtmux-error) (libtmux:error-outcome cause))
                              (configuration-reader-current-outcome reader))))
             (when (and outcome (not (member outcome (configuration-reader-outcomes reader))))
               (push outcome (configuration-reader-outcomes reader)))
             (error 'libtmux:configuration-read-failed :client client :cause cause :outcome outcome
                    :name (and (configuration-reader-active-name reader) (copy-seq (configuration-reader-active-name reader)))
                    :scope (configuration-reader-active-scope reader)
                    :records (owned-data (coerce (reverse (configuration-reader-records reader)) 'vector))
                    :outcomes (coerce (reverse (configuration-reader-outcomes reader)) 'vector)
                    :message (format nil "Configuration acquisition failed: ~A" cause)))))))))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(define-condition configuration-read-failed (command-failed)
  ((records :initarg :records :initform #()) (outcomes :initarg :outcomes :initform #())
   (name :initarg :name :initform nil) (scope :initarg :scope :initform nil))
  (:documentation "A decoded acquisition failed, retaining prior records and native outcomes.
ERROR-CAUSE identifies the failure. ERROR-OUTCOME retains cause-associated or current
leaf evidence, possibly NIL before the associated read. Its status can be success
when decoding or diagnostics failed. No transport failure becomes absence.
No mutation is retried.
See also: CONFIGURATION-PARTIAL-RECORDS, CONFIGURATION-READ-OUTCOMES,
CONFIGURATION-ERROR-NAME, CONFIGURATION-ERROR-SCOPE, ERROR-CAUSE."))

(defun configuration-error-name (condition)
  "Return the owned active name at failure, or NIL before name resolution. No I/O.
See also: CONFIGURATION-READ-FAILED, CONFIGURATION-ERROR-SCOPE."
  (let ((name (slot-value condition 'name))) (and name (copy-seq name))))

(defun configuration-error-scope (condition)
  "Return the active native table scope at acquisition failure. No I/O.
This may be an ancestor table used for inherited lookup.
See also: CONFIGURATION-ERROR-NAME, CONFIGURATION-READ-FAILED."
  (slot-value condition 'scope))

(defun configuration-partial-records (condition)
  "Return owned copies of records fully resolved before acquisition failed. No I/O.
Inspect CONFIGURATION-READ-OUTCOMES for valid individual observations from a
failing or incomplete name. No partial record proves a complete acquisition.
See also: CONFIGURATION-READ-FAILED, OUTCOME-VALUE."
  (libtmux.internal::owned-data (slot-value condition 'records)))

(defun configuration-read-outcomes (condition)
  "Return a fresh vector of all retained read outcomes, in acquisition order.
Outcome objects retain identity. OUTCOME-VALUE exposes any valid decoded leaf
observation, independently of the native outcome's success status. Preflight
failures can have no selected read outcome. No I/O.
See also: CONFIGURATION-PARTIAL-RECORDS, OUTCOME-VALUE, ERROR-OUTCOME."
  (copy-seq (slot-value condition 'outcomes)))

(defun show-options (client &key scope target (names nil names-p) (include-inherited t)
                                cancel-token timeout output-limit (record-limit 4096) (value-limit 1048576))
  "Acquire decoded options; return owned record and native read-outcome vectors.
SCOPE and TARGET follow SET-OPTION. Omitted NAMES enumerates registered built-in
non-hook names in source order; explicit finite lists/vectors preserve requested
order and duplicates, including user names. At most 4096 names of at most 1 MiB
UTF-8 each are accepted, independently of RECORD-LIMIT. Explicit NIL/#() performs
no I/O after argument validation.
Each plist has :NAME, :SCOPE, :TARGET-ID, :VERSION, :TYPE, :ARRAY-P, :PRESENT-P,
:VALUE, :SOURCE-SCOPE, :SOURCE-TARGET-ID and :INHERITED-P. A present false flag
has NIL value and true presence. Arrays are vectors of (key-text . typed-value)
pairs, including sparse and supported string keys; empty arrays are present.
INCLUDE-INHERITED defaults true: use explicit ancestor tables only after local
absence and recheck every shadowing absence. Observations span an interval,
not a transaction. Read hooks can run again during bounded consistency retries.
One lease, token, deadline and aggregate byte/record budget covers all reads.
RECORD-LIMIT counts decoded rows/negative observations, including rechecks.
VALUE-LIMIT bounds each decoded UTF-8 value. Preparation and cleanup add wall time.
The ordinary printer must match its known schema; unrelated after-read output
signals a decoding failure. This assumes trusted native output, not per-leaf
origin authentication. Raw SHOW-OPTIONS-TEXT preserves unrestricted inspection.
Every requested name has a record even when absent. Read outcomes retain native
failures for expected missing names; this does not prove later hooks succeeded.
Records contain no operational handle; strings/containers own their storage.
See also: SHOW-OPTION, SHOW-HOOKS, SHOW-OPTIONS-TEXT, CONFIGURATION-READ-FAILED."
  (multiple-value-bind (records outcomes)
      (libtmux.internal::acquire-configuration client :option scope target names names-p include-inherited nil
        cancel-token timeout output-limit record-limit value-limit)
    (values records outcomes)))

(defun show-hooks (client &key scope target (names nil names-p) (include-inherited t)
                              cancel-token timeout output-limit (record-limit 4096) (value-limit 1048576))
  "Acquire owned hook records and native read outcomes, following SHOW-OPTIONS.
Omitted NAMES enumerates built-in hooks. Explicit dynamic @ names require a
supporting catalog and remain ordinary strings, without a registration claim.
Builtin command values are inert canonical tmux source. Inspection never requests
set-hook -R; ordinary after-read hooks still apply. :SERVER is unavailable.
No Lisp reader or evaluator parses source.
See also: SHOW-OPTIONS, SHOW-HOOKS-TEXT, SET-HOOK, CONFIGURATION-READ-FAILED."
  (multiple-value-bind (records outcomes)
      (libtmux.internal::acquire-configuration client :option scope target names names-p include-inherited t
        cancel-token timeout output-limit record-limit value-limit)
    (values records outcomes)))

(defun show-option (client name &key scope target (key nil key-p) (include-inherited t)
                               cancel-token timeout output-limit (record-limit 4096) (value-limit 1048576))
  "Acquire one decoded option; return VALUE, PRESENT-P and a read-outcome vector.
False returns NIL,T; absence returns NIL,NIL. KEY selects an entry only after
acquiring a whole named array. A missing key does not fall through a present
local array. Mutable key text is copied before I/O and bounded to 1 MiB UTF-8.
Keys normalize under the exact live catalog before payload reads.
Scopes, limits, inheritance, ownership and failure evidence follow SHOW-OPTIONS.
See also: SHOW-OPTIONS, OUTCOME-VALUE, CONFIGURATION-READ-FAILED."
  (multiple-value-bind (records outcomes normalized)
      (libtmux.internal::acquire-configuration client :option scope target (vector name) t include-inherited nil
        cancel-token timeout output-limit record-limit value-limit :key key :key-p key-p)
    (let ((record (aref records 0)))
      (if key-p
          (let ((entry (and (getf record :present-p)
                            (find normalized (getf record :value) :key #'car :test #'string=))))
            (values (cdr entry) (not (null entry)) outcomes))
          (values (getf record :value) (getf record :present-p) outcomes)))))

(defun show-environment (client &key scope target (names nil names-p)
                                    cancel-token timeout output-limit (record-limit 4096) (value-limit 1048576))
  "Acquire named raw environment entries; return owned record/outcome vectors.
SCOPE is :GLOBAL or :SESSION; session scope requires a captured TARGET. NAMES
is required; explicit NIL/#() performs no I/O. Native names are nonempty UTF-8
without NUL or =, including names outside the mutation identifier grammar.
Each plist has :NAME, :SCOPE, :TARGET-ID, :VERSION, :STATE and :VALUE. States are
:PRESENT, :REMOVED and :ABSENT. Empty strings remain present. Present/removal
records additionally carry explicit :HIDDEN-P; absent records claim no visibility.
Read ordinary visibility first, then hidden only after empty success. Contradictory
views retry under the original limits. This is not a merged child environment.
Shared limits, ordinary-output assumptions and failure evidence follow SHOW-OPTIONS.
See also: SHOW-OPTIONS, SHOW-ENVIRONMENT-TEXT, SET-ENVIRONMENT, CONFIGURATION-READ-FAILED."
  (multiple-value-bind (records outcomes)
      (libtmux.internal::acquire-configuration client :environment scope target names names-p nil nil
        cancel-token timeout output-limit record-limit value-limit)
    (values records outcomes)))

(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defun ascii-letter-p (character)
  (or (char<= #\A character #\Z) (char<= #\a character #\z)))

(defun ascii-digit-p (character)
  (char<= #\0 character #\9))

(defun checked-option-name (name)
  "Own NAME and restrict dynamic names to the reversible public write grammar."
  (let ((name (text-argument name "Option name" nil)))
    (when (char= (char name 0) #\@)
      (unless (and (> (length name) 1)
                   (loop for index from 1 below (length name)
                         for character = (char name index)
                         always (or (ascii-letter-p character)
                                    (ascii-digit-p character)
                                    (find character "_.-"))))
        (invalid-argument
         "User option names must match @[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+")))
    name))

(defun checked-environment-name (name)
  "Own NAME and enforce the public environment mutation grammar."
  (let ((name (text-argument name "Environment name" nil)))
    (unless (and (or (ascii-letter-p (char name 0))
                     (char= #\_ (char name 0)))
                 (loop for index from 1 below (length name)
                       for character = (char name index)
                       always (or (ascii-letter-p character)
                                  (ascii-digit-p character)
                                  (char= #\_ character))))
      (invalid-argument
       "Environment names must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*"))
    name))

(defun configuration-scope-data (scope target)
  "Return guarded targets and tmux flags for one explicit option table."
  (labels ((without-target (flags)
             (when target
               (invalid-argument "Scope ~S does not accept a target" scope))
             (values nil flags))
           (with-target (model flags)
             (unless target
               (invalid-argument "Scope ~S requires a captured ~A target" scope model))
             (let ((id (physical-target target model)))
               (values (list target) (append flags (list "-t" id))))))
    (case scope
      (:server (without-target '("-s")))
      (:global-session (without-target '("-g")))
      (:session (with-target :session nil))
      (:global-window (without-target '("-g" "-w")))
      (:window (with-target :window '("-w")))
      (:pane (with-target :pane '("-p")))
      (otherwise
       (invalid-argument
        "Option scope must be :SERVER, :GLOBAL-SESSION, :SESSION, :GLOBAL-WINDOW, :WINDOW or :PANE")))))

(defun environment-scope-data (scope target)
  "Return guarded targets and tmux flags for one raw environment table."
  (case scope
    (:global
     (when target (invalid-argument "Global environment scope does not accept a target"))
     (values nil '("-g")))
    (:session
     (unless target
       (invalid-argument "Session environment scope requires a captured session target"))
     (values (list target) (list "-t" (physical-target target :session))))
    (otherwise
     (invalid-argument "Environment scope must be :GLOBAL or :SESSION"))))

(defun configuration-value-text (spec value format-p)
  "Return one owned tmux value string under SPEC's declared native type."
  (if format-p
      (text-argument value "Option format")
      (let ((value (normalize-option-value spec value)))
        (case (option-spec-kind spec)
          (:number (write-to-string value :base 10 :radix nil))
          (:flag (if value "on" "off"))
          (otherwise value)))))

(defun configuration-option-reference (catalog spec name key key-p)
  "Return a literal option or array-element reference owned by the caller."
  (if key-p
      (progn
        (unless (option-spec-array-p spec)
          (invalid-argument "Option ~A is not an array" (option-spec-name spec)))
        (let ((key (normalize-option-key catalog key)))
          (when (and (stringp key) (find #\] key))
            (invalid-argument "Array keys cannot contain ] in tmux option syntax"))
          (literal-format
           (format nil "~A[~A]" name
                   (if (integerp key)
                       (write-to-string key :base 10 :radix nil)
                       key)))))
      (literal-format name)))

(defun configuration-mutation-builder (command scope scope-flags name value value-p
                                       key key-p format-p append hooks-only unset-p
                                       &key only-if-unset)
  "Build one mutation from the exact live daemon catalog selected by preflight."
  (lambda (witness current)
    (declare (ignore current))
    (let* ((catalog (configuration-catalog (server-witness-version witness)))
           (spec (catalog-option catalog name scope :hooks-only hooks-only))
           (reference (configuration-option-reference
                       catalog spec (option-spec-name spec) key key-p)))
      (when (and (not hooks-only) (option-spec-hook-p spec))
        (invalid-argument "Use SET-HOOK or UNSET-HOOK for hook option ~A" name))
      (when (and append
                 (not (or (eq (option-spec-kind spec) :string)
                          (and (option-spec-array-p spec) (not key-p)))))
        (invalid-argument
         "Option ~A does not support append for this scalar or keyed array value"
         name))
      (append (list command)
              scope-flags
              (when only-if-unset '("-o"))
              (when append '("-a"))
              (when format-p '("-F"))
              (when unset-p '("-u"))
              (list "--" reference)
              (when value-p
                (list (if hooks-only
                          (text-argument value "Hook command source")
                          (configuration-value-text spec value format-p))))))))

(defun mutate-configuration (client command name value value-p scope target key key-p
                            format-p append hooks-only unset-p options &key only-if-unset)
  "Validate local authority, then defer schema selection to the live witness."
  (let ((name (checked-option-name name)))
    (multiple-value-bind (targets flags) (configuration-scope-data scope target)
      (apply #'perform-command client targets (list command name)
             :argument-builder
             (configuration-mutation-builder command scope flags name value value-p
                                             key key-p format-p append hooks-only unset-p
                                             :only-if-unset only-if-unset)
             options))))

(defun environment-mutation-builder (flags name value value-p format-p hidden mode)
  "Build one literal environment mutation; MODE is :SET, :UNSET or :REMOVE."
  (lambda (witness current)
    (declare (ignore witness current))
    (append '("set-environment") flags
            (when format-p '("-F"))
            (when hidden '("-h"))
            (ecase mode (:set nil) (:unset '("-u")) (:remove '("-r")))
            (list "--" name)
            (when value-p (list (text-argument value "Environment value"))))))

(defun mutate-environment (client name value value-p scope target format-p hidden mode options)
  "Validate a raw environment table mutation and dispatch it once."
  (let ((name (checked-environment-name name)))
    (when (and (not (eq mode :set)) (or value-p format-p hidden))
      (invalid-argument "Unset/remove environment operations do not accept value flags"))
    (multiple-value-bind (targets flags) (environment-scope-data scope target)
      (apply #'perform-command client targets (list "set-environment" name)
             :argument-builder
             (environment-mutation-builder flags name value value-p format-p hidden mode)
             options))))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun set-option (client name value &key scope target (key nil key-p) format-p append only-if-unset
                                          cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Set one typed tmux option and return its COMMAND-OUTCOME.
SCOPE is required and names one explicit table: :SERVER, :GLOBAL-SESSION,
:SESSION, :GLOBAL-WINDOW, :WINDOW or :PANE. Local scopes require a captured
TARGET of the matching type; global scopes reject one. NAME is resolved in the
exact live daemon catalog. Native numbers, Booleans and choices are validated
before payload dispatch. User names must match @[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+ and remain
strings. KEY addresses a registered array element. FORMAT-P treats VALUE as an
explicit tmux format; otherwise VALUE is literal and typed. APPEND is supported
for strings, keyed string-array elements and unkeyed array assignment. An
unkeyed array VALUE uses that option's native tmux list grammar; use KEY when
VALUE must remain one literal element. ONLY-IF-UNSET requests tmux -o: write
only when the option, or the selected array key, is absent from the local table.
Inherited values permit a local write; present false and empty values refuse
replacement. Refusal retains normal condition/outcome evidence through
ERROR-OUTCOME. The condition applies to this command; later commands and hooks
remain independent. Use UNSET-OPTION to remove state and SET-HOOK for registered
hooks. Never retries or acquires a replacement capture.
See also: ERROR-OUTCOME, SET-HOOK, UNSET-OPTION."
  (libtmux.internal::mutate-configuration
   client "set-option" name value t scope target key key-p format-p append nil nil
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)
   :only-if-unset only-if-unset))

(defun unset-option (client name &key scope target (key nil key-p)
                                    cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Remove one local option or array entry and return its COMMAND-OUTCOME.
SCOPE/TARGET and KEY follow SET-OPTION. The exact live catalog validates the
name, table and array shape before payload dispatch. Tmux's native unset/default
behavior applies; inherited state is not silently materialized. See SET-OPTION
for setting and scope rules. Never retries.
See also: SET-OPTION."
  (libtmux.internal::mutate-configuration
   client "set-option" name nil nil scope target key key-p nil nil nil t
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun set-hook (client name command-source &key scope target (key nil key-p) append
                                                 cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Install tmux COMMAND-SOURCE for one registered hook and return an outcome.
SCOPE/TARGET follow SET-OPTION. COMMAND-SOURCE is explicit tmux command
language, not Lisp code; this function neither reads nor executes it locally.
KEY selects one hook-array entry. APPEND applies to an unkeyed hook assignment;
tmux does not append command source within a keyed hook entry. The ordinary
install path never uses set-hook -R, but tmux may still run a registered native
after-hook such as `after-set-hook` as a consequence of this set-hook command.
Dynamic @ event sources require a live catalog that supports them. SET-OPTION
rejects registered hooks; use UNSET-HOOK to remove this state. Never retries.
See also: SET-OPTION, UNSET-HOOK."
  (libtmux.internal::mutate-configuration
   client "set-hook" name command-source t scope target key key-p nil append t nil
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun unset-hook (client name &key scope target (key nil key-p)
                                  cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Remove one registered hook or hook-array entry and return its outcome.
SCOPE/TARGET and KEY follow SET-HOOK. The ordinary path never uses set-hook -R,
but tmux may run a remaining native after-hook as a consequence of this
set-hook command. The operation does not retry and validates the exact live
catalog before payload dispatch.
See also: SET-HOOK."
  (libtmux.internal::mutate-configuration
   client "set-hook" name nil nil scope target key key-p nil nil t t
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun set-environment (client name value &key scope target format-p hidden
                                           cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Set one raw tmux environment entry and return its COMMAND-OUTCOME.
SCOPE is required: :GLOBAL rejects TARGET; :SESSION requires a captured session.
NAME must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. VALUE is literal unless FORMAT-P
explicitly requests tmux format expansion. HIDDEN sets tmux's hidden flag.
This mutates one raw table, not an effective merged child environment. Never
retries or refreshes captured observations. See UNSET-ENVIRONMENT for deletion
and REMOVE-ENVIRONMENT for an explicit tombstone.
See also: REMOVE-ENVIRONMENT, UNSET-ENVIRONMENT."
  (libtmux.internal::mutate-environment
   client name value t scope target format-p hidden :set
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun unset-environment (client name &key scope target cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Delete NAME from one raw tmux environment table and return its outcome.
SCOPE/TARGET follow SET-ENVIRONMENT. Absence remains tmux's native idempotent
unset behavior. This is distinct from REMOVE-ENVIRONMENT's tombstone; use
SET-ENVIRONMENT to store a present value.
See also: REMOVE-ENVIRONMENT, SET-ENVIRONMENT."
  (libtmux.internal::mutate-environment
   client name nil nil scope target nil nil :unset
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun remove-environment (client name &key scope target cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Store tmux's removal marker for NAME and return its COMMAND-OUTCOME.
SCOPE/TARGET follow SET-ENVIRONMENT. A removal marker is distinct from absence
and from a present empty string. UNSET-ENVIRONMENT deletes the entry instead.
Never retries the mutation.
See also: SET-ENVIRONMENT, UNSET-ENVIRONMENT."
  (libtmux.internal::mutate-environment
   client name nil nil scope target nil nil :remove
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun show-options-text (client &key scope target name include-inherited include-hooks value-only
                                     format cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Inspect an option table; return owned UTF-8 printer text and a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
Required SCOPE and captured TARGET follow SET-OPTION. They select native flags;
tmux can infer a built-in's table from NAME instead. NAME is a literal option
reference with native abbreviation/array syntax; omission lists the table.
INCLUDE-INHERITED uses -A, which does not promise inherited user @ options in a
whole-table listing. INCLUDE-HOOKS uses -H and VALUE-ONLY uses -v.

FORMAT is explicit tmux format source, requires live tmux 3.8, and has no
implicit time expansion. #() can start asynchronous command-client jobs; their
results can be incomplete and disconnect cleans them up. Omission uses native
printer syntax. Escaping, whitespace and ordinary hook output remain text;
this does not decode values or prove presence, provenance or completeness.
Blocks under shared preflight/dispatch limits, starts no daemon and never
retries. Missing names remain errors with retained outcomes. Invalid UTF-8
signals DECODING-ERROR with the client and outcome.
See also: SHOW-HOOKS-TEXT, SHOW-ENVIRONMENT-TEXT, SET-OPTION, ERROR-OUTCOME."
  (multiple-value-bind (targets flags) (libtmux.internal::configuration-scope-data scope target)
    (libtmux.internal::printed-command
     client (append '("show-options") flags
                    (when include-inherited '("-A"))
                    (when include-hooks '("-H"))
                    (when value-only '("-v"))
                    (when format (list "-F" (libtmux.internal::text-argument format "Option format")))
                    (when name
                      (list "--" (libtmux.internal::literal-format
                                  (libtmux.internal::text-argument name "Option reference" nil)))))
     :targets targets :minimum-version (when format "3.8") :feature :option-listing-format
     :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun show-hooks-text (client &key scope target name format monitors cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Inspect native hooks; return owned UTF-8 printer text and a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
SCOPE/TARGET follow SET-HOOK; :SERVER is unavailable because show-hooks has no
server-table flag. NAME is a literal native reference; omission lists hooks.
Tmux can infer a built-in's table from NAME. A named ordinary @ option can
also be printed; that success does not prove event registration.

FORMAT is explicit tmux format source with no implicit time expansion.
MONITORS selects native monitor presentation (-B). Both require live tmux 3.8.
#() in FORMAT can start command-client jobs with incomplete results and cleanup
on disconnect. Native escaping, whitespace and ordinary hook output remain
printer text, not a decoded or replayable configuration. No -R is invoked.
Blocks under shared preflight/dispatch limits, starts no daemon and never
retries. Missing names and decoding/resource failures retain outcome evidence.
See also: SHOW-OPTIONS-TEXT, SET-HOOK, UNSET-HOOK, ERROR-OUTCOME."
  (when (eq scope :server)
    (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "show-hooks has no server-table flag"))
  (multiple-value-bind (targets flags) (libtmux.internal::configuration-scope-data scope target)
    (libtmux.internal::printed-command
     client (append '("show-hooks") flags
                    (when monitors '("-B"))
                    (when format (list "-F" (libtmux.internal::text-argument format "Hook format")))
                    (when name
                      (list "--" (libtmux.internal::literal-format
                                  (libtmux.internal::text-argument name "Hook reference" nil)))))
     :targets targets :minimum-version (when (or format monitors) "3.8")
     :feature (if monitors :hook-monitor-listing :hook-listing-format)
     :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun show-environment-text (client &key scope target name hidden shell-format
                                         cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Inspect a raw environment table; return owned UTF-8 text and a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
Required SCOPE is :GLOBAL or :SESSION; a session needs a captured TARGET.
NAME is literal nonempty text without NUL or =, including names outside the
mutation identifier grammar. Omission lists the table. HIDDEN selects hidden
entries; NIL selects ordinary entries. A visibility mismatch can return empty
text, which does not prove absence. Empty values, removal markers and native
escaping remain printer syntax. Session output is not a merged child environment.

SHELL-FORMAT selects native shell-looking presentation (-s); returned text is
never evaluated or executed. Ordinary hook output is preserved. This is not a
decoded environment mapping. Blocks under shared preflight/dispatch limits,
starts no daemon and never retries. Missing names remain errors; operational,
resource and UTF-8 failures retain client/outcome diagnostics.
See also: SHOW-OPTIONS-TEXT, SET-ENVIRONMENT, REMOVE-ENVIRONMENT, ERROR-OUTCOME."
  (when name
    (setf name (libtmux.internal::text-argument name "Environment name" nil))
    (when (find #\= name)
      (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Environment names cannot contain =")))
  (multiple-value-bind (targets flags) (libtmux.internal::environment-scope-data scope target)
    (libtmux.internal::printed-command
     client (append '("show-environment") flags
                    (when hidden '("-h"))
                    (when shell-format '("-s"))
                    (when name (list "--" name)))
     :targets targets :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defpackage #:libtmux.control
  (:use #:cl)
  (:export #:connection #:request #:connection-error #:connection-start-failed
           #:connection-cleanup-failed #:connection-closed #:connection-busy
           #:error-connection #:open-connection #:close-connection #:with-connection
           #:connection-state #:connection-failure #:connection-cleanup-failures
           #:pending-cleanups #:submit-command #:await-request #:request-state
           #:cancel-request #:next-event #:reconnect #:with-reconnection #:connection-stale)
  (:documentation "Persistent native tmux commands and bounded byte events.
Load the optional LIBTMUX/CONTROL system. The qualified backend requires the
core SBCL/Linux profile and an actual tmux daemon >=3.8. Connections own a
worker and process independently of their originating LIBTMUX:CLIENT.
Submission is nonblocking; waits use condition notifications. One worker
serializes requests and reads all protocol data. No application callback
runs in that worker. Commands use tmux argv, not shell source.
Results and events own their mutable bytes and containers. A completed
command queue does not establish application readiness. No automatic replay
or reconnect occurs. Explicit RECONNECT renews the original core client's
generation and returns fresh observations.
See also: WITH-CONNECTION, WITH-RECONNECTION, SUBMIT-COMMAND, NEXT-EVENT."))

(in-package #:libtmux.control)

(defclass connection ()
  ((peer :initarg :peer :reader %peer)
   (cleanup-failures :initform nil))
  (:documentation "An owned persistent tmux connection with one protocol worker.
Use WITH-CONNECTION or CLOSE-CONNECTION to release it. Closing the originating
core client does not close this resource. Captured core observations remain
separate; raw control commands do not refresh them. RECONNECT requires that
original core client to remain open.
See also: OPEN-CONNECTION, RECONNECT, CONNECTION-STATE, PENDING-CLEANUPS."))

(defclass request ()
  ((handle :initarg :handle :reader %handle))
  (:documentation "One queued command and its retained dispatch/result evidence.
Keep this handle to await or cancel work. A wait timeout leaves it live.
See also: SUBMIT-COMMAND, AWAIT-REQUEST, CANCEL-REQUEST."))

(defgeneric error-connection (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the retained connection implicated in a CONNECTION-ERROR. No I/O.
See also: CLOSE-CONNECTION, LIBTMUX:ERROR-CAUSE."))

(define-condition connection-error (libtmux:libtmux-error)
  ((connection :initarg :connection :reader error-connection))
  (:documentation "A control failure retaining its connection and original cause.
See also: ERROR-CONNECTION, LIBTMUX:ERROR-CAUSE."))

(define-condition connection-start-failed (connection-error libtmux:command-failed) ()
  (:documentation "Startup failed after allocating a connection resource.
ERROR-CONNECTION retains the resource even if cleanup also failed. Core
argument and unsupported-capability errors before allocation stay core types.
See also: OPEN-CONNECTION, CLOSE-CONNECTION, PENDING-CLEANUPS."))

(define-condition connection-cleanup-failed (connection-error libtmux:cleanup-failed) ()
  (:documentation "Closing failed; retry CLOSE-CONNECTION on ERROR-CONNECTION.
The resource remains discoverable through PENDING-CLEANUPS. No mutation is
replayed. See also: CONNECTION-CLEANUP-FAILURES, LIBTMUX:ERROR-CAUSE."))

(define-condition connection-closed (connection-error libtmux:client-closed) ()
  (:documentation "Submission attempted on a closing or closed connection.
See also: CONNECTION-STATE, SUBMIT-COMMAND."))

(define-condition connection-busy (connection-error libtmux:client-busy) ()
  (:documentation "The bounded request queue, including active work, is full.
Submission did not dispatch this command. See also: SUBMIT-COMMAND."))

(define-condition connection-stale (connection-error libtmux:stale-target) ()
  (:documentation "The original control client generation, daemon or session changed.
ERROR-CONNECTION and LIBTMUX:ERROR-TARGET retain the old public connection.
Acquire fresh observations and use OPEN-CONNECTION explicitly; stale authority
cannot authorize reconnection to a replacement target. No request is replayed.
See also: RECONNECT, LIBTMUX:ERROR-CAUSE, LIBTMUX:STALE-TARGET."))

(defun %connection-for-peer (peer)
  (libtmux.internal::with-control-lock
   peer (lambda ()
          (or (libtmux.internal::control-peer-api-object peer)
              (setf (libtmux.internal::control-peer-api-object peer)
                    (make-instance 'connection :peer peer))))))

(defun open-connection (client session &key (timeout 30) (request-limit 16)
                                          (event-limit 256) (event-byte-limit 4194304)
                                          (reply-byte-limit 1048576))
  "Attach a separate owned control connection to a captured SESSION.
CLIENT supplies the core endpoint and authority. Startup preflights the target
and requires the live daemon to be >=3.8. TIMEOUT bounds startup admission and
supervised execution; platform preparation and cleanup add caller wall time.
REQUEST-LIMIT includes active and queued work. Events drop oldest entries at
EVENT-LIMIT or EVENT-BYTE-LIMIT and report loss. REPLY-BYTE-LIMIT bounds each
request's retained output; overflow closes the connection with a cause.
This call blocks until ready or failed. All limits must be positive integers
except the nonnegative real TIMEOUT. No daemon is started or terminated.
Attachment preserves the stored session environment; native attach hooks and
server lifecycle policies still apply. Readiness checks the observed daemon
witness after attachment, so a refused candidate may have appeared briefly.
See also: WITH-CONNECTION, RECONNECT, CLOSE-CONNECTION, SUBMIT-COMMAND, NEXT-EVENT."
  (handler-case
      (%connection-for-peer
       (libtmux.internal::start-control-peer client session :timeout timeout
         :request-limit request-limit :event-limit event-limit
         :event-byte-limit event-byte-limit :reply-byte-limit reply-byte-limit))
    (libtmux.internal::control-start-failed (condition)
      (error 'connection-start-failed
             :connection (%connection-for-peer (libtmux.internal::failed-control-peer condition))
             :cause condition :message "Control startup failed; inspect the cause and retained connection"))))

(defun connection-state (connection)
  "Return :STARTING, :READY, :CLOSING or :CLOSED without I/O.
This is an observation, not a lease for subsequent submission.
See also: SUBMIT-COMMAND, CONNECTION-FAILURE."
  (check-type connection connection)
  (libtmux.internal::with-control-lock
   (%peer connection) (lambda () (libtmux.internal::control-peer-state (%peer connection)))))

(defun connection-failure (connection)
  "Return the retained worker failure condition, or NIL, without I/O.
Conditions retain identity; byte data comes from NEXT-EVENT or AWAIT-REQUEST.
See also: CONNECTION-STATE, CONNECTION-CLEANUP-FAILURES."
  (check-type connection connection)
  (libtmux.internal::with-control-lock
   (%peer connection) (lambda () (libtmux.internal::control-peer-failure (%peer connection)))))

(defun connection-cleanup-failures (connection)
  "Return a fresh vector of the last 16 close failures, newest first. No I/O.
Condition objects are retained by identity. WITH-CONNECTION records secondary
cleanup failures while preserving an existing body error or nonlocal exit.
See also: CLOSE-CONNECTION, PENDING-CLEANUPS."
  (check-type connection connection)
  (libtmux.internal::with-control-lock
   (%peer connection) (lambda () (coerce (slot-value connection 'cleanup-failures) 'vector))))

(defun pending-cleanups ()
  "Return a fresh vector of connections retaining failed cleanup work. No I/O.
Retry CLOSE-CONNECTION explicitly. Successful close removes the entry.
See also: CONNECTION-CLEANUP-FAILED, ERROR-CONNECTION."
  (let ((peers (libtmux.internal::call-with-lock
                libtmux.internal::*pending-control-lock*
                (lambda () (copy-list libtmux.internal::*pending-control-peers*)))))
    (map 'vector #'%connection-for-peer peers)))

(defun %record-cleanup-failure (connection condition)
  (handler-case
      (libtmux.internal::with-control-lock
       (%peer connection)
       (lambda ()
         (unless (eq condition (first (slot-value connection 'cleanup-failures)))
           (setf (slot-value connection 'cleanup-failures)
                 (subseq (cons condition (slot-value connection 'cleanup-failures))
                         0 (min 16 (1+ (length (slot-value connection 'cleanup-failures)))))))))
    (serious-condition () nil)))

(defgeneric close-connection (connection)
  (:documentation "Close this connection's worker and process; return NIL after cleanup.
Leave the tmux daemon running. Concurrent closes serialize; repeated successful
close is harmless. In-flight results retain partial output and dispatch state.
Cleanup can add time beyond request deadlines. Failure signals
CONNECTION-CLEANUP-FAILED and retains this resource for explicit retry.
See also: WITH-CONNECTION, PENDING-CLEANUPS, CONNECTION-CLEANUP-FAILURES."))

(defmethod close-connection ((connection connection))
  (handler-case (libtmux.internal::close-control-peer (%peer connection))
    (error (cause)
      (let ((condition (make-condition 'connection-cleanup-failed
                        :connection connection :resource connection :cause cause
                        :message "Control cleanup failed; retry closing the retained connection")))
        (%record-cleanup-failure connection condition)
        (error condition)))))

(defun reconnect (connection &key (timeout 30)
                                 (request-limit nil request-limit-p)
                                 (event-limit nil event-limit-p)
                                 (event-byte-limit nil event-byte-limit-p)
                                 (reply-byte-limit nil reply-byte-limit-p))
  "Retire CONNECTION and return a fresh connection and complete snapshot.
Use the original core client and exact session ID. The client must remain open
in the original generation. Explicitly supplied limits must be positive integers;
omitted queue/reply limits inherit the old connection. TIMEOUT is nonnegative
real seconds shared across preflight, retirement, recapture and startup;
preparation and cleanup can add wall time. Capture output shares the core
client's output budget. Concurrent core work signals LIBTMUX:CLIENT-BUSY.
Preflight refusal leaves a live old connection alone. After successful close,
renew the core generation even if later work fails. Every earlier core capture
from that client becomes stale for operations, while local data remains usable.
The returned snapshot precedes new attachment; it does not include that new
frontend. A closing/closed old resource remains reconnectable with valid origin.
Old requests/results/events stay on the retired resource. Pending work is closed,
never replayed; dispatched effects can remain uncertain. Other separately owned
control resources remain independent. No event continuity or replay is implied.
The CLOSE-CONNECTION generic runs on the caller thread; its failures are retained.
CONNECTION-STALE refuses changed origin/session/daemon. Old cleanup failures
retain the old resource; startup failures retain the new candidate through
CONNECTION-START-FAILED. After failed cutover, acquire/select and open anew.
Use WITH-RECONNECTION or close the returned resource explicitly.
See also: WITH-RECONNECTION, CONNECTION-STALE, CLOSE-CONNECTION, AWAIT-REQUEST."
  (check-type connection connection)
  (let ((peer (%peer connection)))
    (handler-case
        (multiple-value-bind (replacement capture)
            (libtmux.internal::reconnect-control-peer peer :timeout timeout
              :close-function (lambda ()
                                (handler-case (close-connection connection)
                                  (error (cause)
                                    (libtmux.internal::retain-control-peer peer)
                                    (%record-cleanup-failure connection cause)
                                    (error cause))))
              :request-limit (if request-limit-p request-limit (libtmux.internal::control-peer-request-limit peer))
              :event-limit (if event-limit-p event-limit (libtmux.internal::control-peer-event-limit peer))
              :event-byte-limit (if event-byte-limit-p event-byte-limit (libtmux.internal::control-peer-event-byte-limit peer))
              :reply-byte-limit (if reply-byte-limit-p reply-byte-limit (libtmux.internal::control-peer-reply-byte-limit peer)))
          (values (%connection-for-peer replacement) capture))
      (libtmux.internal::control-origin-stale (cause)
        (error 'connection-stale :connection connection :target connection
               :client (libtmux:error-client cause) :cause cause :message (libtmux:error-message cause)))
      (libtmux.internal::control-start-failed (cause)
        (error 'connection-start-failed
               :connection (%connection-for-peer (libtmux.internal::failed-control-peer cause))
               :cause cause :message "Reconnection startup failed; inspect the new candidate and original cause"))
      (libtmux:cleanup-failed (cause)
        (unless (eq peer (slot-value cause 'libtmux::resource)) (error cause))
        (let ((condition (make-condition 'connection-cleanup-failed
                          :connection connection :resource connection :cause cause
                          :message "Old control cleanup failed; retry closing the retained connection")))
          (%record-cleanup-failure connection condition)
          (error condition))))))

(defun %call-with-connection-scope (connection body)
  (let ((completed nil))
    (unwind-protect
         (multiple-value-prog1 (funcall body connection) (setf completed t))
      (handler-case (close-connection connection)
        (error (condition)
          (%record-cleanup-failure connection condition)
          (when completed (error condition)))))))

(defmacro with-connection ((name client session &rest options) &body body)
  "Bind NAME to a control connection and close the original resource on exit.
Evaluate CLIENT, SESSION and OPEN-CONNECTION options once. BODY accepts
declarations and returns all its values. Rebinding NAME cannot redirect cleanup.
After normal return, propagate cleanup failure; during an error or nonlocal
exit, preserve that exit and record cleanup failure on the connection.
See also: OPEN-CONNECTION, CLOSE-CONNECTION, CONNECTION-CLEANUP-FAILURES."
  (let ((resource (gensym "CONNECTION")))
    `(let ((,resource (open-connection ,client ,session ,@options)))
       (%call-with-connection-scope ,resource (lambda (,name) ,@body)))))

(defmacro with-reconnection ((name snapshot previous &rest options) &body body)
  "Bind a fresh NAME and SNAPSHOT from explicit RECONNECT; close NAME on exit.
Evaluate PREVIOUS and options once. BODY permits declarations and returns all
values. Rebinding either visible name cannot redirect cleanup. Preserve primary
errors/nonlocal exits and record secondary cleanup errors on the new connection.
The previous resource retains its own old results and events.
See also: RECONNECT, WITH-CONNECTION, CONNECTION-CLEANUP-FAILURES."
  (let ((resource (gensym "CONNECTION")) (capture (gensym "SNAPSHOT")) (ignored (gensym "RESOURCE")))
    `(multiple-value-bind (,resource ,capture) (reconnect ,previous ,@options)
       (%call-with-connection-scope
        ,resource (lambda (,ignored)
                    (declare (ignore ,ignored))
                    (funcall (lambda (,name ,snapshot) ,@body) ,resource ,capture))))))

(defun submit-command (connection argv &key effect (timeout 30))
  "Queue copied tmux ARGV and return a REQUEST without waiting for its reply.
EFFECT must explicitly be :READ or :MUTATION; it records caller intent, not a
command restriction. TIMEOUT is a nonnegative real deadline budget starting at
submission, including queue time. A zero budget can expire before dispatch.
Commands execute serially. Full queues signal CONNECTION-BUSY; closing ones
signal CONNECTION-CLOSED. Use argv for tmux syntax, not shell interpolation.
This raw path does not validate or refresh captured operational targets.
See also: AWAIT-REQUEST, CANCEL-REQUEST, REQUEST-STATE."
  (check-type connection connection)
  (handler-case
      (make-instance 'request :handle
        (libtmux.internal::submit-control-command (%peer connection) argv :effect effect :timeout timeout))
    (libtmux:client-busy (cause)
      (error 'connection-busy :connection connection :cause cause :message "Control request queue is full"))
    (libtmux:client-closed (cause)
      (error 'connection-closed :connection connection :cause cause :message "Control connection is closed"))))

(defun request-state (request)
  "Return retained request state without I/O.
States are :QUEUED, :WRITING, :RUNNING, :COMPLETED, :FAILED, :TIMED-OUT,
:CANCELLED and :CLOSED. A terminal result is never replaced by cancellation.
See also: AWAIT-REQUEST, CANCEL-REQUEST."
  (check-type request request)
  (let ((handle (%handle request)))
    (libtmux.internal::with-control-lock
     (libtmux.internal::control-request-peer handle)
     (lambda () (libtmux.internal::control-request-state handle)))))

(defun await-request (request &key (timeout 30))
  "Wait for owned result/:READY, or return NIL/:TIMEOUT without cancelling.
TIMEOUT is nonnegative real seconds or NIL for an unbounded wait. Zero polls.
The result plist contains :STATUS, :OUTPUT bytes, :WIRE-TAIL bytes,
:TRUNCATED-P, :EFFECT, :DISPATCHED-P, :REASON and :REPLY-COUNT. Wire tail is
unterminated protocol data, not decoded output. Positive stdin progress makes
DISPATCHED-P true conservatively, even for an incomplete line. A dispatched
failed/cancelled/timed-out/closed request may have effects; never infer rollback.
COMPLETED means the command queue reached its marker, not application readiness.
Only framed replies enter OUTPUT; unframed lines remain notification events.
Repeated awaits return fresh byte storage. No exception hides a terminal result.
See also: SUBMIT-COMMAND, CANCEL-REQUEST, NEXT-EVENT."
  (check-type request request)
  (libtmux.internal::await-control-request (%handle request) :timeout timeout))

(defun cancel-request (request)
  "Request cancellation; return true only when this call changes live work.
Queued work is removed without dispatch or connection closure. Active work
closes its connection and retires unissued queued requests. The worker records
write progress before publishing :CANCELLED; await it to inspect that evidence.
Cancellation winning before completion preserves :CANCELLED; an already terminal
request is unchanged. No command is replayed and dispatched effects are not undone.
See also: AWAIT-REQUEST, REQUEST-STATE, CLOSE-CONNECTION."
  (check-type request request)
  (libtmux.internal::cancel-control-request (%handle request)))

(defun next-event (connection &key (timeout 30))
  "Wait for an owned event/:READY or NIL/:TIMEOUT on this connection.
TIMEOUT is nonnegative real seconds or NIL; zero polls. :OUTPUT has :PANE,
:AGE, :EXTENDED-P and :DATA octets, preserving invalid UTF-8. :NOTIFICATION
contains a raw line without LF in :DATA, preserving unknown labels and bytes.
Native %exit is a notification; transport end is reported independently.
Unsolicited :REPLY also has :FAILED-P.
:GAP reports :EVENTS and :BYTES dropped from the bounded queue. An oversized
new event reports loss without discarding retained smaller events.
Local loss does not pause tmux. Native pause/continue notices remain raw
notifications and are distinct from local :GAP delivery.
:END follows retained events, with :REASON, :EXIT-CODE, :DIAGNOSTICS bytes,
:WIRE-TAIL bytes and :CAUSE. After end, repeated reads return end immediately.
Causes retain condition identity. No application callback executes in the reader.
See also: OPEN-CONNECTION, AWAIT-REQUEST, CONNECTION-FAILURE."
  (check-type connection connection)
  (libtmux.internal::next-control-event (%peer connection) :timeout timeout))

(defmethod print-object ((object connection) stream)
  (print-unreadable-object (object stream :type t :identity t)
    (write (connection-state object) :stream stream)))

(defmethod print-object ((object request) stream)
  (print-unreadable-object (object stream :type t :identity t)
    (write (request-state object) :stream stream)))

(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defun creation-options (cwd environment command shell-command command-p shell-command-p)
  (append (when cwd (list "-c" (literal-format (text-argument cwd "Working directory" nil))))
          (environment-arguments environment) '("--")
          (pane-command-arguments command shell-command :command-p command-p :shell-command-p shell-command-p)))

(defun observe-created (model)
  (lambda (outcome capture)
    (let* ((text (outcome-text outcome))
           (field (ecase model (:session :session/id) (:window :window/id) (:pane :pane/id))))
      (unless (and (plusp (length text)) (char= #\Newline (char text (1- (length text)))))
        (error 'libtmux:decoding-error :outcome outcome :message "Creation did not return one entity ID"))
      (let* ((id (decode-scalar (registered-field field model) (subseq text 0 (1- (length text)))))
             (entity (find id (captured-collection capture model) :key #'libtmux:id :test #'equal)))
        (unless entity
          (error 'libtmux:stale-target :outcome outcome
                 :message "Creation succeeded but the resulting entity is no longer present"))
        (values entity t)))))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun new-window (client session &key name index cwd environment
                                      (command nil command-p) (shell-command nil shell-command-p)
                                      (detached t) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Create a physical window in captured SESSION and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
NAME and CWD are literal strings. INDEX chooses a free link index; omission uses
tmux's next available index. DETACHED defaults true. ENVIRONMENT is a list/vector
of (name . value) string pairs. COMMAND is nonempty argv; SHELL-COMMAND is a
separate, mutually exclusive shell string. Omit both for tmux's default shell.
OUTCOME-VALUE supplies the resulting window; observation failure is separate.
Never replaces an occupied index or retries a mutation. Limits cover all I/O."
  (let ((target (libtmux.internal::physical-target session :session)))
    (libtmux.internal::perform-command
     client (list session)
     (append (list "new-window" "-P" "-F" "#{window_id}" "-t"
                   (concatenate 'string target ":"
                                (if index (libtmux.internal::integer-argument index 0 2147483647 "Window index") "")))
             (when detached '("-d"))
             (when name (list "-n" (libtmux.internal::literal-format name)))
             (libtmux.internal::creation-options cwd environment command shell-command command-p shell-command-p))
     :observe (libtmux.internal::observe-created :window)
     :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun split-pane (client pane &key (direction :vertical) size percent before full-size
                                   cwd environment (detached t)
                                   (command nil command-p) (shell-command nil shell-command-p)
                                   cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Split captured PANE and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME with the created pane.
DIRECTION is :HORIZONTAL (left/right) or :VERTICAL (top/bottom). SIZE is a
positive cell count; PERCENT is 1 through 100, mutually exclusive with SIZE.
BEFORE places the pane before its target; FULL-SIZE spans the whole window.
DETACHED defaults true. CWD, ENVIRONMENT, COMMAND and SHELL-COMMAND follow
NEW-WINDOW. Failed acquisition after successful creation is retained separately.
Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition; never retries the mutation."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client (list pane)
   (append (list "split-window" "-P" "-F" "#{pane_id}" "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target pane :pane))
           (libtmux.internal::split-flags direction size percent before full-size detached)
           (libtmux.internal::creation-options cwd environment command shell-command command-p shell-command-p))
   :observe (libtmux.internal::observe-created :pane)
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun new-session (client &key name window-name width height cwd environment
                               (command nil command-p) (shell-command nil shell-command-p)
                               cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Create a detached session on the selected live daemon; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
NAME, WINDOW-NAME and CWD are literal. WIDTH/HEIGHT are positive initial cell
dimensions through 65535. ENVIRONMENT, COMMAND and SHELL-COMMAND follow
NEW-WINDOW. OUTCOME-VALUE supplies the created session; acquisition failure is
retained separately. This operation requires an existing daemon and never
silently starts or replaces one.
See also: START-DAEMON, WITH-DAEMON, NEW-WINDOW."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client nil
   (append '("new-session" "-d" "-P" "-F" "#{session_id}")
           (when name (list "-s" (libtmux.internal::literal-format name)))
           (when window-name (list "-n" (libtmux.internal::literal-format window-name)))
           (when width (list "-x" (libtmux.internal::integer-argument width 1 65535 "Width")))
           (when height (list "-y" (libtmux.internal::integer-argument height 1 65535 "Height")))
           (libtmux.internal::creation-options cwd environment command shell-command command-p shell-command-p))
   :observe (libtmux.internal::observe-created :session)
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))
