(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defun rename-entity (client target model text format-p observe options)
  (apply #'perform-command client (list target)
         (list (ecase model (:session "rename-session") (:window "rename-window"))
               "-t" (physical-target target model) "--"
               (if format-p (text-argument text "Name format") (literal-format text)))
         :observe (when observe (observe-target client target)) options))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun rename-window (client window text &key format-p (observe t) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Rename the selected physical WINDOW and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
TEXT is literal by default; FORMAT-P explicitly enables tmux format expansion.
Tmux may normalize or reject names. OBSERVE acquires a replacement in
OUTCOME-VALUE; a failed follow-up stays in OUTCOME-OBSERVATION-ERROR without
erasing successful mutation. Earlier observations are unchanged. Signals
STALE-TARGET or an operational condition. Never retries the mutation."
  (libtmux.internal::rename-entity client window :window text format-p observe
                                  (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun rename-session (client session text &key format-p (observe t) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Rename SESSION with literal TEXT, or an explicit FORMAT-P expression.
Return a COMMAND-OUTCOME. OBSERVE defaults true and supplies a replacement
through OUTCOME-VALUE; observation failure is retained separately. Tmux enforces
session-name restrictions and uniqueness. Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational
condition. Timeout and byte limits cover preflight, mutation and observation."
  (libtmux.internal::rename-entity client session :session text format-p observe
                                  (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun select-window (client link &key (observe t) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Select a captured window LINK within its session; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
The expected session/index/window mapping is checked before dispatch. OBSERVE
supplies a replacement link through OUTCOME-VALUE. A moved or replaced mapping
signals STALE-TARGET; external failures retain their command outcome."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client (list link) (list "select-window" "-t" (libtmux.internal::link-target link))
   :observe (when observe (libtmux.internal::observe-target client link))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun select-pane (client pane &key (observe t) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Select PANE within its physical window; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
OBSERVE supplies a replacement pane through OUTCOME-VALUE. Captured getters
stay local and unchanged. Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client (list pane) (list "select-pane" "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target pane :pane))
   :observe (when observe (libtmux.internal::observe-target client pane))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun capture-pane-bytes (client pane &key start end join-lines escape-sequences
                                          escape-controls alternate pending-output
                                          cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Read PANE now; return owned output octets and the diagnostic command outcome.
START/END accept signed line numbers or :ALL for the corresponding history edge.
JOIN-LINES joins wrapped rows; ESCAPE-SEQUENCES retains terminal styles;
ESCAPE-CONTROLS asks tmux to render controls as octal; ALTERNATE selects its
alternate screen; PENDING-OUTPUT requests tmux's pending input bytes. Tmux owns
these capture modes and may reject unavailable combinations. Does not decode or
trim bytes. Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition with its outcome."
  (let ((arguments (list "capture-pane" "-p" "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target pane :pane))))
    (loop for value in (list join-lines escape-sequences escape-controls alternate pending-output)
          for flag in '("-J" "-e" "-C" "-a" "-P")
          when value do (setf arguments (append arguments (list flag))))
    (loop for value in (list start end) for flag in '("-S" "-E")
          when value do (setf arguments
                              (append arguments (list flag (if (eq value :all) "-"
                                                               (libtmux.internal::integer-argument
                                                                value (- 2147483647) 2147483647 "Line"))))))
    (let ((outcome (libtmux.internal::perform-command
                    client (list pane) arguments :cancel-token cancel-token
                    :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))
      (values (outcome-stdout outcome) outcome))))

(defun capture-pane (client pane &rest options)
  "Read PANE now; return strict UTF-8 text and the diagnostic command outcome.
Preserve whitespace and trailing lines.
OPTIONS are the CAPTURE-PANE-BYTES options. Invalid UTF-8 signals DECODING-ERROR;
call CAPTURE-PANE-BYTES when byte preservation is required."
  (multiple-value-bind (bytes outcome) (apply #'capture-pane-bytes client pane options)
    (handler-bind ((decoding-error (lambda (condition)
                                    (setf (slot-value condition 'outcome) outcome
                                          (slot-value condition 'client) client))))
      (values (libtmux.internal::strict-text bytes) outcome))))

(defpackage #:libtmux
  (:use #:cl)
  (:documentation "Native Common Lisp captured tmux graphs and explicit external operations.
OPEN-CLIENT/WITH-CLIENT establish connection scopes without starting a daemon.
FETCH-SNAPSHOT acquires sessions, physical windows, panes, window links and
attached clients. Captured getters, traversal and ENTITY-DATA are local and
remain usable after closure; captured strings and containers are owned copies. REFRESH returns
a new observation. Named mutators take CLIENT first and return COMMAND-OUTCOME;
OUTCOME-VALUE and FIELD-VALUE return value and presence as two values.
Operations are synchronous, bounded and cancellable, with one active operation
per client. Typed LIBTMUX-ERROR conditions retain diagnostic outcome and cause.
Closing a client releases owned resources and leaves the daemon alive.
START-DAEMON/WITH-DAEMON separately own a new empty-config foreground daemon;
STOP-DAEMON releases that owner, with incomplete cleanup retained for retry.
See docs/index.md for the tutorial, API reference and current capability limits.")
  (:export
   #:libtmux-error #:error-message #:error-cause #:error-outcome #:error-client
   #:invalid-argument #:unsupported-platform #:unsupported-tmux
   #:unsupported-configuration #:error-setting #:error-commands
   #:unsupported-capability #:error-feature #:error-required-version #:error-actual-version
   #:show-options #:show-option #:show-hooks #:show-environment
   #:configuration-read-failed #:configuration-partial-records #:configuration-read-outcomes
   #:configuration-error-name #:configuration-error-scope
   #:show-options-text #:show-hooks-text #:show-environment-text
   #:client-closed #:client-busy #:cleanup-failed #:command-failed
   #:outcome-unknown #:command-cancelled #:deadline-exceeded
   #:output-limit-exceeded #:decoding-error
   #:incomplete-snapshot #:field-unavailable #:error-field #:error-model
   #:stale-target #:error-target
   #:snapshot #:entity #:session #:window #:pane #:window-link #:attached-client
   #:entity-model #:field-value #:entity-data #:id #:provenance #:same-entity-p
   #:sessions #:windows #:panes #:window-links #:clients
   #:name #:active-p #:width #:height #:index #:current-command #:current-path #:title #:dead-p
   #:fetch-snapshot #:fetch-sessions #:fetch-windows #:fetch-panes #:fetch-clients #:refresh
   #:rename-window #:rename-session #:select-window #:select-pane #:capture-pane #:capture-pane-bytes
   #:new-session #:new-window #:split-pane
   #:send-text #:send-keys #:send-prefix #:clear-history #:copy-mode
   #:respawn-pane #:respawn-window #:pipe-pane
   #:switch-client #:detach-client #:refresh-client #:suspend-client #:lock-client
   #:wait-for #:lock-session #:lock-server #:display-message
   #:server-access #:list-server-access
   #:list-commands #:list-keys #:bind-key #:unbind-key
   #:resize-pane #:resize-window #:select-layout #:next-layout #:previous-layout
   #:next-window #:previous-window #:last-window #:last-pane
   #:link-window #:unlink-window #:move-window #:swap-windows
   #:move-pane #:join-pane #:break-pane #:swap-panes #:rotate-window
   #:list-buffers #:set-buffer #:show-buffer #:load-buffer #:save-buffer #:paste-buffer #:delete-buffer
   #:set-option #:unset-option #:set-hook #:unset-hook
   #:set-environment #:unset-environment #:remove-environment
   #:kill-pane #:kill-window #:kill-session #:kill-server
   #:command-outcome #:outcome-status #:outcome-phase #:outcome-arguments
   #:outcome-stdout #:outcome-stderr #:outcome-exit-code #:outcome-reason
   #:outcome-elapsed #:outcome-value #:outcome-observation-error
   #:outcome-cleanup-failures
   #:cancellation-token #:make-cancellation-token #:cancel #:cancelled-p
   #:client #:open-client #:close-client #:with-client #:client-open-p
   #:client-cleanup-failures #:tmux-version #:run-command
   #:daemon #:start-daemon #:stop-daemon #:with-daemon #:daemon-state
   #:daemon-program #:daemon-socket-path #:daemon-failure #:daemon-cleanup-failures
   #:pending-daemon-cleanups #:daemon-start-failed #:daemon-cleanup-failed #:error-daemon))

(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defun observed-link (capture session-id index window-id)
  (or (find (list session-id index window-id) (captured-collection capture :window-link)
            :key #'libtmux:id :test #'equal)
      (error 'libtmux:stale-target :message "The resulting window link is no longer present")))

(defun relocate-link (client source session index command detached observe options)
  (let ((source-target (link-target source))
        (destination (session-index-target session index))
        (expected-window (third (libtmux:id source))))
    (apply #'perform-command client (list source session)
           (append (list command "-s" source-target "-t" destination) (when detached '("-d")))
           :observe (when observe
                      (lambda (outcome capture)
                        (declare (ignore outcome))
                        (values (observed-link capture (libtmux:id session) index expected-window) t)))
           options)))

(defun relocate-pane (client source destination command direction size percent before full-size detached observe options)
  (apply #'perform-command client (list source destination)
         (append (list command "-s" (physical-target source :pane)
                       "-t" (physical-target destination :pane))
                 (split-flags direction size percent before full-size detached))
         :observe (when observe (observe-target client source)) options))

(defun break-pane-command (witness arguments pane-id name)
  ;; tmux 3.7 inverted its new-window naming branch (fixed in 3.7a).
  ;; Decide from live pane count: the single-pane move has different semantics.
  (if (string= "3.7" (server-witness-version witness))
      (list "if-shell" "-F" "-t" pane-id "#{==:#{window_panes},1}"
            (tmux-command-text arguments)
            (tmux-command-list
             (append (list (if name arguments
                               (append arguments '("-n" "libtmux-break-pane"))))
                     (when name
                       (list (list "rename-window" "-t" pane-id (literal-format name)))))))
      arguments))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun link-window (client source-link session index &key (detached t) (observe t)
                                                         cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Link SOURCE-LINK's physical window into SESSION at the free INDEX.
Return a COMMAND-OUTCOME with the new window link when OBSERVE is true.
SOURCE-LINK preserves the source session context, including tmux group rules.
DETACHED defaults true. Never overwrites an occupied index. Signals STALE-TARGET
or an operational condition; observation failure is retained separately."
  (libtmux.internal::relocate-link
   client source-link session index "link-window" detached observe
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun move-window (client source-link session index &key (detached t) (observe t)
                                                         cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Move SOURCE-LINK into SESSION at the free INDEX; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
Other links to the physical window survive. Removing a session's last link can
destroy that session, following tmux semantics. OBSERVE supplies the destination
link. DETACHED defaults true; occupied indexes are never overwritten. Signals
STALE-TARGET or an operational condition; older link observations stay unchanged."
  (libtmux.internal::relocate-link
   client source-link session index "move-window" detached observe
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun unlink-window (client link &key kill-if-last cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Remove the captured LINK and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME without a value.
Tmux refuses the last reference unless KILL-IF-LAST is explicit; group membership
affects that check. Removing a last link can destroy its window and session.
Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition. Does not refresh a deleted link."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client (list link)
   (append (list "unlink-window" "-t" (libtmux.internal::link-target link))
           (when kill-if-last '("-k")))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun swap-windows (client first-link second-link &key select (observe t)
                                                       cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Swap physical windows at two captured links; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
OBSERVE supplies a fresh vector of replacement links in argument order. SELECT
selects the affected indexes in their sessions; omission keeps current indexes.
Tmux group restrictions apply. Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition;
old links retain their original expected window IDs."
  (let ((first-target (libtmux.internal::link-target first-link))
        (second-target (libtmux.internal::link-target second-link))
        (first-id (id first-link)) (second-id (id second-link)))
    (libtmux.internal::perform-command
     client (list first-link second-link)
     (append (list "swap-window" "-s" first-target "-t" second-target) (when select '("-d")))
     :observe (when observe
                (lambda (outcome capture)
                  (declare (ignore outcome))
                  (values (vector (libtmux.internal::observed-link
                                   capture (first first-id) (second first-id) (third second-id))
                                  (libtmux.internal::observed-link
                                   capture (first second-id) (second second-id) (third first-id))) t)))
     :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun move-pane (client source destination &key (direction :vertical) size percent before full-size
                                                (detached t) (observe t) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Move SOURCE pane beside DESTINATION; return an outcome with the moved pane.
DIRECTION is :HORIZONTAL or :VERTICAL. SIZE is cells; PERCENT is 1..100,
mutually exclusive with SIZE. BEFORE changes placement and FULL-SIZE spans the
window. Percent sizing retains tmux's version semantics: with FULL-SIZE, 3.3a
uses destination-pane dimensions and 3.8 uses whole-window dimensions. Use SIZE
for cell-based control. DETACHED defaults true.
An emptied source window is destroyed, including all its links. With DETACHED
false, tmux chooses the session context of the physical destination. OBSERVE
supplies a replacement source pane; its old observation retains its old window.
Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition."
  (libtmux.internal::relocate-pane
   client source destination "move-pane" direction size percent before full-size detached observe
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun join-pane (client source destination &key (direction :vertical) size percent before full-size
                                                (detached t) (observe t) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Join SOURCE pane beside DESTINATION using tmux's join-pane command.
Arguments, outcomes, emptied-window effects and observation semantics match
MOVE-PANE. Both targets are captured physical panes. Signals STALE-TARGET or an
operational condition; a failed follow-up is distinct from mutation failure."
  (libtmux.internal::relocate-pane
   client source destination "join-pane" direction size percent before full-size detached observe
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun break-pane (client pane source-link session index &key name (detached t) (observe t)
                                                            cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Break PANE from SOURCE-LINK into SESSION's free INDEX; return an outcome.
SOURCE-LINK fixes the session context when breaking the window's only pane;
tmux moves that link instead of creating another physical window. NAME is
literal. DETACHED defaults true. OBSERVE supplies the destination window link.
On tmux 3.7, a new named window requires a following RENAME-WINDOW in the same
guarded request; its configured hooks can run. Failure can leave the pane moved.
The pane keeps its identity. Signals INVALID-ARGUMENT, STALE-TARGET or an
operational condition. Occupied indexes are never overwritten."
  (let ((pane-id (libtmux.internal::physical-target pane :pane))
        (source (libtmux.internal::link-target source-link))
        (destination (libtmux.internal::session-index-target session index))
        (name (when name (libtmux.internal::text-argument name "Window name"))))
    (unless (same-entity-p (window pane) (window source-link))
      (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Pane and source link must refer to the same captured physical window"))
    (let ((arguments
            (append (list "break-pane" "-s" (concatenate 'string source "." pane-id) "-t" destination)
                    (when detached '("-d")) (when name (list "-n" name)))))
      (libtmux.internal::perform-command
       client (list pane source-link session) arguments
       :argument-builder (lambda (witness current)
                           (declare (ignore current))
                           (libtmux.internal::break-pane-command witness arguments pane-id name))
       :observe (when observe
                  (lambda (outcome capture)
                    (declare (ignore outcome))
                    (let ((moved (libtmux.internal::resolve-observation client pane capture)))
                      (values (libtmux.internal::observed-link capture (id session) index (id (window moved))) t))))
       :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))))

(defun swap-panes (client first-pane second-pane &key (detached t) preserve-zoom (observe t)
                                                     cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Swap two physical panes; return an outcome with replacements in a fresh vector.
The vector follows argument order. DETACHED defaults true; tmux still adjusts
active-pane references when panes change windows. PRESERVE-ZOOM restores zoom.
Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition. Earlier captures stay local
and unchanged; observation failure is retained separately."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client (list first-pane second-pane)
   (append (list "swap-pane" "-s" (libtmux.internal::physical-target first-pane :pane)
                 "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target second-pane :pane))
           (when detached '("-d")) (when preserve-zoom '("-Z")))
   :observe (when observe
              (lambda (outcome capture)
                (declare (ignore outcome))
                (values (vector (libtmux.internal::resolve-observation client first-pane capture)
                                (libtmux.internal::resolve-observation client second-pane capture)) t)))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun rotate-window (client window &key (direction :up) preserve-zoom (observe t)
                                        cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Rotate WINDOW's pane positions :UP or :DOWN; return an outcome and replacement.
Tmux also advances the active pane. PRESERVE-ZOOM restores zoom after rotating.
Signals INVALID-ARGUMENT, STALE-TARGET or an operational condition. Captured
pane order remains unchanged in earlier observations."
  (libtmux.internal::operate-on-target
   client window :window "rotate-window"
   (append (list (case direction (:up "-U") (:down "-D")
                   (otherwise (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Rotate direction must be :up or :down"))))
           (when preserve-zoom '("-Z")))
   observe (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defun respawn-entity (client target model kill cwd environment command shell-command
                      command-p shell-command-p observe options)
  (apply #'perform-command client (list target)
         (append (list (ecase model (:window "respawn-window") (:pane "respawn-pane"))
                       "-t" (physical-target target model))
                 (when kill '("-k"))
                 (creation-options cwd environment command shell-command command-p shell-command-p))
         :observe (when observe (observe-target client target)) options))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun respawn-pane (client pane &key kill cwd environment (observe t)
                                    (command nil command-p) (shell-command nil shell-command-p)
                                    cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Restart PANE's process and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
KILL explicitly replaces a running process; otherwise tmux requires it to have
exited. Omit COMMAND and SHELL-COMMAND to reuse the previous command. Explicit
argv, shell text, literal CWD and ENVIRONMENT follow NEW-WINDOW. OBSERVE returns
a replacement pane through OUTCOME-VALUE; its earlier capture stays unchanged.
The process may exit before observation. Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational
condition; never retries an uncertain restart."
  (libtmux.internal::respawn-entity
   client pane :pane kill cwd environment command shell-command command-p shell-command-p observe
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun respawn-window (client window &key kill cwd environment (observe t)
                                        (command nil command-p) (shell-command nil shell-command-p)
                                        cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Restart WINDOW as one pane and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
KILL explicitly replaces running processes. Tmux retains its first pane and
destroys every other pane in the physical window, including through other links.
Other options follow RESPAWN-PANE. OBSERVE supplies a replacement window without
changing earlier observations. Linked-window session context is selected by tmux.
Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition; never retries the restart."
  (libtmux.internal::respawn-entity
   client window :window kill cwd environment command shell-command command-p shell-command-p observe
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun pipe-pane (client pane &key shell-command format-p (direction :output) toggle
                                 cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Configure PANE's tmux-owned pipe and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
SHELL-COMMAND is shell source, literal to tmux by default; FORMAT-P explicitly
enables tmux format and time expansion before shell execution. DIRECTION is
:OUTPUT (pane to shell), :INPUT (shell to pane), or :BOTH. Omit SHELL-COMMAND,
or pass an empty string, to close the pipe. TOGGLE closes an existing pipe
without starting its replacement. Replacing a pipe closes the previous one.
Completion acknowledges configuration, not shell startup, success or output
consumption. The daemon owns the pipe child; closing CLIENT leaves it running.
Literal commands exceeding tmux's time-format capacity fail before I/O.
Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition; never retries configuration."
  (unless (member direction '(:input :output :both))
    (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Pipe direction must be :input, :output or :both"))
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client (list pane)
   (append (list "pipe-pane" "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target pane :pane))
           (ecase direction (:input '("-I")) (:output '("-O")) (:both '("-I" "-O")))
           (when toggle '("-o"))
           (when shell-command
             (list "--" (if format-p
                            (libtmux.internal::text-argument shell-command "Pipe shell format")
                            (libtmux.internal::literal-time-format shell-command)))))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

src/query.lisp.content:
(defpackage #:libtmux.query
  (:use #:cl)
  (:documentation "Validated native queries over finite captured libtmux observations.
Loading this package adds no transport dependency and performs no tmux I/O.")
  (:export
   #:compiled-filter #:compile-filter #:predicate #:matching
   #:fields #:expression #:required-fields #:required-relations #:explain
   #:query-set #:from #:where #:where-if #:order-by #:items #:query-set-model
   #:one #:one-or-none
   #:invalid-filter #:invalid-query-target #:query-limit-exceeded
   #:no-match #:ambiguous-match
   #:error-path #:error-operator #:error-expected #:error-received
   #:match-count #:count-exact-p #:match-sample))

(in-package #:libtmux.query)

(defgeneric error-path (condition)
  (:documentation "Return a fresh bounded vector locating the invalid query input."))
(defgeneric error-operator (condition)
  (:documentation "Return a bounded invalid-operator summary, or NIL."))
(defgeneric error-expected (condition)
  (:documentation "Return an owned bounded description of the expected query shape or type."))
(defgeneric error-received (condition)
  (:documentation "Return a safe bounded description of the received query value or target."))
(defgeneric match-count (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the known cardinality associated with a selection condition."))
(defgeneric count-exact-p (condition)
  (:documentation "Return true when MATCH-COUNT is exact, false when it is a lower bound."))

(define-condition invalid-filter (libtmux:libtmux-error)
  ((model :initarg :model :reader libtmux:error-model)
   (path :initarg :path :initform #())
   (operator :initarg :operator :initform nil)
   (field :initarg :field :initform nil :reader libtmux:error-field)
   (expected :initarg :expected :initform nil)
   (received :initarg :received :initform nil))
  (:documentation "A declarative filter is malformed, mistyped or exceeds a compile limit."))

(define-condition invalid-query-target (libtmux:libtmux-error)
  ((model :initarg :model :reader libtmux:error-model)
   (received :initarg :received))
  (:documentation "A compiled filter received an object outside its captured root model."))

(defmethod error-path ((condition invalid-filter))
  (copy-seq (slot-value condition 'path)))
(defmethod error-operator ((condition invalid-filter))
  (slot-value condition 'operator))
(defmethod error-expected ((condition invalid-filter))
  (libtmux.internal::owned-data (slot-value condition 'expected)))
(defmethod error-received ((condition invalid-filter))
  (libtmux.internal::owned-data (slot-value condition 'received)))
(defmethod error-received ((condition invalid-query-target))
  (libtmux.internal::owned-data (slot-value condition 'received)))

(define-condition query-limit-exceeded (invalid-filter) ()
  (:documentation "A bounded query compilation, execution or selection exhausted its budget."))

(define-condition no-match (libtmux:libtmux-error)
  ((count :initform 0 :reader match-count)
   (count-exact-p :initform t :reader count-exact-p)
   (sample :initform #()))
  (:documentation "Strict selection received no items."))

(define-condition ambiguous-match (libtmux:libtmux-error)
  ((count :initarg :count :reader match-count)
   (count-exact-p :initarg :count-exact-p :initform t :reader count-exact-p)
   (sample :initarg :sample :initform #()))
  (:documentation "Strict selection received more than one item."))

(defun match-sample (condition)
  "Return a fresh bounded vector of safe selected-item summaries."
  (libtmux.internal::owned-data (slot-value condition 'sample)))

(defstruct (query-node (:constructor make-query-node
                         (operator function &key field descriptor operand children)))
  operator function field descriptor operand children)

(defstruct (execution-context (:constructor make-execution-context (model limit &key checker)))
  model limit (visits 0) checker)

(defun check-execution-interruption (context)
  (let ((checker (execution-context-checker context)))
    (when checker (funcall checker))))

(defun execution-checkpoint (context)
  (when (> (incf (execution-context-visits context))
           (execution-context-limit context))
    (error 'query-limit-exceeded :model (execution-context-model context)
           :received :execution
           :message (format nil "Query execution exceeds ~D expression visits"
                            (execution-context-limit context))))
  (check-execution-interruption context))

(defun evaluate-node (node entity context)
  (execution-checkpoint context)
  (multiple-value-prog1 (funcall (query-node-function node) entity context)
    (check-execution-interruption context)))

(defclass compiled-filter ()
  ((model :initarg :model)
   (expression :initarg :expression)
   (root :initarg :root)
   (required-fields :initarg :required-fields)
   (required-relations :initarg :required-relations)
   (registry-version :initarg :registry-version)
   (limits :initarg :limits)
   (execution-limit :initarg :execution-limit))
  (:documentation "An owned validated expression and reusable local evaluator."))

(defclass query-set ()
  ((contents :initarg :contents)
   (model :initarg :model :initform nil))
  (:documentation "An eager owned local selection with optional captured-model metadata."))

(defconstant +default-max-depth+ 64)
(defconstant +default-max-input-visits+ 10000)
(defconstant +default-max-membership+ 1000)
(defconstant +default-max-string-length+ 65536)
(defconstant +default-max-retained-characters+ 1048576)
(defconstant +default-max-selection-items+ 100000)
(defconstant +default-max-execution-visits+ 1000000)

(defstruct (operator-spec
             (:constructor make-operator-spec
                 (key arity field-kinds stage documentation)))
  key arity field-kinds stage documentation)

(defparameter *operator-specs*
  (map 'simple-vector
       (lambda (entry) (apply #'make-operator-spec entry))
       '((:= 2 (:text :integer :boolean) :scalar "Typed equality")
         (:< 2 (:integer) :scalar "Integer less-than")
         (:<= 2 (:integer) :scalar "Integer less-than or equal")
         (:> 2 (:integer) :scalar "Integer greater-than")
         (:>= 2 (:integer) :scalar "Integer greater-than or equal")
         (:in 2 (:text :integer :boolean) :scalar "Typed finite membership")
         (:contains 2 (:text) :scalar "Case-sensitive substring search")
         (:starts-with 2 (:text) :scalar "Case-sensitive text prefix")
         (:and :variadic () :scalar "Ordered conjunction; empty is true")
         (:or :variadic () :scalar "Ordered disjunction; empty is false")
         (:not 1 () :scalar "Boolean negation")
         (:present 1 (:text :integer :boolean) :scalar "Captured value is present")
         (:missing 1 (:text :integer :boolean) :scalar "Optional captured value is absent")
         (:any 2 (:relation) :relations "A related object matches")
         (:all 2 (:relation) :relations "Every related object matches")
         (:none 2 (:relation) :relations "No related object matches")
         (:is 2 (:relation) :relations "A to-one relation target matches")
         (:regex-search 2 (:text) :regex "CL-PPCRE search")
         (:regex-full-match 2 (:text) :regex "CL-PPCRE full match"))))

(defparameter *operator-registry*
  (let ((registry (make-hash-table :test 'eq)))
    (loop for spec across *operator-specs*
          do (setf (gethash (operator-spec-key spec) registry) spec))
    registry))

(defstruct compile-limits
  max-depth max-input-visits max-membership max-string-length
  max-retained-characters max-execution-visits)

(defvar *compile-path* nil)
(defvar *diagnostic-expected* nil)
(defvar *diagnostic-received* nil)

(defun query-model-class (model)
  (libtmux.internal::entity-model-class model))

(defun safe-designator-summary (value)
  (if (and (keywordp value) (<= (length (symbol-name value)) 64))
      value
      (type-of value)))

(defun fail-filter (model form control &rest arguments)
  (error 'invalid-filter :model (safe-designator-summary model)
         :path (coerce (reverse *compile-path*) 'simple-vector)
         :operator (and (consp form) (safe-designator-summary (first form)))
         :field (and (consp form) (consp (rest form))
                     (safe-designator-summary (second form)))
         :expected *diagnostic-expected*
         :received (or *diagnostic-received* (type-of form))
         :message (apply #'format nil control arguments)))

(defgeneric compile-optional-node
    (operator model form requirements seen relation-requirements relation-seen limits)
  (:documentation "Compile an operator supplied by a separately loaded query system.")
  (:method (operator model form requirements seen
            relation-requirements relation-seen limits)
    (declare (ignore requirements seen relation-requirements relation-seen limits))
    (let ((*diagnostic-expected* :loaded-optional-query-system)
          (*diagnostic-received* operator))
      (fail-filter model form
                   "Operator ~S requires its unloaded optional query system"
                   operator))))

(defun limit-error (model form path control &rest arguments)
  (error 'query-limit-exceeded :model model
         :path (coerce (reverse path) 'simple-vector)
         :received (type-of form)
         :message (apply #'format nil control arguments)))

(defun validated-limit (model value name minimum)
  (unless (and (integerp value) (>= value minimum))
    (error 'invalid-filter :model model :expected `(integer ,minimum *)
           :received (type-of value)
           :message (format nil "~S must be an integer no smaller than ~D" name minimum)))
  value)

(defun validated-owned-form (model form limits)
  (let ((active (make-hash-table :test 'eq))
        (stack (list (list :visit form nil :root 1 nil 0 nil)))
        (root nil)
        (visits 0)
        (pending-visits 1)
        (characters 0))
    (labels ((assign (destination place value)
               (cond ((eq place :root) (setf root value))
                     ((eq place :car) (setf (car destination) value))
                     ((eq place :cdr) (setf (cdr destination) value))
                     ((integerp place) (setf (aref destination place) value))
                     (t (error "Unknown query copy destination"))))
             (visit (value path)
               (when (> (incf visits) (compile-limits-max-input-visits limits))
                 (limit-error model value path "Filter exceeds ~D input visits"
                              (compile-limits-max-input-visits limits))))
             (reserve-visits (count value path)
               (when (> (+ visits pending-visits count)
                        (compile-limits-max-input-visits limits))
                 (limit-error model value path "Filter exceeds ~D input visits"
                              (compile-limits-max-input-visits limits)))
               (incf pending-visits count))
             (enter (value depth path)
               (when (> depth (compile-limits-max-depth limits))
                 (limit-error model value path "Filter exceeds nesting depth ~D"
                              (compile-limits-max-depth limits)))
               (when (gethash value active)
                 (error 'invalid-filter :model model
                        :path (coerce (reverse path) 'simple-vector)
                        :received (type-of value)
                        :message "Filter data contains a cycle"))
               (setf (gethash value active) t)))
      (loop while stack
            for frame = (pop stack)
            do (destructuring-bind (action value destination place depth path position cdr-p)
                   frame
                 (when (eq action :visit) (decf pending-visits))
                 (ecase action
                   (:exit (remhash value active))
                   (:visit
                    (when (and cdr-p (not (or (null value) (consp value))))
                      (error 'invalid-filter :model model
                             :path (coerce (reverse path) 'simple-vector)
                             :received (type-of value)
                             :message "Filter data contains a dotted list"))
                    (visit value path)
                    (typecase value
                      (string
                       (when (> (length value) (compile-limits-max-string-length limits))
                         (limit-error model value path "String exceeds ~D characters"
                                      (compile-limits-max-string-length limits)))
                       (when (> (incf characters (length value))
                                (compile-limits-max-retained-characters limits))
                         (limit-error model value path
                                      "Filter retains more than ~D text characters"
                                      (compile-limits-max-retained-characters limits)))
                       (assign destination place (copy-seq value)))
                      (cons
                       (enter value depth path)
                       (reserve-visits 2 value path)
                       (let ((copy (cons nil nil)))
                         (assign destination place copy)
                         (push (list :exit value nil nil 0 nil 0 nil) stack)
                         (push (list :visit (cdr value) copy :cdr depth path
                                     (1+ position) t)
                               stack)
                         (push (list :visit (car value) copy :car (1+ depth)
                                     (cons position path) 0 nil)
                               stack)))
                      (vector
                       (enter value depth path)
                       (let ((length (length value)))
                         (reserve-visits length value path)
                         (let ((copy (make-array length)))
                           (assign destination place copy)
                           (push (list :exit value nil nil 0 nil 0 nil) stack)
                           (loop for index downfrom (1- length) to 0
                                 do (push (list :visit (aref value index) copy index
                                                (1+ depth) (cons index path) 0 nil)
                                          stack)))))
                      (t (assign destination place value)))))))
      (values root visits characters))))

(defun checked-field (model key operator)
  (let ((field (gethash key libtmux.internal::*field-registry*)))
    (if (and field (eq model (libtmux.internal::field-spec-model field)))
        field
        (let* ((safe-key (safe-designator-summary key))
               (cause (make-condition
                       'libtmux:field-unavailable :field safe-key :model model
                       :message "Field is not registered for the query model")))
          (error 'invalid-filter :model model :field safe-key
                 :path (coerce (reverse *compile-path*) 'simple-vector)
                 :operator operator
                 :expected :registered-field-for-model
                 :received safe-key :cause cause
                 :message (libtmux:error-message cause))))))

(defun record-requirement (key requirements seen)
  (unless (gethash key seen)
    (setf (gethash key seen) t)
    (vector-push-extend key requirements)))

(defun scalar-equality (kind)
  (ecase kind (:text #'string=) (:integer #'=) (:boolean #'eq)))

(defun normalize-scalar-operand (model form field operand)
  (let ((kind (libtmux.internal::field-spec-kind field))
        (key (libtmux.internal::field-spec-key field)))
    (unless (ecase kind
              (:text (stringp operand))
              (:integer (integerp operand))
              (:boolean (or (eq operand t) (null operand))))
      (let ((*diagnostic-expected* kind)
            (*diagnostic-received* (type-of operand)))
        (fail-filter model form "Operand for ~S must have field type ~S" key kind)))
    operand))

(defun scalar-field (model form operator requirements seen)
  (let* ((key (second form))
         (field (checked-field model key operator))
         (kind (libtmux.internal::field-spec-kind field))
         (spec (gethash operator *operator-registry*)))
    (unless (member kind (operator-spec-field-kinds spec))
      (let ((*diagnostic-expected* (operator-spec-field-kinds spec))
            (*diagnostic-received* kind))
        (fail-filter model form "Operator ~S does not accept ~S field ~S"
                     operator kind key)))
    (record-requirement key requirements seen)
    field))

(defun relation-field (model form operator requirements seen)
  (let* ((key (second form))
         (field (checked-field model key operator))
         (kind (libtmux.internal::field-spec-kind field))
         (cardinality (libtmux.internal::field-spec-cardinality field))
         (expected-cardinality (if (eq operator :is) :one :many)))
    (unless (eq kind :relation)
      (let ((*diagnostic-expected* :relation)
            (*diagnostic-received* kind))
        (fail-filter model form "Operator ~S requires a relation field" operator)))
    (unless (eq cardinality expected-cardinality)
      (let ((*diagnostic-expected* expected-cardinality)
            (*diagnostic-received* cardinality))
        (fail-filter model form "Operator ~S requires a ~S relation"
                     operator expected-cardinality)))
    (record-requirement key requirements seen)
    field))

(defun compile-node
    (model form requirements seen relation-requirements relation-seen limits
     &optional path)
  (let ((*compile-path* path))
    (unless (consp form)
      (let ((*diagnostic-expected* :nonempty-list))
        (fail-filter model form "A filter expression must be a nonempty list")))
    (let* ((operator (first form))
           (spec (gethash operator *operator-registry*)))
    (unless spec
      (let ((*diagnostic-expected* :registered-query-operator)
            (*diagnostic-received* (safe-designator-summary operator)))
        (fail-filter model form "Unsupported native query operator")))
    (unless (or (eq :variadic (operator-spec-arity spec))
                (= (operator-spec-arity spec) (length (rest form))))
      (let ((*diagnostic-expected* (operator-spec-arity spec))
            (*diagnostic-received* (length (rest form))))
        (fail-filter model form "Operator ~S expects ~D operands"
                     operator (operator-spec-arity spec))))
    (unless (member (operator-spec-stage spec) '(:scalar :relations))
      (return-from compile-node
        (compile-optional-node operator model form requirements seen
                               relation-requirements relation-seen limits)))
    (case operator
      (:and
       (let ((children
               (coerce (loop for child in (rest form)
                             for index from 1
                             collect (compile-node model child requirements seen
                                                   relation-requirements relation-seen limits
                                                   (cons index path)))
                       'simple-vector)))
         (make-query-node
          operator
          (lambda (entity context)
            (loop for child across children
                  always (evaluate-node child entity context)))
          :children children)))
      (:or
       (let ((children
               (coerce (loop for child in (rest form)
                             for index from 1
                             collect (compile-node model child requirements seen
                                                   relation-requirements relation-seen limits
                                                   (cons index path)))
                       'simple-vector)))
         (make-query-node
          operator
          (lambda (entity context)
            (loop for child across children
                  thereis (evaluate-node child entity context)))
          :children children)))
      (:not
       (unless (= 2 (length form))
         (fail-filter model form "Operator :NOT expects one child"))
       (let ((child (compile-node model (second form) requirements seen
                                  relation-requirements relation-seen limits
                                  (cons 1 path))))
         (make-query-node operator
                          (lambda (entity context)
                            (not (evaluate-node child entity context)))
                          :children (vector child))))
      ((:= :< :<= :> :>= :contains :starts-with)
       (unless (= 3 (length form))
         (fail-filter model form "Operator ~S expects a field and operand" operator))
       (let* ((field (scalar-field model form operator requirements seen))
              (kind (libtmux.internal::field-spec-kind field))
              (key (libtmux.internal::field-spec-key field))
              (operand (normalize-scalar-operand model form field (third form))))
         (when (and (member operator '(:< :<= :> :>=)) (not (eq kind :integer)))
           (fail-filter model form "Operator ~S requires an integer field" operator))
         (when (and (member operator '(:contains :starts-with)) (not (eq kind :text)))
           (fail-filter model form "Operator ~S requires a text field" operator))
         (let ((comparison
                 (case operator
                   (:= (scalar-equality kind))
                   (:< #'<) (:<= #'<=) (:> #'>) (:>= #'>=))))
           (make-query-node
            operator
            (lambda (entity context)
              (declare (ignore context))
              (multiple-value-bind (value present-p)
                  (libtmux.internal::resolved-field-value entity field)
                (and present-p
                     (case operator
                       ((:= :< :<= :> :>=) (funcall comparison value operand))
                       (:contains (not (null (search operand value :test #'char=))))
                       (:starts-with (and (<= (length operand) (length value))
                                          (string= operand value :end2 (length operand))))))))
            :field key :descriptor field :operand operand))))
      (:in
       (unless (= 3 (length form))
         (fail-filter model form "Operator :IN expects a field and finite sequence"))
       (let* ((field (scalar-field model form operator requirements seen))
              (kind (libtmux.internal::field-spec-kind field))
              (key (libtmux.internal::field-spec-key field))
              (source (third form)))
         (unless (or (listp source) (and (vectorp source) (not (stringp source))))
           (let ((*diagnostic-expected* '(or list non-string-vector))
                 (*diagnostic-received* (type-of source)))
             (fail-filter model form
                          "Operator :IN expects a list or non-string vector")))
         (when (> (length source) (compile-limits-max-membership limits))
           (error 'query-limit-exceeded
                  :model model
                  :path (coerce (reverse *compile-path*) 'simple-vector)
                  :operator operator
                  :field key
                  :expected (compile-limits-max-membership limits)
                  :received (length source)
                  :message (format nil "Membership contains more than ~D operands"
                                   (compile-limits-max-membership limits))))
         (let* ((operands (map 'simple-vector
                               (lambda (operand)
                                 (normalize-scalar-operand model form field operand))
                               source))
                (lookup (make-hash-table :test (if (eq kind :text) 'equal 'eql))))
           (loop for operand across operands do (setf (gethash operand lookup) t))
           (make-query-node
            operator
            (lambda (entity context)
              (declare (ignore context))
              (multiple-value-bind (value present-p)
                  (libtmux.internal::resolved-field-value entity field)
                (and present-p (not (null (gethash value lookup))))))
            :field key :operand operands))))
      ((:present :missing)
       (unless (= 2 (length form))
         (fail-filter model form "Operator ~S expects one field" operator))
       (let* ((field (scalar-field model form operator requirements seen))
              (key (libtmux.internal::field-spec-key field)))
         (make-query-node
          operator
          (lambda (entity context)
            (declare (ignore context))
            (let ((present-p
                    (nth-value 1 (libtmux.internal::resolved-field-value entity field))))
              (if (eq operator :present) present-p (not present-p))))
          :field key)))
      ((:any :all :none :is)
       (let* ((field (relation-field model form operator
                                     relation-requirements relation-seen))
              (key (libtmux.internal::field-spec-key field))
              (target (libtmux.internal::field-spec-target field))
              (child (compile-node target (third form) requirements seen
                                   relation-requirements relation-seen limits
                                   (cons 2 path))))
         (make-query-node
          operator
          (lambda (entity context)
            (multiple-value-bind (value present-p)
                (libtmux.internal::resolved-field-value entity field)
              (ecase operator
                (:is
                 (and present-p
                      (progn
                        (execution-checkpoint context)
                        (evaluate-node child value context))))
                (:any
                 (loop for related across value
                       thereis (progn
                                 (execution-checkpoint context)
                                 (evaluate-node child related context))))
                (:all
                 (loop for related across value
                       always (progn
                                (execution-checkpoint context)
                                (evaluate-node child related context))))
                (:none
                 (loop for related across value
                       never (progn
                               (execution-checkpoint context)
                               (evaluate-node child related context)))))))
          :field key :children (vector child))))
      (otherwise
       (fail-filter model form "Unsupported native query operator ~S" operator))))))

(defun compile-filter
    (model form
     &key
       (max-depth +default-max-depth+)
       (max-input-visits +default-max-input-visits+)
       (max-membership +default-max-membership+)
       (max-string-length +default-max-string-length+)
       (max-retained-characters +default-max-retained-characters+)
       (max-execution-visits +default-max-execution-visits+))
  "Compile FORM for captured MODEL into an owned local filter.
Scalar and registered relation operators perform no I/O and never evaluate
FORM as Lisp code. Regex operators require the optional regex system.
Keyword limits bound container depth, input visits, membership size, copied
character counts and later predicate execution. Limit failures signal
QUERY-LIMIT-EXCEEDED; malformed or mistyped forms signal INVALID-FILTER."
  (let ((class (query-model-class model)))
    (unless class
      (let ((*diagnostic-expected* #(:session :window :pane :window-link :client))
            (*diagnostic-received* (safe-designator-summary model)))
        (fail-filter model form
                     "Unknown captured query model; expected a registered entity model")))
    (when (null form)
      (let ((*diagnostic-expected* :nonempty-list)
            (*diagnostic-received* 'null))
        (fail-filter model form "A bare NIL filter is invalid")))
    (let* ((limits
             (make-compile-limits
              :max-depth (validated-limit model max-depth :max-depth 1)
              :max-input-visits
              (validated-limit model max-input-visits :max-input-visits 1)
              :max-membership
              (validated-limit model max-membership :max-membership 0)
              :max-string-length
              (validated-limit model max-string-length :max-string-length 0)
              :max-retained-characters
              (validated-limit model max-retained-characters
                               :max-retained-characters 0)
              :max-execution-visits
              (validated-limit model max-execution-visits
                               :max-execution-visits 1)))
           (owned (validated-owned-form model form limits))
           (requirements (make-array 4 :adjustable t :fill-pointer 0))
           (seen (make-hash-table :test 'eq))
           (relation-requirements (make-array 4 :adjustable t :fill-pointer 0))
           (relation-seen (make-hash-table :test 'eq))
           (root (compile-node model owned requirements seen
                               relation-requirements relation-seen limits)))
      (make-instance 'compiled-filter :model model :expression owned
                     :root root :required-fields (coerce requirements 'simple-vector)
                     :required-relations
                     (coerce relation-requirements 'simple-vector)
                     :registry-version libtmux.internal::+registry-version+
                     :limits limits
                     :execution-limit max-execution-visits))))

(defun expression (filter)
  "Return a fresh ordinary-data copy of FILTER's canonical native expression."
  (check-type filter compiled-filter)
  (nth-value 0
    (validated-owned-form (slot-value filter 'model)
                          (slot-value filter 'expression)
                          (slot-value filter 'limits))))

(defun required-fields (filter)
  "Return a fresh vector of scalar fields in first-occurrence order."
  (check-type filter compiled-filter)
  (copy-seq (slot-value filter 'required-fields)))

(defun required-relations (filter)
  "Return a fresh vector of relation fields in first-occurrence order."
  (check-type filter compiled-filter)
  (copy-seq (slot-value filter 'required-relations)))

(defun field-description (field)
  (list :key (libtmux.internal::field-spec-key field)
        :model (libtmux.internal::field-spec-model field)
        :kind (libtmux.internal::field-spec-kind field)
        :optional-p (not (null (libtmux.internal::field-spec-optional field)))
        :wire-format (let ((format (libtmux.internal::field-spec-format field)))
                       (and format (copy-seq format)))
        :wire-minimum (libtmux.internal::field-spec-minimum field)
        :wire-maximum (libtmux.internal::field-spec-maximum field)
        :target (libtmux.internal::field-spec-target field)
        :cardinality (libtmux.internal::field-spec-cardinality field)))

(defun fields (model)
  "Return fresh field metadata for one captured query MODEL in key order.
MODEL is one of :SESSION, :WINDOW, :PANE, :WINDOW-LINK or :CLIENT. Wire bounds
describe capture decoding and do not restrict native query integer operands."
  (unless (query-model-class model)
    (let ((*diagnostic-expected* #(:session :window :pane :window-link :client))
          (*diagnostic-received* (safe-designator-summary model)))
      (fail-filter model nil
                   "Unknown captured query model; expected a registered entity model")))
  (map 'simple-vector #'field-description (libtmux.internal::model-fields model)))

(defun explain (filter)
  "Return fresh execution metadata for FILTER. Query execution is local and acquires nothing."
  (check-type filter compiled-filter)
  (list :model (slot-value filter 'model)
        :registry-version (slot-value filter 'registry-version)
        :required-fields (required-fields filter)
        :required-relations (required-relations filter)
        :execution :local
        :acquires-p nil
        :source-filtering :unavailable))

(defun evaluate-filter (filter entity context)
  (let* ((model (slot-value filter 'model))
         (class (query-model-class model)))
    (unless (and (typep entity class) (eq model (libtmux:entity-model entity)))
      (error 'invalid-query-target :model model :received (type-of entity)
             :message (format nil "Expected a captured ~S entity, received ~S"
                              model (type-of entity))))
    (evaluate-node (slot-value filter 'root) entity context)))

(defun predicate (filter)
  "Return a genuine one-argument function that evaluates FILTER locally.
Each invocation receives a fresh execution budget and performs no tmux I/O."
  (check-type filter compiled-filter)
  (lambda (entity)
    (evaluate-filter
     filter entity
     (make-execution-context (slot-value filter 'model)
                             (slot-value filter 'execution-limit)))))

(defun selection-limit-error (model limit)
  (error 'query-limit-exceeded :model model :received :selection
         :message (format nil "Selection contains more than ~D items" limit)))

(defun finite-selection-vector (values max-items &optional model)
  (validated-limit model max-items :max-items 0)
  (typecase values
    (query-set
     (finite-selection-vector (slot-value values 'contents) max-items
                              (or model (slot-value values 'model))))
    (string
     (error 'libtmux:invalid-argument
            :message "A query selection must be a list or non-string vector"))
    (vector
     (let ((length (length values)))
       (when (> length max-items) (selection-limit-error model max-items))
       (let ((copy (make-array length)))
         (loop for index below length do (setf (aref copy index) (aref values index)))
         copy)))
    (list
     (let ((seen (make-hash-table :test 'eq))
           (copy (make-array (min 16 max-items) :adjustable t :fill-pointer 0))
           (tail values)
           (count 0))
       (loop while (consp tail)
             do (when (gethash tail seen)
                  (error 'libtmux:invalid-argument
                         :message "A query selection list must not contain a cycle"))
                (setf (gethash tail seen) t)
                (when (> (incf count) max-items)
                  (selection-limit-error model max-items))
                (vector-push-extend (car tail) copy)
                (setf tail (cdr tail)))
       (unless (null tail)
         (error 'libtmux:invalid-argument
                :message "A query selection must be a proper list"))
       (coerce copy 'simple-vector)))
    (t
     (error 'libtmux:invalid-argument
            :message "A query selection must be a list or non-string vector"))))

(defun query-set-model (set)
  "Return SET's declared captured model, or NIL for untyped ordinary data."
  (check-type set query-set)
  (slot-value set 'model))

(defun items (set)
  "Return a fresh simple vector containing SET's selected items in order."
  (check-type set query-set)
  (copy-seq (slot-value set 'contents)))

(defun from (values &key model (max-items +default-max-selection-items+))
  "Copy finite VALUES into an eager local QUERY-SET.
VALUES is a proper list, non-string vector or another query set. MODEL may name
one registered captured entity model; omit it for unrestricted ordinary data."
  (when (and model (not (query-model-class model)))
    (error 'invalid-filter
           :model (safe-designator-summary model)
           :expected #(:session :window :pane :window-link :client)
           :received (safe-designator-summary model)
           :message "Unknown query-set model"))
  (let* ((source-model (and (typep values 'query-set)
                            (slot-value values 'model)))
         (result-model (or model source-model))
         (contents (finite-selection-vector values max-items result-model)))
    (when (and model source-model (not (eq model source-model)))
      (error 'invalid-query-target :model model :received source-model
             :message "Cannot relabel a query set with another model"))
    (when result-model
      (let ((class (query-model-class result-model)))
        (loop for value across contents
              unless (and (typep value class)
                          (eq result-model (libtmux:entity-model value)))
                do (error 'invalid-query-target :model result-model
                          :received (type-of value)
                          :message "Query-set item does not match its declared model"))))
    (make-instance 'query-set :contents contents :model result-model)))

(defun where
    (set filter &key (max-items +default-max-selection-items+)
                      max-execution-visits)
  "Return a new query set containing SET items accepted by compiled FILTER.
Evaluation is eager and local. FILTER supplies the result model; conflicting
declared model metadata signals INVALID-QUERY-TARGET before evaluation."
  (check-type set query-set)
  (check-type filter compiled-filter)
  (let ((set-model (slot-value set 'model))
        (filter-model (slot-value filter 'model)))
    (when (and set-model (not (eq set-model filter-model)))
      (error 'invalid-query-target :model filter-model :received set-model
             :message "Query-set model does not match the compiled filter"))
    (make-instance
     'query-set :model filter-model
     :contents (matching filter (slot-value set 'contents)
                         :max-items max-items
                         :max-execution-visits max-execution-visits))))

(defun resolve-query-function (designator role)
  (or (and (functionp designator) designator)
      (and (symbolp designator)
           (not (macro-function designator))
           (not (special-operator-p designator))
           (handler-case (symbol-function designator)
             (undefined-function () nil)))
      (error 'libtmux:invalid-argument
             :message (format nil
                              "~A must be a function or a symbol naming a global function"
                              role))))

(defun where-if
    (set function &key (max-items +default-max-selection-items+))
  "Return a new query set selected by native FUNCTION in input order.
FUNCTION is a function object or a symbol naming a global function, resolved
once before traversal. Invalid designators signal LIBTMUX:INVALID-ARGUMENT.
On normal completion it has been called exactly once per item, eagerly and
locally. Its effects and call order are never optimized as declarative data.
The result owns its container and shares the selected items with SET.
See also: FROM, ITEMS, WHERE, ORDER-BY."
  (check-type set query-set)
  (let* ((function (resolve-query-function function "WHERE-IF function"))
         (input (finite-selection-vector set max-items))
         (result (make-array (min 16 (length input))
                             :adjustable t :fill-pointer 0)))
    (loop for value across input
          when (funcall function value)
            do (vector-push-extend value result))
    (make-instance 'query-set :model (slot-value set 'model)
                              :contents (coerce result 'simple-vector))))

(defun order-by
    (set predicate &key (key #'identity)
                        (max-items +default-max-selection-items+))
  "Return a new query set stably ordered by native PREDICATE and KEY.
PREDICATE and KEY are function objects or symbols naming global functions,
each resolved once before sorting. Invalid designators signal
LIBTMUX:INVALID-ARGUMENT. Their calls follow the STABLE-SORT callback contract.
Sorting is eager and local, mutating only a private simple-vector copy. SET
remains unchanged; items are shared and equal keys retain input order.
See also: FROM, ITEMS, WHERE-IF."
  (check-type set query-set)
  (let ((predicate (resolve-query-function predicate "ORDER-BY predicate"))
        (key (resolve-query-function key "ORDER-BY key"))
        (copy (finite-selection-vector set max-items)))
    (make-instance 'query-set :model (slot-value set 'model)
                              :contents (stable-sort copy predicate :key key))))

(defun matching
    (filter values
     &key (max-items +default-max-selection-items+) max-execution-visits)
  "Return a fresh simple vector of VALUES accepted by FILTER.
VALUES must be a finite list or non-string vector. The result preserves order,
multiplicity and the original captured handles. MAX-ITEMS bounds validation.
One execution budget is shared across the entire traversal; no I/O occurs."
  (check-type filter compiled-filter)
  (when (typep values 'query-set)
    (error 'libtmux:invalid-argument
           :message "MATCHING accepts lists and vectors; use WHERE for a query set"))
  (let* ((model (slot-value filter 'model))
         (input (finite-selection-vector values max-items model))
         (limit (if max-execution-visits
                    (validated-limit model max-execution-visits
                                     :max-execution-visits 1)
                    (slot-value filter 'execution-limit)))
         (context (make-execution-context model limit))
         (result (make-array (min 16 (length input)) :adjustable t :fill-pointer 0)))
    (loop for value across input
          when (evaluate-filter filter value context)
            do (vector-push-extend value result))
    (coerce result 'simple-vector)))

(defun safe-item-summary (item)
  (if (typep item 'libtmux:entity)
      (list :model (libtmux:entity-model item) :id (libtmux:id item))
      (type-of item)))

(defun ambiguity-sample (items)
  (let* ((length (min 2 (length items)))
         (sample (make-array length)))
    (loop for index below length
          do (setf (aref sample index) (safe-item-summary (aref items index))))
    sample))

(defun one (values &key (max-items +default-max-selection-items+))
  "Return the only item in finite VALUES.
Signal NO-MATCH for zero items or AMBIGUOUS-MATCH for more than one. The full
bounded container is validated before a candidate is returned. NIL is an item."
  (let* ((items (finite-selection-vector values max-items))
         (count (length items)))
    (case count
      (0 (error 'no-match :message "Strict selection found no items"))
      (1 (aref items 0))
      (otherwise
       (error 'ambiguous-match :count count :count-exact-p t
              :sample (ambiguity-sample items)
              :message (format nil "Strict selection found ~D items" count))))))

(defun one-or-none (values &key (max-items +default-max-selection-items+))
  "Return the only item and T, or NIL,NIL when finite VALUES is empty.
Signal AMBIGUOUS-MATCH for more than one item after validating the full bounded
container. A singleton containing NIL returns NIL,T."
  (let* ((items (finite-selection-vector values max-items))
         (count (length items)))
    (case count
      (0 (values nil nil))
      (1 (values (aref items 0) t))
      (otherwise
       (error 'ambiguous-match :count count :count-exact-p t
              :sample (ambiguity-sample items)
              :message (format nil "Strict selection found ~D items" count))))))

(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defun cycle-selection (client target model command activity observe options)
  (apply #'perform-command client (list target)
         (append (list command "-t" (physical-target target model)) (when activity '("-a")))
         :observe (when observe
                    (lambda (outcome capture)
                      (declare (ignore outcome))
                      (let* ((parent (resolve-observation client target capture))
                             (children (ecase model
                                         (:session (libtmux:window-links parent))
                                         (:window (libtmux:panes parent))))
                             (selected (find-if #'libtmux:active-p children)))
                        (unless selected
                          (error 'libtmux:incomplete-snapshot :message "No active selection after the command"))
                        (values selected t)))) options))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun next-window (client session &key activity (observe t) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Select SESSION's next window link; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
ACTIVITY restricts selection to windows with an alert. OBSERVE supplies the
newly captured active link through OUTCOME-VALUE, or records an observation
failure separately. Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition."
  (libtmux.internal::cycle-selection
   client session :session "next-window" activity observe
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun previous-window (client session &key activity (observe t) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Select SESSION's previous window link; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
ACTIVITY restricts selection to windows with an alert. OBSERVE supplies the
newly captured active link through OUTCOME-VALUE, or records an observation
failure separately. Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition."
  (libtmux.internal::cycle-selection
   client session :session "previous-window" activity observe
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun last-window (client session &key (observe t) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Select SESSION's last active link; return an outcome with that observed link.
OBSERVE may omit follow-up acquisition. Tmux reports an error when no last
window exists. Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition. Earlier
captures retain their original selection."
  (libtmux.internal::cycle-selection
   client session :session "last-window" nil observe
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun last-pane (client window &key (observe t) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Select WINDOW's last active pane; return an outcome with that observed pane.
OBSERVE may omit follow-up acquisition. Tmux reports an error when no last
pane exists. Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition. Earlier
captures retain their original selection."
  (libtmux.internal::cycle-selection
   client window :window "last-pane" nil observe
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))
