(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun server-access (client principal access &key group-p cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Change PRINCIPAL's native daemon ACL entry; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
PRINCIPAL is a nonempty literal account name, resolved by the daemon's name
service, not a numeric UID/GID. GROUP-P selects a group and requires live tmux
3.8; older daemons signal UNSUPPORTED-CAPABILITY before payload dispatch.

ACCESS is :ALLOW (add a writable entry), :DENY (remove an entry), :READ-ONLY
or :READ-WRITE (update or add). Adding an existing entry and removing an absent
one are errors. Root and the daemon-owner UID cannot be changed. :DENY creates
no deny rule: from 3.8, a removed user can still match its peer GID's entry.
Explicit UID entries take precedence over that GID; supplementary groups are
not searched. Cross-user filesystem access must be configured separately.

From 3.8, removal and permission updates recompute every connected client's
read-only state. This can clear an unrelated frontend's separate read-only
flag when its effective ACL entry is writable. Updates can schedule client
disconnection; success does not prove frontend exit. Already scheduled exits
are not cancelled by a later grant.

Blocks under shared preflight/dispatch limits, acquires no observation and
never retries. Invalid input signals INVALID-ARGUMENT; native errors and
uncertain effects retain their outcome. Earlier captures stay unchanged.
See also: LIST-SERVER-ACCESS, FETCH-CLIENTS, REFRESH, ERROR-OUTCOME."
  (let* ((principal (libtmux.internal::text-argument principal "Account name" nil))
         (flag (case access
                 (:allow "-a") (:deny "-d") (:read-only "-r") (:read-write "-w")
                 (otherwise
                  (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument
                   "Access must be :allow, :deny, :read-only or :read-write")))))
    (libtmux.internal::perform-command
     client nil (append (list "server-access" flag) (when group-p '("-g"))
                        (list "--" (libtmux.internal::literal-format principal)))
     :minimum-version (when group-p "3.8") :feature :group-server-access
     :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun list-server-access (client &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Print the daemon ACL; return owned UTF-8 text and a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
The ordinary native listing preserves escaping and whitespace. Before 3.8,
rows use (R)/(W); from 3.8 they include U/G account kinds. UID 0 is omitted and
unresolvable names print as unknown. An empty listing does not prove that no
account has access. This is printer output, not a decoded authorization model.
Blocks under shared preflight/dispatch limits and never retries or acquires an
observation. Invalid UTF-8 signals DECODING-ERROR; native and operational
failures retain their outcomes.
See also: SERVER-ACCESS, OUTCOME-STDOUT, ERROR-OUTCOME."
  (libtmux.internal::printed-command
   client '("server-access" "-l")
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun display-message (client message &key target format-p cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Print MESSAGE through tmux; return owned UTF-8 text and a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
Always uses the ordinary -p printer, preserving its whitespace and trailing lines.
Native versions can escape output, so it is not a byte-identical echo. MESSAGE
is literal by default. FORMAT-P enables tmux format and time expansion;
#() may start shell jobs but does not wait for their output. Fresh requests can
print empty or incomplete job results. The native command client owns those
jobs; its disconnect cleans them up.

TARGET may be a captured session, window, pane or window-link owned by CLIENT.
Use a window-link for exact session/index context. With no target, tmux selects
the context; physical windows and panes also leave their session context to
tmux. Foreign, replaced or vanished targets signal STALE-TARGET.

The result includes after-hook printer output; it is not a decoded scalar or
configuration record. Hooks may also have effects. The call blocks under shared
preflight/dispatch limits, acquires no replacement and never retries. Tmux 3.3a
literal fallback limits the escaped intermediate text to 8,191 UTF-8 bytes;
newer daemons use native literal printing. Encoded command limits also apply.
Invalid UTF-8 signals DECODING-ERROR with its outcome; other failures retain
their diagnostic outcome. Local validation signals INVALID-ARGUMENT.
See also: RUN-COMMAND, CAPTURE-PANE, SET-HOOK, OUTCOME-STDOUT, ERROR-OUTCOME."
  (let* ((message (libtmux.internal::text-argument message "Message"))
         (locator (when target
                    (unless (typep target '(or session window pane window-link))
                      (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument
                       "Message target must be a captured session, window, pane or window-link"))
                    (libtmux.internal::target-guard target)))
         (prefix (append '("display-message" "-p") (when locator (list "-t" locator))))
         (outcome
           (libtmux.internal::perform-command
            client (when target (list target)) (append prefix (list "--" message))
            :argument-builder
            (lambda (witness current)
              (declare (ignore current))
              (let ((literal-flag (and (not format-p)
                                       (libtmux.internal::version-at-least-p
                                        (libtmux.internal::server-witness-version witness) "3.4"))))
                (append prefix (when literal-flag '("-l"))
                        (list "--" (if (or format-p literal-flag)
                                       message
                                       (libtmux.internal::literal-time-format message))))))
            :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))
    (handler-bind ((decoding-error (lambda (condition) (setf (slot-value condition 'client) client))))
      (values (libtmux.internal::outcome-text outcome) outcome))))

(defun lock-session (client session &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Request locking of SESSION's attached frontends; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
CLIENT must own the captured SESSION. The live session membership determines
which frontends receive the request. Each runs its configured lock-command;
control clients, suspended frontends and empty/oversized commands are skipped.
Success acknowledges the request, not startup, completion or authentication.
Blocks under shared preflight/dispatch limits and returns no replacement.
Foreign or vanished sessions signal STALE-TARGET; other failures retain their
outcome. Lock programs belong to the frontends; closing CLIENT leaves them
running. Never retries.
See also: LOCK-CLIENT, LOCK-SERVER, SET-OPTION, OUTCOME-STATUS, ERROR-OUTCOME."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client (list session)
   (list "lock-session" "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target session :session))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun lock-server (client &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Request locking of all attached frontends on CLIENT's daemon.
Return a COMMAND-OUTCOME after guarded dispatch. Live frontend membership
determines the recipients; this is wider than one captured session. Each
frontend runs its configured lock-command. Control clients, suspended
frontends and empty/oversized commands are skipped. Success acknowledges
the request, not startup, completion or authentication. Blocks under shared
preflight/dispatch limits and returns no replacement. Failures retain their
outcome. Lock programs belong to the frontends; closing CLIENT leaves them
running. Never retries.
See also: LOCK-CLIENT, LOCK-SESSION, SET-OPTION, OUTCOME-STATUS, ERROR-OUTCOME."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client nil '("lock-server")
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun wait-for (client channel &key (operation :wait) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Wait, signal, lock or unlock the literal CHANNEL; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
OPERATION is :WAIT (default), :SIGNAL, :LOCK or :UNLOCK. CHANNEL is a nonempty
string without NUL. This call performs I/O on an existing daemon. :WAIT and
:LOCK require tmux 3.8, whose client-loss handling removes queued waiters;
older daemons signal UNSUPPORTED-CAPABILITY before dispatch. :SIGNAL and
:UNLOCK support the library's tmux floor.

A signal wakes current waiters or retains one pending wake. Repeated signals
are not an idempotent latch or a counting semaphore. Locks have no owner and
survive this call and CLOSE-CLIENT within the daemon's lifetime; unlock them
explicitly. Continuation does not identify a sender; server shutdown can flush
waiting requests. Signals and locks
share a channel, so applications should use separate names for those protocols.

One operation owns CLIENT at a time. Use another client to signal or unlock
a blocked call. TIMEOUT and OUTPUT-LIMIT cover preflight and waiting together.
Cancellation or lost acknowledgement can leave signal consumption or a lock
grant uncertain; inspect ERROR-OUTCOME. Never retries or unlocks automatically.
Signals INVALID-ARGUMENT, COMMAND-FAILED or an operational condition.
See also: CLOSE-CLIENT, CANCEL, ERROR-OUTCOME, OUTCOME-STATUS, UNSUPPORTED-CAPABILITY."
  (let* ((channel (libtmux.internal::text-argument channel "Wait channel" nil))
         (flag (case operation
                 (:wait nil) (:signal "-S") (:lock "-L") (:unlock "-U")
                 (otherwise
                  (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument
                   "Wait operation must be :wait, :signal, :lock or :unlock"))))
         (blocking (member operation '(:wait :lock))))
    (libtmux.internal::perform-command
     client nil (append (list "wait-for") (when flag (list flag)) (list "--" channel))
     :minimum-version (when blocking "3.8") :feature :wait-channel-disconnect-cleanup
     :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun send-text (client pane text &key enter cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Send literal TEXT to PANE through tmux and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
ENTER appends one Return key in the same command. Text such as C-c remains
literal text; it is not parsed as a key name, tmux format or shell command.
Tmux's active pane mode still handles the resulting input. Completion means
tmux processed the send request, not that the application consumed it. An
oversized encoded command is rejected without silently splitting the input."
  (let ((text (libtmux.internal::text-argument text)))
    (libtmux.internal::perform-command
     client (list pane)
     (list "send-keys" "-l" "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target pane :pane) "--"
           (if enter (concatenate 'string text (string #\Return)) text))
     :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun send-keys (client pane keys &key (repeat 1) cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Send a finite nonempty list/vector of tmux key strings to PANE.
Return a COMMAND-OUTCOME. REPEAT is a positive count. Tmux interprets key names
such as C-c and Enter; its unrecognized strings fall back to literal input.
Use SEND-TEXT when key-name interpretation must be disabled. Acknowledgment
does not prove application readiness or consumption."
  (let ((keys (libtmux.internal::argument-vector keys)))
    (unless (and (plusp (length keys)) (every (lambda (key) (plusp (length key))) keys))
      (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Keys must be a nonempty sequence of nonempty strings"))
    (libtmux.internal::perform-command
     client (list pane)
     (append (list "send-keys" "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target pane :pane)
                   "-N" (libtmux.internal::integer-argument repeat 1 4294967295 "Repeat count") "--")
             (coerce keys 'list))
     :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun send-prefix (client pane &key second cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Send the session's configured prefix key to PANE; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
SECOND selects prefix2. Tmux's active pane mode handles input; completion does
not establish application consumption. Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational
condition retaining its outcome."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client (list pane)
   (append (list "send-prefix" "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target pane :pane))
           (when second '("-2")))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun clear-history (client pane &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Clear PANE's retained tmux history; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
Captured observations remain unchanged. This does not promise to clear the
application's current screen. Signals STALE-TARGET or an operational condition."
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client (list pane) (list "clear-history" "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target pane :pane))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(defun copy-mode (client pane &key exit page-up cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Enter PANE's tmux copy mode, or EXIT it; return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
PAGE-UP scrolls up on entry and cannot be combined with EXIT. This addresses an
existing pane and does not create an interactive terminal frontend. Signals
STALE-TARGET or an operational condition."
  (when (and exit page-up)
    (libtmux.internal::invalid-argument "Copy-mode exit and page-up are mutually exclusive"))
  (libtmux.internal::perform-command
   client (list pane)
   (append (list "copy-mode" "-t" (libtmux.internal::physical-target pane :pane))
           (when exit '("-q")) (when page-up '("-u")))
   :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defun terminate-entity (client target model command options)
  (apply #'perform-command client (list target)
         (list command "-t" (physical-target target model))
         options))

(defun server-termination-command (witness nonce)
  (let ((entered (receipt-command (concatenate 'string nonce ":entered")))
        (rejected (receipt-command (concatenate 'string nonce ":server"))))
    (list "-N" "if-shell" "-F" (server-guard witness)
          (tmux-command-list (list entered '("kill-server")))
          (tmux-command-text rejected))))

(defun wait-for-server-death (witness token deadline)
  (let ((wake (cancellation-event-open))
        (registered nil))
    (when (minusp wake)
      (error 'libtmux:command-failed
             :message "Cannot allocate the server-termination cancellation descriptor"))
    (unwind-protect
         (progn
           (when (member :server
                         (poll-owned (list (list :server (server-witness-fd witness) :input)) 0))
             (return-from wait-for-server-death :terminated))
           (unless (setf registered (register-token token wake))
             (return-from wait-for-server-death :cancelled))
           (loop
             (let ((remaining (- deadline (monotonic-seconds))))
               (let ((ready (poll-owned
                             (list (list :server (server-witness-fd witness) :input)
                                   (list :cancel wake :input))
                             (max 0 remaining))))
                 (when (member :server ready)
                   (return :terminated))
                 (when (or (member :cancel ready) (libtmux:cancelled-p token))
                   (return :cancelled))
                 (unless (plusp remaining)
                   (return :deadline))))))
      (if registered
          (retire-token token wake)
          (close-descriptor wake)))))

(defvar *server-death-waiter* #'wait-for-server-death)

(defun interpret-server-termination (client witness token deadline outcome nonce)
  (let* ((bytes (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::stdout))
         (entered (receipt-bytes nonce "entered"))
         (rejected (receipt-bytes nonce "server"))
         (entered-p (byte-prefix-p entered bytes))
         (rejected-p (byte-prefix-p rejected bytes)))
    (when (eq :not-dispatched (libtmux:outcome-status outcome))
      (check-outcome outcome))
    (when rejected-p
      (invalidate-client-generation client)
      (setf (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::status) :not-dispatched
            (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::phase) :guard-rejected
            (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::reason) :stale-server)
      (error 'libtmux:stale-target :client client :outcome outcome
             :message "The live dispatch guard rejected the selected server"))
    (when entered-p
      (setf (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::stdout) (subseq bytes (length entered))))
    (ecase (handler-case (funcall *server-death-waiter* witness token deadline)
             (error (condition)
               (setf (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::status) :unknown
                     (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::reason) :server-exit-unobserved)
               (error 'libtmux:outcome-unknown :cause condition :outcome outcome
                      :message "Cannot prove whether the selected tmux server exited")))
      (:terminated
       (invalidate-client-generation client)
       (setf (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::phase) :server-terminated
             (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::status) (if entered-p :succeeded :unknown)
             (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::reason) (unless entered-p :missing-dispatch-receipt)))
      (:cancelled
       (setf (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::status) :unknown
             (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::reason) :cancelled))
      (:deadline
       (setf (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::status) :unknown
             (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::reason) :deadline)))
    (check-outcome outcome)))

(defun perform-server-termination (client &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  (setf timeout (or timeout (slot-value client 'libtmux::timeout))
        output-limit (or output-limit (slot-value client 'libtmux::output-limit)))
  (check-limits timeout output-limit)
  (handler-bind ((libtmux:libtmux-error
                   (lambda (condition) (setf (slot-value condition 'libtmux::client) client))))
    (call-with-operation
     client cancel-token
     (lambda (token)
       (let* ((start (monotonic-seconds))
              (deadline (+ start timeout))
              (budget (make-capture-budget :start start :deadline deadline
                                           :remaining output-limit :row-limit 100000
                                           :field-limit 1048576))
              (current (handler-case (preflight-targets client nil token budget)
                         (libtmux:libtmux-error (condition)
                           (preflight-failure client '("kill-server") start condition))))
              (witness (slot-value client 'libtmux::witness))
              (*command-socket-path* (server-witness-endpoint witness))
              (nonce (format nil "libtmux-~32,'0X"
                             (random (ash 1 128) (make-random-state t))))
              (encoded (handler-case
                           (check-command-envelope
                            (server-termination-command witness nonce))
                         (libtmux:libtmux-error (condition)
                           (preflight-failure client '("kill-server") start condition))))
              (outcome (execute-tmux client encoded token
                                     (max 0 (- deadline (monotonic-seconds)))
                                     (capture-budget-remaining budget) nil)))
         (declare (ignore current))
         (unwind-protect
              (interpret-server-termination client witness token deadline outcome nonce)
           (setf (slot-value outcome 'libtmux::elapsed)
                 (- (monotonic-seconds) start))))))))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defun kill-pane (client pane &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Delete exactly the captured physical PANE and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
The live pane identity is checked before dispatch. Other panes are preserved.
Signals STALE-TARGET when PANE disappeared or belongs to another generation.
Never retries the mutation.

See also: KILL-WINDOW, KILL-SESSION, KILL-SERVER"
  (libtmux.internal::terminate-entity
   client pane :pane "kill-pane"
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun kill-window (client window &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Delete exactly the captured physical WINDOW and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
Every link to that physical window is removed by tmux. Other windows remain.
The live identity is checked before dispatch; the mutation is never retried.

See also: KILL-PANE, KILL-SESSION, KILL-SERVER"
  (libtmux.internal::terminate-entity
   client window :window "kill-window"
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun kill-session (client session &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Delete exactly the captured SESSION and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
Tmux removes that session's links and panes no longer referenced elsewhere.
The live identity is checked before dispatch; the mutation is never retried.

See also: KILL-PANE, KILL-WINDOW, KILL-SERVER"
  (libtmux.internal::terminate-entity
   client session :session "kill-session"
   (list :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit)))

(defun kill-server (client &key cancel-token timeout output-limit)
  "Terminate CLIENT's preflight-accepted daemon and return a COMMAND-OUTCOME.
Success requires both a pre-dispatch receipt and observed exit of the server
process accepted during this call. Missing evidence signals OUTCOME-UNKNOWN;
cancellation or a deadline never causes an automatic retry. The connection
CLIENT stays open but its generation is invalidated after observed server death.
A failed exit wait retains :SERVER-EXIT-UNOBSERVED and the underlying
ERROR-CAUSE. CLOSE-CLIENT never calls this function.

See also: CLOSE-CLIENT, KILL-SESSION, OUTCOME-STATUS, OUTCOME-PHASE"
  (libtmux.internal::perform-server-termination
   client :cancel-token cancel-token :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit))

(in-package #:libtmux)

(defgeneric outcome-status (outcome)
  (:documentation "Return :SUCCEEDED, :FAILED, :UNKNOWN or :NOT-DISPATCHED. No I/O.
These describe retained evidence, not rollback. Observation failure is separate
from mutation success; inspect OUTCOME-OBSERVATION-ERROR and OUTCOME-VALUE."))
(defgeneric outcome-phase (outcome)
  (:documentation "Return retained dispatch evidence, without I/O.
Raw process phases are :PREPARED, :LAUNCHING, :DISPATCHED and :EXITED. Named
operations may also report :PREFLIGHT or :GUARD-REJECTED before payload dispatch.
Explicit server termination reports :SERVER-TERMINATED only after retained
pidfd readiness proves exit. Phase is separate from OUTCOME-STATUS; an exited
queue can have partially completed effects even when it reported failure."))
(defgeneric outcome-exit-code (outcome)
  (:documentation "Return the subprocess's integer exit status, or NIL if unknown. No I/O."))
(defgeneric outcome-reason (outcome)
  (:documentation "Return the retained failure reason keyword, or NIL. No I/O.
Examples include :DEADLINE and :CANCELLED; inspect the condition and phase too."))
(defgeneric outcome-elapsed (outcome)
  (:documentation "Return elapsed monotonic seconds for this retained result. No I/O.
Raw RUN-COMMAND measures its subprocess operation. Named operations include
preflight, dispatch and follow-up acquisition in their retained outcome timing."))
(defgeneric outcome-observation-error (outcome)
  (:documentation "Return the condition from follow-up acquisition, or NIL. No I/O.
A successful mutation remains :SUCCEEDED when its replacement observation
fails. Do not repeat the mutation merely to obtain a replacement observation."))

(defclass command-outcome ()
  ((status :initarg :status :reader outcome-status)
   (phase :initarg :phase :reader outcome-phase)
   (arguments :initarg :arguments)
   (stdout :initarg :stdout)
   (stderr :initarg :stderr)
   (exit-code :initarg :exit-code :initform nil :reader outcome-exit-code)
   (reason :initarg :reason :initform nil :reader outcome-reason)
   (elapsed :initarg :elapsed :reader outcome-elapsed)
   (value :initarg :value :initform nil)
   (present-p :initarg :present-p :initform nil)
   (cleanup-failures :initarg :cleanup-failures :initform nil)
   (observation-error :initarg :observation-error :initform nil
                      :reader outcome-observation-error))
  (:documentation "A retained command result; byte and argument readers copy storage.
STATUS is :SUCCEEDED, :FAILED, :UNKNOWN or :NOT-DISPATCHED. PHASE is separate
dispatch evidence. An observation error does not erase a successful mutation."))

(defun outcome-arguments (outcome)
  "Return an owned vector of the effective argv strings. No external I/O."
  (map 'vector #'copy-seq (slot-value outcome 'arguments)))

(defun outcome-stdout (outcome)
  "Return a fresh octet vector containing retained standard output."
  (copy-seq (slot-value outcome 'stdout)))

(defun outcome-stderr (outcome)
  "Return a fresh octet vector containing retained diagnostic output."
  (copy-seq (slot-value outcome 'stderr)))

(defun outcome-value (outcome)
  "Return the resulting value and presence as two values, without I/O.
Copy data containers and strings; captured entity observations may be shared."
  (values (libtmux.internal::owned-data (slot-value outcome 'value))
          (slot-value outcome 'present-p)))

(defun outcome-cleanup-failures (outcome)
  "Return a fresh vector of conditions encountered while releasing the process."
  (coerce (slot-value outcome 'cleanup-failures) 'simple-vector))

(defclass cancellation-token ()
  ((lock :initform (libtmux.internal::make-lock "cancellation token"))
   (cancelled-p :initform nil)
   (registrations :initform nil))
  (:documentation "One-way cancellation state; idle tokens own no OS descriptors."))

(defun make-cancellation-token ()
  "Create a token for one or more operations. CANCEL is idempotent.
Signals UNSUPPORTED-PLATFORM outside the qualified runtime profile.
See also: CANCEL, CANCELLED-P, OPEN-CLIENT."
  (libtmux.internal::require-process-profile)
  (make-instance 'cancellation-token))

(defun cancelled-p (token)
  "Return whether TOKEN has been cancelled, without external I/O."
  (libtmux.internal::call-with-lock
   (slot-value token 'lock)
   (lambda () (slot-value token 'cancelled-p))))

(defun cancel (token)
  "Cancel registered operations and return true only for the first request.
Cancellation wakes each active owner. It does not wait for completion or undo
a mutation. Inspect the operation's outcome and dispatch phase."
  (check-type token cancellation-token)
  (libtmux.internal::call-with-lock
   (slot-value token 'lock)
   (lambda ()
     (unless (slot-value token 'cancelled-p)
       (setf (slot-value token 'cancelled-p) t)
       (dolist (fd (slot-value token 'registrations))
         (libtmux.internal::wake-operation fd))
       t))))

(in-package #:libtmux.internal)

(defun monotonic-seconds ()
  (/ (get-internal-real-time) internal-time-units-per-second))

(defun invalid-argument (format-control &rest arguments)
  (error 'libtmux:invalid-argument
         :message (apply #'format nil format-control arguments)))

(defun require-process-profile ()
  (unless (every (lambda (feature) (member feature *features*))
                 '(:sbcl :linux :x86-64))
    (error 'libtmux:unsupported-platform :feature :runtime-profile
           :message (format nil "The process backend requires SBCL on Linux x86-64; found ~A ~A on ~A (~A)"
                            (lisp-implementation-type) (lisp-implementation-version)
                            (software-type) (machine-type)))))

(defun finite-vector (value &optional (name "Sequence"))
  (cond
    ((and (vectorp value) (not (stringp value)))
     (map 'vector #'identity value))
    ((listp value)
     (let ((length (handler-case (list-length value) (type-error () nil))))
       (unless length (invalid-argument "~A must be a finite proper list" name))
       (coerce value 'simple-vector)))
    (t (invalid-argument "~A must be a list or vector" name))))

(defun argument-vector (arguments)
  (let ((result (finite-vector arguments "Arguments")))
    (map-into result
              (lambda (argument)
                (unless (and (stringp argument)
                             (not (find #\Null argument)))
                  (invalid-argument "Arguments must be strings without NUL"))
                (copy-seq argument))
              result)
    result))

(defun octet-vector (input)
  (unless (or (null input)
              (and (vectorp input) (not (stringp input))
                   (every (lambda (byte) (typep byte '(unsigned-byte 8))) input)))
    (invalid-argument "Input must be an octet vector or NIL"))
  (map '(simple-array (unsigned-byte 8) (*)) #'identity input))

(defun check-limits (timeout output-limit)
  (unless (handler-case
              (and (realp timeout) (<= 0 timeout most-positive-double-float))
            (arithmetic-error () nil))
    (invalid-argument "Timeout must be a nonnegative finite real"))
  (unless (typep output-limit '(integer 1))
    (invalid-argument "Output limit must be a positive integer")))

(defun make-outcome (arguments status phase start &key stdout stderr code reason)
  (make-instance 'libtmux:command-outcome
                 :arguments arguments :status status :phase phase
                 :stdout (or stdout (octet-vector nil))
                 :stderr (or stderr (octet-vector nil))
                 :exit-code code :reason reason
                 :elapsed (- (monotonic-seconds) start)))

(defun check-outcome (outcome)
  (unless (eq (libtmux:outcome-status outcome) :succeeded)
    (error (case (libtmux:outcome-reason outcome)
             (:cancelled 'libtmux:command-cancelled)
             (:deadline 'libtmux:deadline-exceeded)
             (:output-limit 'libtmux:output-limit-exceeded)
             (otherwise (if (eq (libtmux:outcome-status outcome) :unknown)
                            'libtmux:outcome-unknown 'libtmux:command-failed)))
           :outcome outcome
           :message (format nil "Command ~A (~A, ~A); inspect ERROR-OUTCOME"
                            (libtmux:outcome-status outcome)
                            (libtmux:outcome-phase outcome)
                            (or (libtmux:outcome-reason outcome)
                                (libtmux:outcome-exit-code outcome)))))
  outcome)

(defun strict-text (octets)
  (handler-case (decode-utf8 octets)
    (error (cause)
      (error 'libtmux:decoding-error :cause cause
             :message "Tmux output is not valid UTF-8; use the byte API"))))

(defun register-token (token fd)
  (call-with-lock
   (slot-value token 'libtmux::lock)
   (lambda ()
     (unless (slot-value token 'libtmux::cancelled-p)
       (push fd (slot-value token 'libtmux::registrations))
       t))))

(defun retire-token (token fd)
  (call-with-lock
   (slot-value token 'libtmux::lock)
   (lambda ()
     (setf (slot-value token 'libtmux::registrations)
           (delete fd (slot-value token 'libtmux::registrations)))
     (close-descriptor fd))))

(defvar *process-started-hook* nil
  "Internal test observation point, called inside owned-process cleanup scope.")

(defvar *process-launched-hook* nil
  "Internal failure-injection point before acquiring child authority.")

(defvar *before-dispatch-hook* nil
  "Internal race-injection point after unlinking the launcher names.")

(defvar *operation-client* nil)
(defvar *command-socket-path* nil)

(in-package #:libtmux.workspace)

(defun check-owned-workspace-limits (declaration max-windows max-panes max-argv max-environment)
  "Apply caller limits to already normalized owned data; protocol ceilings still apply."
  (let* ((data (slot-value declaration 'data)) (session (getf data :session))
         (windows (getf session :windows)) (panes 0))
    (flet ((limit (count maximum name path)
             (when (> count maximum)
               (fail-workspace "Owned workspace exceeds a configured limit" :path path :limit name))))
      (limit (length windows) max-windows :max-windows #(:session :windows))
      (limit (length (getf session :environment)) max-environment :max-environment #(:session :environment))
      (loop for window across windows for window-index from 0
            do (incf panes (length (getf window :panes)))
               (limit panes max-panes :max-panes #(:session :windows))
               (loop for pane across (getf window :panes) for pane-index from 0
                     do (limit (length (getf pane :command)) max-argv :max-argv
                               (vector :session :windows window-index :panes pane-index :command)))))))

(defun make-workspace (data &key (max-windows 100) (max-panes 1000) (max-argv 256) (max-environment 256))
  "Validate inert native DATA and return an owned WORKSPACE without I/O.
DATA is a finite keyword plist declaring libtmux.lisp.workspace/1 or /2.
Workspace/1 describes name-based topology reuse. Workspace/2 requires stable
IDs at the root, session, windows and panes; duplicate window names are allowed.
Mutable inputs are copied. Unknown/duplicate keys, cyclic containers and invalid
values signal INVALID-WORKSPACE with WORKSPACE-PATH and WORKSPACE-LIMIT.

MAX-WINDOWS, MAX-PANES, MAX-ARGV and MAX-ENVIRONMENT limit topology, individual
argv vectors and session environment pairs. Owned protocol ceilings remain in
force when a caller chooses larger limits. :COMMAND is literal argv;
:SHELL-COMMAND is explicit shell source. Cwd, environment and named/custom
layouts retain their creation meanings; changing existing processes is refused.

See also: WORKSPACE-DATA, PARSE-WORKSPACE, READ-WORKSPACE, PLAN-WORKSPACE,
APPLY-WORKSPACE, LIBTMUX:NEW-SESSION."
  (checked-limit max-windows :max-windows 1)
  (checked-limit max-panes :max-panes 1)
  (checked-limit max-argv :max-argv 0)
  (checked-limit max-environment :max-environment 0)
  (closed-plist data t #() "Workspace")
  (let ((schema (plist-value data :schema)))
    (cond
      ((and (stringp schema) (string= schema +schema+))
       (%make-v1-workspace data :max-windows max-windows :max-panes max-panes
                               :max-argv max-argv :max-environment max-environment))
      ((and (stringp schema) (string= schema "libtmux.lisp.workspace/2"))
       (let ((declaration (make-owned-declaration data)))
         (check-owned-workspace-limits declaration max-windows max-panes max-argv max-environment)
         (make-instance 'workspace :session nil :owned declaration :data (slot-value declaration 'data))))
      (t (fail-workspace "Unsupported or missing workspace :SCHEMA" :path #(:schema))))))

(defun workspace-document-path (path)
  "Translate registered native field names to JSON diagnostics without interning input."
  (map 'vector (lambda (part)
                 (if (keywordp part) (substitute #\_ #\- (string-downcase (symbol-name part))) part))
       path))

(defun parse-workspace
    (source &key (max-input-bytes +default-max-input-bytes+) (max-depth +default-max-depth+)
                 (max-nodes +default-max-nodes+) (max-string-length +default-max-string-length+)
                 (max-windows +default-max-windows+) (max-panes +default-max-panes+)
                 (max-argv +default-max-argv+) (max-environment +default-max-environment+)
                 (max-integer-digits +default-max-integer-digits+))
  "Parse one bounded workspace/1 or workspace/2 JSON string into a WORKSPACE.
The declared schema selects a closed grammar. Unknown/duplicate members,
invalid values and incomplete input fail; no external names are interned or
evaluated. Limits bound UTF-8 bytes, nesting, nodes, string length, topology,
argv length, session environment pairs and integer token digits. Owned protocol
ceilings remain in force when callers choose larger limits.

Workspace/2 requires stable IDs and permits repeated window names. Command
arrays are literal argv; shell_command is explicit source. Named/custom layouts
and all other creation inputs have the same meanings as MAKE-WORKSPACE.
Retained strings and containers are owned. Signals INVALID-WORKSPACE-DOCUMENT
or WORKSPACE-LIMIT-EXCEEDED with WORKSPACE-PATH and WORKSPACE-LIMIT. No tmux I/O.

See also: MAKE-WORKSPACE, READ-WORKSPACE, WORKSPACE-DATA."
  (unless (stringp source) (fail-document "PARSE-WORKSPACE requires a complete JSON string"))
  (checked-limit max-input-bytes :max-input-bytes 1)
  (checked-limit max-depth :max-depth 1)
  (checked-limit max-nodes :max-nodes 1)
  (checked-limit max-string-length :max-string-length 1)
  (checked-limit max-windows :max-windows 1)
  (checked-limit max-panes :max-panes 1)
  (checked-limit max-argv :max-argv 0)
  (checked-limit max-environment :max-environment 0)
  (checked-limit max-integer-digits :max-integer-digits 0)
  (bounded-utf-8-size source max-input-bytes)
  (validate-json-integers source max-integer-digits)
  (let* ((document (parse-json-events source max-depth max-nodes max-string-length))
         (schema (required-member document "schema" #())))
    (cond
      ((and (stringp schema) (string= schema +schema+))
       (workspace-from-v1-document document max-windows max-panes max-argv max-environment))
      ((and (stringp schema) (string= schema "libtmux.lisp.workspace/2"))
       (bounded-utf-8-size source +owned-record-bytes+)
       (validate-json-integers source (min 32 max-integer-digits))
       (let ((tree (if (or (> max-depth 32) (> max-nodes +owned-record-nodes+)
                           (> max-string-length +owned-text-length+))
                       (parse-json-events source (min 32 max-depth) (min +owned-record-nodes+ max-nodes)
                                                 (min +owned-text-length+ max-string-length))
                       document)))
         (handler-case
             (let* ((data (normalize-owned-declaration tree (make-owned-context :json)))
                    (declaration (make-owned-declaration data)))
               (check-owned-workspace-limits declaration max-windows max-panes max-argv max-environment)
               (make-instance 'workspace :session nil :owned declaration :data (slot-value declaration 'data)))
           (invalid-workspace-document (condition) (error condition))
           (invalid-workspace (condition)
             (fail-document "Owned document violates its workspace contract" :cause condition
                            :path (workspace-document-path (workspace-path condition))
                            :limit (workspace-limit condition))))))
      (t (fail-document "Unsupported workspace-document schema" :path #("schema"))))))

(defclass workspace-state ()
  ((value :initarg :value))
  (:documentation "Captured ready/vacant owned workspace evidence for local planning.
Acquire through FETCH-WORKSPACE-STATE. Readers remain usable after client close.

See also: STATE-DATA, STATE-SNAPSHOT, PLAN-WORKSPACE, WORKSPACE-INSPECTION."))

(define-condition workspace-state-error (workspace-error)
  ((data :initarg :data :initform nil) (snapshot :initarg :snapshot :initform nil)
   (outcomes :initarg :outcomes :initform #()) (causes :initarg :causes :initform #()))
  (:documentation "Owned state acquisition failed with retained partial read evidence.
Failure does not imply vacancy or grant ownership. Inspect STATE-DATA,
STATE-SNAPSHOT, STATE-OUTCOMES and STATE-CAUSES without further I/O.

See also: FETCH-WORKSPACE-STATE, INSPECT-WORKSPACE, LIBTMUX:ERROR-CAUSE."))

(defclass workspace-inspection ()
  ((value :initarg :value))
  (:documentation "Explicit read evidence, including incomplete or invalid owned work.
An inspection cannot stand in for WORKSPACE-STATE in local planning.

See also: INSPECT-WORKSPACE, INSPECTION-DATA, WORKSPACE-INSPECTION-ERROR."))

(define-condition workspace-inspection-error (workspace-error)
  ((inspection :initarg :inspection) (terminal :initarg :terminal))
  (:documentation "Inspection stopped with its original and terminal failures retained.
INSPECTION-EVIDENCE returns the partial public observation. Its causes remain
separate from INSPECTION-TERMINAL; neither admits planning or mutation.

See also: INSPECTION-EVIDENCE, INSPECTION-TERMINAL, INSPECTION-CAUSES."))

(defgeneric state-data (state)
  (:documentation "Return fresh finite metadata for WORKSPACE-STATE or WORKSPACE-STATE-ERROR.
No I/O. Partial metadata from an error does not prove readiness or vacancy.

See also: STATE-SNAPSHOT, STATE-OUTCOMES, STATE-CAUSES."))
(defgeneric state-snapshot (state)
  (:documentation "Return STATE's retained captured SNAPSHOT, or NIL before capture. No I/O.

See also: STATE-DATA, FETCH-WORKSPACE-STATE, LIBTMUX:PANES."))
(defgeneric state-outcomes (state)
  (:documentation "Return STATE's read COMMAND-OUTCOME objects in a fresh simple vector.
Includes retained unsuccessful reads. No I/O.

See also: STATE-CAUSES, LIBTMUX:OUTCOME-STATUS."))
(defgeneric state-causes (state)
  (:documentation "Return retained acquisition conditions in a fresh simple vector. No I/O.
Successful state has an empty vector. Original condition objects are shared.

See also: WORKSPACE-STATE-ERROR, LIBTMUX:ERROR-CAUSE."))
(defgeneric inspection-data (inspection)
  (:documentation "Return fresh attempts, record roles and diagnostics from INSPECTION. No I/O.
Read completion does not establish valid ownership or application success.

See also: INSPECTION-SNAPSHOTS, INSPECTION-CAUSES, INSPECT-WORKSPACE."))
(defgeneric inspection-snapshots (inspection)
  (:documentation "Return retained captured SNAPSHOT objects in a fresh simple vector. No I/O.
Each capture remains paired with its attempt's metadata in INSPECTION-DATA.

See also: INSPECTION-DATA, INSPECTION-OUTCOMES."))
(defgeneric inspection-outcomes (inspection)
  (:documentation "Return INSPECTION's read outcomes in a fresh simple vector. No I/O.

See also: INSPECTION-DATA, LIBTMUX:OUTCOME-STATUS."))
(defgeneric inspection-causes (inspection)
  (:documentation "Return original retained conditions in a fresh simple vector. No I/O.

See also: INSPECTION-DATA, INSPECTION-TERMINAL, LIBTMUX:ERROR-CAUSE."))
(defgeneric inspection-evidence (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the partial WORKSPACE-INSPECTION retained by CONDITION. No I/O.

See also: WORKSPACE-INSPECTION-ERROR, INSPECTION-DATA, INSPECTION-TERMINAL."))
(defgeneric inspection-terminal (condition)
  (:documentation "Return the terminal condition that stopped inspection. No I/O.
The original metadata cause remains in the cause chain and inspection evidence.

See also: INSPECTION-EVIDENCE, INSPECTION-CAUSES, LIBTMUX:ERROR-CAUSE."))
(defgeneric plan-data (plan)
  (:documentation "Return (values fresh-owned-data T), or (values NIL NIL) for legacy evidence.
Accepts WORKSPACE-PLAN or WORKSPACE-CONFLICT. Owned data separates declaration
changes, captured drift, informational context, conflicts and :PUBLISH-P.
An empty step vector can still require metadata publication. No I/O.

See also: PLAN-STEPS, PLAN-WORKSPACE, WORKSPACE-CONFLICT."))
(defgeneric result-data (result)
  (:documentation "Return owned application data and presence as two values, without I/O.
Accepts WORKSPACE-RESULT or WORKSPACE-APPLY-FAILED. Returns fresh data and T for
owned evidence; legacy evidence returns NIL,NIL. Data distinguishes phase,
mappings, selected/candidate/observed metadata and publication status.

See also: RESULT-SNAPSHOT, RESULT-OUTCOMES, RESULT-CAUSES, FAILED-STEP."))
(defgeneric result-causes (result)
  (:documentation "Return retained application conditions in a fresh simple vector. No I/O.
Conditions keep primary-first order and identity deduplication; successful
applications without failures return an empty vector.

See also: RESULT-DATA, WORKSPACE-APPLY-FAILED, LIBTMUX:ERROR-CAUSE."))

(defmethod state-data ((state workspace-state)) (owned-state-data (slot-value state 'value)))
(defmethod state-snapshot ((state workspace-state)) (owned-state-snapshot (slot-value state 'value)))
(defmethod state-outcomes ((state workspace-state)) (owned-state-outcomes (slot-value state 'value)))
(defmethod state-causes ((state workspace-state)) (make-array 0))
(defmethod state-data ((condition workspace-state-error)) (deep-copy (slot-value condition 'data)))
(defmethod state-snapshot ((condition workspace-state-error)) (slot-value condition 'snapshot))
(defmethod state-outcomes ((condition workspace-state-error)) (copy-seq (slot-value condition 'outcomes)))
(defmethod state-causes ((condition workspace-state-error)) (copy-seq (slot-value condition 'causes)))
(defmethod inspection-data ((value workspace-inspection)) (owned-inspection-data (slot-value value 'value)))
(defmethod inspection-snapshots ((value workspace-inspection)) (owned-inspection-snapshots (slot-value value 'value)))
(defmethod inspection-outcomes ((value workspace-inspection)) (owned-inspection-outcomes (slot-value value 'value)))
(defmethod inspection-causes ((value workspace-inspection)) (owned-inspection-causes (slot-value value 'value)))
(defmethod inspection-evidence ((condition workspace-inspection-error)) (slot-value condition 'inspection))
(defmethod inspection-terminal ((condition workspace-inspection-error)) (slot-value condition 'terminal))
(defmethod plan-data ((value workspace-plan))
  (let ((data (slot-value value 'data))) (values (deep-copy data) (not (null data)))))
(defmethod plan-data ((condition workspace-conflict))
  (let ((data (slot-value condition 'data))) (values (deep-copy data) (not (null data)))))
(defmethod result-data ((value workspace-result))
  (let ((data (slot-value value 'data))) (values (deep-copy data) (not (null data)))))
(defmethod result-data ((condition workspace-apply-failed))
  (let ((data (slot-value condition 'data))) (values (deep-copy data) (not (null data)))))
(defmethod result-snapshot ((condition workspace-apply-failed)) (slot-value condition 'snapshot))
(defmethod result-causes ((value workspace-result)) (copy-seq (slot-value value 'causes)))
(defmethod result-causes ((condition workspace-apply-failed)) (copy-seq (slot-value condition 'causes)))

(defun require-owned-workspace (workspace)
  (check-type workspace workspace)
  (or (slot-value workspace 'owned)
      (fail-workspace "This operation requires workspace/2" :path #(:schema))))

(defun plan-workspace (workspace &optional observation &key reconcile)
  "Return a local WORKSPACE-PLAN for WORKSPACE and captured OBSERVATION.
Workspace/1 accepts a SNAPSHOT or no observation for a creation preview; an
exact captured topology produces no steps. Workspace/2 requires an explicitly
acquired WORKSPACE-STATE for the same workspace ID. A snapshot or incomplete
inspection cannot establish ownership. Matching acquired state remains usable
after its client closes. No acquisition, refresh or mutation occurs.

Owned planning separates declaration changes and captured drift. By default,
either requires explicit :RECONCILE before a plan can be returned; unsupported
changes remain conflicts. PLAN-DATA exposes diagnostics on a plan or
WORKSPACE-CONFLICT. An empty owned step vector can still require metadata
publication: inspect :PUBLISH-P. Application always reacquires and replans.
Non-NIL RECONCILE is invalid for workspace/1.

See also: FETCH-WORKSPACE-STATE, PLAN-DATA, PLAN-STEPS, APPLY-WORKSPACE,
WORKSPACE-STATE, WORKSPACE-CONFLICT."
  (check-type workspace workspace)
  (let ((declaration (slot-value workspace 'owned)))
    (unless declaration
      (when reconcile (fail-workspace "Reconciliation requires workspace/2" :path #(:schema)))
      (return-from plan-workspace (%plan-v1-workspace workspace observation)))
    (unless (typep observation 'workspace-state)
      (fail-workspace "Owned planning requires an explicitly acquired WORKSPACE-STATE" :type 'workspace-conflict))
    (let* ((state (slot-value observation 'value))
           (data (slot-value state 'data)))
      (unless (equal (getf (slot-value declaration 'data) :id) (getf (getf data :declaration) :id))
        (fail-workspace "Planning state belongs to a different workspace ID" :path #(:id) :type 'workspace-conflict))
      (handler-case
          (let ((plan (plan-owned-workspace declaration state :reconcile reconcile)))
            (make-instance 'workspace-plan :steps (owned-plan-steps plan) :data (owned-plan-data plan)))
        (owned-plan-conflict (condition)
          (error 'workspace-conflict :cause condition :data (owned-plan-error-data condition)
                 :path (workspace-path condition) :limit (workspace-limit condition)
                 :message (libtmux:error-message condition)))))))

(defun fetch-workspace-state (client workspace &key cancel-token
                             (timeout (slot-value client 'libtmux::timeout))
                             (output-limit (slot-value client 'libtmux::output-limit)) (record-limit 100000))
  "Acquire ready/vacant owned metadata and a captured graph explicitly through CLIENT.
WORKSPACE must use schema /2; /1 is refused before I/O. TIMEOUT and OUTPUT-LIMIT
share the bounded read policy across attempts. RECORD-LIMIT is an integer from
1 through 100000; CANCEL-TOKEN is shared. No mutation occurs. Returns a
WORKSPACE-STATE for local planning, usable after client close. Actual read
failures signal WORKSPACE-STATE-ERROR with partial evidence; invalid arguments
remain validation failures. Failure is never reported as vacancy.

See also: STATE-DATA, STATE-SNAPSHOT, STATE-OUTCOMES, STATE-CAUSES,
INSPECT-WORKSPACE, PLAN-WORKSPACE."
  (let ((declaration (require-owned-workspace workspace)))
    (handler-case
        (make-instance 'workspace-state
                       :value (fetch-owned-state client declaration :cancel-token cancel-token
                                                 :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit :record-limit record-limit))
      (owned-state-error (condition)
        (error 'workspace-state-error :client client :cause condition :outcome (libtmux:error-outcome condition)
               :path (workspace-path condition) :limit (workspace-limit condition)
               :data (owned-state-error-data condition) :snapshot (owned-state-error-snapshot condition)
               :outcomes (owned-state-error-outcomes condition) :causes (owned-state-error-causes condition)
               :message "Owned state acquisition failed; inspect its retained read evidence")))))

(defun inspect-workspace (client workspace &key cancel-token (timeout (slot-value client 'libtmux::timeout))
                         (output-limit (slot-value client 'libtmux::output-limit)) (record-limit 100000))
  "Acquire explicit incomplete-workspace evidence through CLIENT without mutation.
WORKSPACE must use schema /2; /1 is refused before I/O. Read limits and
CANCEL-TOKEN have FETCH-WORKSPACE-STATE's meanings. Returns a distinct
WORKSPACE-INSPECTION, never a planning input. Completed inspection can describe
BUSY or invalid ownership. A terminal failure signals WORKSPACE-INSPECTION-ERROR
with a partial inspection and original/terminal causes separately retained.

See also: INSPECTION-DATA, INSPECTION-SNAPSHOTS, INSPECTION-OUTCOMES,
INSPECTION-CAUSES, INSPECTION-EVIDENCE, INSPECTION-TERMINAL."
  (let ((declaration (require-owned-workspace workspace)))
    (handler-case
        (make-instance 'workspace-inspection
                       :value (inspect-owned-state client declaration :cancel-token cancel-token
                                                   :timeout timeout :output-limit output-limit :record-limit record-limit))
      (owned-inspection-error (condition)
        (error 'workspace-inspection-error :client client :cause condition
               :outcome (libtmux:error-outcome condition)
               :inspection (make-instance 'workspace-inspection :value (owned-inspection-error-evidence condition))
               :terminal (owned-inspection-error-terminal condition)
               :message "Owned inspection stopped; inspect its retained attempts and causes")))))

(defun retained-workspace-causes (condition)
  "Keep the cause chain and additional read failures once, without traversing cycles."
  (let ((seen (make-hash-table :test #'eq)) (result nil))
    (labels ((visit (value)
               (when (and (typep value 'condition) (not (gethash value seen)))
                 (setf (gethash value seen) t)
                 (push value result)
                 (when (typep value 'libtmux:libtmux-error) (visit (libtmux:error-cause value)))
                 (typecase value
                   (owned-state-error (map nil #'visit (owned-state-error-causes value)))
                   (owned-inspection-error
                    (map nil #'visit (owned-inspection-causes (owned-inspection-error-evidence value))))))))
      (visit condition))
    (coerce (nreverse result) 'simple-vector)))

(defun retained-workspace-snapshot (condition causes)
  (or (owned-apply-error-snapshot condition)
      (some (lambda (cause)
              (when (typep cause 'owned-state-error) (owned-state-error-snapshot cause))) causes)))

(defun apply-workspace
    (client workspace &key cancel-token (timeout nil timeout-p) (output-limit nil output-limit-p)
                          (total-timeout nil total-timeout-p) reconcile)
  "Apply WORKSPACE through explicit CLIENT and return a WORKSPACE-RESULT.
Workspace/1 retains topology-only creation/reuse. Workspace/2 freshly acquires
owned state and replans; a preview is never mutation authority. By default
owned declaration changes or drift are refused; :RECONCILE permits only the
qualified additive, rename, metadata and layout changes. It never adopts an
unowned session or repeats an uncertain mutation. RECONCILE requires schema /2.

TIMEOUT and OUTPUT-LIMIT apply per core operation; CANCEL-TOKEN is shared.
TOTAL-TIMEOUT, when supplied, is a nonnegative finite number of seconds shared
across acquisition, planning and application. It controls admission, including
no-op planning, and is not a hard caller wall-time bound. Synchronous setup and
cleanup can extend an admitted call. Invalid arguments fail before application.

Owned results retain read outcomes even for no-mutation reapplication.
RESULT-DATA separates selected/candidate/observed metadata and publication
status; RESULT-CREATED-P reports creation of the owned session. Conditional
publication is the final mutation, and later observation is read-only.

Owned acquisition, planning and execution failures signal WORKSPACE-APPLY-FAILED
with local RESULT-DATA, RESULT-SNAPSHOT, RESULT-OUTCOMES and RESULT-CAUSES.
FAILED-STEP retains the actual step where known. Successful publication with
failed observation remains distinguishable from failed/uncertain publication.
Legacy failures retain their original early-validation and partial-outcome
behavior. No rollback, hidden refresh during inspection or automatic retry.

See also: PLAN-WORKSPACE, FETCH-WORKSPACE-STATE, RESULT-DATA, RESULT-SNAPSHOT,
RESULT-OUTCOMES, RESULT-CAUSES, FAILED-STEP, WORKSPACE-DEADLINE-EXCEEDED."
  (check-type client libtmux:client)
  (check-type workspace workspace)
  (let* ((declaration (slot-value workspace 'owned))
         (options (append (operation-options cancel-token timeout timeout-p output-limit output-limit-p)
                          (when total-timeout-p (list :total-timeout total-timeout)))))
    (unless declaration
      (when reconcile (fail-workspace "Reconciliation requires workspace/2" :path #(:schema)))
      (return-from apply-workspace (apply #'%apply-v1-workspace client workspace options)))
    (when total-timeout-p
      (libtmux.internal::check-limits total-timeout
                                     (if output-limit-p output-limit (slot-value client 'libtmux::output-limit))))
    (handler-case
        (let* ((result (apply #'apply-owned-workspace client declaration :reconcile reconcile options))
               (data (owned-result-data result)))
          (make-instance 'workspace-result :snapshot (owned-result-snapshot result)
                         :outcomes (owned-result-outcomes result) :data data
                         :created-p (eq :vacant (getf (getf data :selected-state) :status))))
      (owned-apply-error (condition)
        (let ((causes (retained-workspace-causes condition)))
          (error 'workspace-apply-failed :client client :cause condition
                 :outcome (libtmux:error-outcome condition) :step (owned-apply-error-step condition)
                 :data (owned-apply-error-data condition) :outcomes (owned-apply-error-outcomes condition)
                 :snapshot (retained-workspace-snapshot condition causes) :causes causes
                 :path (workspace-path condition) :limit (workspace-limit condition)
                 :message "Owned workspace application stopped; inspect its public phase, mappings and outcomes"))))))
